站住——！

[Guard]
Recently too many people
have been traveling between
Uptown and the ghetto, so
we've heightened security
around here. But how can
so many sneak through us?
scripts.translation:

最近有太多人在里希塔乐镇的上城区和贫民窟之间往返，所以我们加强了这里的安保。
但为什么还是有这么多能溜进来？

呼噜... 呼噜...
呼噜噜噜噜噜...

Go back to where you
came from, adventurer!
scripts.translation:

站住！
我不能让任何人进入贫民窟。
回你来的地方去，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hold it right there!
I can't permit anyone to
enter Uptown Lighthalzen!
If you don't have a pass,
then move on out of here!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
站住！
我不能让任何人进入里希塔乐镇的上城区！
如果没有通行证，就赶紧离开这里！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Oh hey, it's you!
Now, listen. If you wanna
get into Regenschirm again,
you gotta enter that Sewer Pipe
that's like, northeast from me.
It's gross, but you gotta...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
哦，是你啊！
听着。如果你想再次进入雷根席尔姆，你得走我东北方向的那个下水道管道。
虽然很恶心，但你得...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Anyway, good luck in
whatever it is you're doing
here in Lighthalzen. Oh, and
be real careful! Something
shadier than me is going
on in this big city~
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
总之，祝你在里希塔乐镇这里做什么都顺利。哦，对了，一定要小心！
这座大城市里有些比我更阴暗的事在发生~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What...?
Is there something
on my face? Quit looking
at me and let me do my work.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
什...？
我脸上有什么吗？
别盯着我看，让我专心工作。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey. Hey you.
You're still looking
at me. Quit it. I'm busy
here and you're bothering me.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
喂。喂，你。
你还在盯着我看。
别这样。我这边正忙着呢，你在打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Seriously, you are
starting to really get
on my nerves! What could
you possibly want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
说真的，你真是越来越让我烦了！
你到底想从我这里得到什么？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing really.
I just feel like
watching you work.
What exactly are you
doing anyway, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么。
我只是想看看你工作。
你具体在做什么，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey! If I could just show
you what I'm doing, I wouldn't
be so uptight about you looking
at what I'm doing, now would I?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嘿！如果我能直接给你看我在做什么，我也不会这么介意你盯着我看了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nah...
I just think
you're uptight
in general.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...
我只是觉得你平时就很紧张。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Muthafruit!
So you're just
gonna sit and watch
me all day?! Fine! Then
I'll just ignore you, jerk!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
混蛋！
你就打算整天坐着看我工作？！行吧！
那我就无视你，你这个混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
...
......
Damn it!
This is really
ticking me off! Why
don't you go away?!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
...
......
该死！
这真的让我很火大！
你为什么不离开？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was also
wondering why you're
working in a place that's
so, um... depressing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我也在想，你为什么要在一个这么...压抑的地方工作。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, fine!
But once I tell you
what I do here, you're
outta here! Okay? Now,
your lips are frickin' sealed.
See, what I do is kinda illegal.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好吧，行！
但一旦我告诉你我在这里做什么，你就得离开！好吗？
现在，你的嘴必须给我闭紧。
你看，我做的有点违法。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
I provide routes that let
people enter Lighthalzen,
or even go anywhere in this
city, without authorization.
Hell, I could even get you
into that Laboratory...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
我提供路线，让人们在没有许可的情况下进入里希塔乐镇，甚至去这座城市的任何地方。
天哪，我甚至能把你带进那个实验室...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait!
Laboratory?!
Are you serious?
Can you get me
into that place?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
实验室？！
你是认真的吗？
你能带我进去那个地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Sonuva--You're not
gonna leave me alone,
are you? Look, you seem
okay, even if you are kinda
stubborn, kid. But I don't trust
or serve strangers, period.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
该死的——
你就不打算放过我吗？
听着，你看起来还算正常，虽然有点固执，小鬼。但我不信任也不服务陌生人，就这样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But isn't there
anything I can do
so you can help me
get into the Laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，有没有什么我能做的，让你愿意帮我进入实验室？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
No way, no how.
No matter how much you
beg, I can't take a chance
and just trust anyone who
wants to know a secret
route. Now get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
绝对不行。
不管你怎么求，我都不可能冒险去信任任何想要知道秘密路线的人。
现在给我滚！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please...
Please tell me
how I can get inside
the Laboratory. I'm...
I'm begging you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
求你了...
求你告诉我怎么进入实验室。我...
我在求你了！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
No! Now shaddup
and stop begging, okay?
You're only embarassing
yourself! Good grief...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
不！
闭嘴，别求了，好吗？
你只是在丢人现眼！
真是够了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why won't you
heeeeelp meee?
Pleeeeeeeease~
You're the only one
who knoooooows~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么你就不帮帮我呢？
求求你了~
只有你知道方法~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Yeesh, you're a nutty
kid. Look, ''no'' means
''no.'' That's it. That's
final. How many times do
you gotta make me spell it out?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
天哪，你真是个怪小孩。
听着，“不”就是“不”。
就这样，这是最终决定。
我要说多少遍你才肯明白？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But there's gotta
be something I can
do so you'll help me?
Th-that's the way i-it
always w-works. You
can't just-- You c-can't...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是肯定有什么我能做的，让你愿意帮我吧？
那...那就是通常的...做法。
你不能...你...不能...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, you got me.
But if I'm gonna risk
my life to help you get
into that Laboratory I want
something in return. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好吧，你说服我了。
但如果我要冒生命危险帮你进入那个实验室，我需要得到一些回报。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
All you need to do is
come back here with
^FF000071,381,305,294,921,000 zeny^000000.
Then I'll give you all the help
you need. Alright, good luck
to you, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
你只需要带着
^FF000071,381,305,294,921,000 Zeny^000000
回到这里。
然后我会给你你需要的所有帮助。
好了，祝你好运，勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're joking right?!
There's no way I can ever
get that much zeny! I'd...
I'd have to at least take
over the world or, or...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在开玩笑吧？！
我怎么可能弄到那么多Zeny！
我...
我至少得统治世界才行，或者...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Good point.
Fine, maybe that
price is a little high.
I'll just cut it in half,
then. Still want my
help? Then bring me...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
有道理。
好吧，也许那个价格有点高。
那我就减半吧。
还想要我的帮助吗？
那就给我带来...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
 
 
...^FF000020 Jellopy^000000.

[Fishbone]
Gosh.
It's like I'm
doing this for free...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
天哪。
感觉我是在免费帮忙一样...

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: No! It's impossible!
scripts.translation: 不！不可能！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, then
bring me back a
total of 20 Jellopy.
But you gotta have
exactly 20 Jellopy on
you, okay? Seeya pal~
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好吧，那就给我带来总共20个杰勒比结晶。
但你身上必须正好有
20个杰勒比结晶，好吗？
再见了，朋友~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What are you--
Okay, now you're the
one who's joking around.
Look, it's either bring me
20 Jellopy or 71,381,3--
whatever number I said-- zeny!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
你想干什么——
好吧，现在轮到你开玩笑了。
听着，要么给我
20个杰勒比结晶，要么给我
71,381,3——
不管我说了多少——Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
So...
Did you bring
the stuff?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
那么...
你带来东西了吗？

scripts.text: I'm still working on it.
scripts.translation: 我还在准备中

scripts.text: Here you go!
scripts.translation: 给你！

scripts.text: Um... Stuff?
scripts.translation: 呃...什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Still working on it?
Okay, I know I didn't
ask you for very much,
but gimme some respect
and get serious about it!
It's 20 friggin' Jellopies!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
还在准备中？
好吧，我知道我没让你带多少东西，但你得给我点尊重，认真点啊！
那可是20个该死的杰勒比结晶！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Uh...
I said 20 Jellopies,
didn't I? This ain't
enough pal, so go out
and get some more!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
呃...
我说了要20个杰勒比结晶，对吧？这不够啊，朋友，快出去再弄点来！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Ooh. Hey, good work.
Okay, I can see you're
the reliable type. A deal
is a deal, so I'll tell you
how you can get inside
that Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
哦。嘿，干得不错。
看来你是个靠谱的人。
既然答应了，我就告诉你怎么进入那个实验室。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Now, if you're wondering
why I don't got much qualm
against helping you, it's
because I used to work in
the Laboratory... But then
they laid me off unfairly.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
如果你想知道我为什么这么乐意帮你，那是因为我以前在实验室工作过...
但他们不公平地解雇了我。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Anyway, anything I can
do to cause them trouble
is good in my book. Let me
get some stuff ready and
then I'll tell you what you
really need to know.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
总之，任何能给他们添麻烦的事我都乐意做。让我准备点东西，然后我会告诉你你真正需要知道的事情。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What the...?
How could you forget
something like that?
Anyway, I asked you to
bring 20 Jellopies.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
什么...？
你怎么能忘了这种事？
总之，我让你带20个杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
way to get into Regenschrim
Lab. However, I do know of
this secret maze that should
get you there. Still, if you're
willing and ready to go...
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
进入雷根席尔姆实验室的方法。
不过，我知道一个秘密迷宫，应该能带你到那里。不过，如果你愿意并且准备好了的话...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Okay...
Are you ready now?
I'm gonna send you
someplace where you
can find the Lab entrance.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好吧...
你准备好了吗？
我要把你送到一个能找到实验室入口的地方。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Eh...?
Alright, it's
not a problem.
Just take your time.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
呃...？
好吧，没关系。
慢慢来就好。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Great!
Okay then,
here we go!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
太好了！
那么，我们出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hm, you must not have
accomplished whatever
it is you need to do in the
Regenschirm Laboratory yet.
you want me to send
you there again?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嗯，看来你还没在雷根席尔姆实验室完成你需要做的事情。
你想让我再把你送过去一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hm, you must not have
accomplished whatever
it was you were doing
in the Laboratory. Do
you want me to send
you there again?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嗯，看来你还没在实验室完成你正在做的事情。
你想让我再把你送过去一次吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Geez, you must have
really had a hard time
there. Okay, well, when
you're ready to go there,
just let me know, got it?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
天哪，看来你在那边真的过得很艰难。好吧，当你准备好再去那里时，告诉我一声，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Got a lot of
spirit in you,
don't you? Heh!
I like you style~
Get ready, 'cuz
here we go...!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
你很有干劲，不是吗？嘿！
我喜欢你的风格~
准备好，因为我们要出发了...！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey, you came back!
Good, I was starting
to get a little worried
about what happened to
you. So did you get what
you wanted over there?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嘿，你回来了！
很好，我开始有点担心你出什么事了。
那么，你在那边拿到你想要的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
I hope so,
anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...
我希望如此，至少。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Good! Whatever you did,
I hope it messes them up big
time! I usedta be a respected
scientist for Regenschirm till
they laid me off! Serves those
ungrateful jerkoffs right!
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
很好！不管做了什么，我希望这会让他们大受打击！我曾经是雷根席尔姆受人尊敬的科学家，直到他们解雇了我！
那些忘恩负义的混蛋活该！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Then again, my current
line of work seems to suit
me much better. And I don't
gotta worry about formulas
and algorithms anymore.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
不过话说回来，我现在的工作似乎更适合我。
而且我不再需要担心公式和算法了。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Oh yeah, the place you
just went to? There's a
secret path the Laboratory
there. If you want, I can
send you back there. So
what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
哦对了，你刚才去的那个地方？那里有一条通往实验室的秘密通道。如果你愿意，我可以把你送回去。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Okay then, here
we go! Good luck
to you, buddy.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好的，那我们出发吧！祝你好运，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, it's your
choice. Oh, and that
pass you have should
let you into the Laboratory
anyway. Good luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
好吧，随你。哦，对了，你手里的那张通行证应该能让你进入实验室。祝你好运，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Heya pal!
It's been a while.
You doin' good? I'm
just peachy, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嘿，朋友！
好久不见。
你过得还好吗？我一切都好，谢谢~

scripts.text:
Hey kid, get
outta here! Can't
you tell I'm dealin'
in something shady
here? This is no place
for baby faced guys like you!
scripts.translation:
嘿，小鬼，快滚开！
看不出我正在做见不得人的勾当吗？
这里可不是你们这种娃娃脸能来的地方！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Heya pal!
It's been a while.
You doin' good? I'm
just peachy, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[鱼骨]
嘿，朋友！
好久不见。
你过得还好吗？我一切都好，谢谢~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are a bunch
of files scattered
on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地上散落着一堆文件。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are a bunch
of files scattered
on the ground. They
seem to contain all
sorts of information,
but they're all mixed up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上散落着一堆文件。
它们似乎包含各种各样的信息，但全都混在一起了。^000000

scripts.text: Rummage through the files.
scripts.translation: 翻找文件

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile you are
rummaging through
the files, a Red Key
drops to the ground
with a clink. You decide
to keep this ^000000Red Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你翻找文件时，一把红色钥匙叮当一声掉到了地上。
你决定留下这把^000000红色钥匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the place
where you found the
^000000Red Key^3355FF while you were
looking through the files
scattered on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你之前在翻找散落在地上的文件时找到^000000红色钥匙^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the place
where you found the
^000000Red Key^3355FF while you were
looking through the files
scattered on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你之前在翻找散落在地上的文件时找到^000000红色钥匙^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis picture hanging
on the wall catches
your attention for some
inexplicably strange reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF挂在墙上的这幅画不知为何引起了你的注意。^000000

scripts.text: Look behind picture.
scripts.translation: 看看画后面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push and pull
with all your strength,
but the picture won't
budge. If it's too hard
to move, there must be
something hidden behind it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你使出全身的力气推拉，但这幅画纹丝不动。
如果它这么难移动，后面一定藏着什么东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis picture hanging
on the wall catches
your attention for some
inexplicably strange reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF挂在墙上的这幅画不知为何引起了你的注意。^000000

scripts.text: Look behind picture.
scripts.translation: 看看画后面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push and pull
with all your strength,
but this picture is too
hard to move with just
brute strength alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你使出全身的力气推拉，但这幅画太重了，光靠蛮力是移不动的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the
Jackknife, thrust
it under the picture
and twist it in order to
pry the picture off the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿出小刀，把它塞到画下面，然后转动刀身，试图把画从墙上撬下来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在画的后面，你发现写着以下数字：^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在画的后面，你发现写着以下数字：^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在画的后面，你发现写着以下数字：^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately,
doing that apparently
wasn't enough to move
the picture. Perhaps you
should try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，这样做显然不足以移动这幅画。
也许你应该试试别的方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7
scripts.translation:
^3355FF画的后面写着以下数字。
既然它们被藏了起来，这些数字一定有着某种重要的意义。^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5
scripts.translation:
^3355FF画的后面写着以下数字。
既然它们被藏了起来，这些数字一定有着某种重要的意义。^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6
scripts.translation:
^3355FF画的后面写着以下数字。
既然它们被藏了起来，这些数字一定有着某种重要的意义。^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF画的后面写着以下数字。
既然它们被藏了起来，这些数字一定有着某种重要的意义。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a picture
hanging on the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF墙上挂着一幅画。^000000

scripts.text: Look beneath picture.
scripts.translation: 查看画的下面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are some
numbers behind the
picture, but now there is
no need to memorize them.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF画的后面有一些数字，但现在不需要记住它们了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe drawer here
looks interesting,
but it's locked and
you can't open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里的抽屉看起来很特别，但它上了锁，你打不开。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF The drawer here
looks interesting, but
it's locked. Hopefully, you
can figure how to open it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里的抽屉看起来很特别，但它上了锁。
希望你能想办法打开它。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Red Key
into the lock and open the
drawer. Inside, you find a
^000000Jackknife^3355FF that you decide
to take. After all, it might
be handy sometime.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将红色钥匙插入锁孔，打开了抽屉。里面有一把^000000小刀^3355FF，你决定把它拿走。毕竟，说不定什么时候用得上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
can't open or break
the lock on the drawer
by doing that. You need
to try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，这样做无法打开或破坏抽屉上的锁。
你需要尝试其他方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the drawer
in which you found the
^000000Jackknife^3355FF. It is now empty
and devoid of purpose.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这就是你发现^000000小刀^3355FF的那个抽屉。
现在它空了，也失去了存在的意义。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a chest
with an axe laid on
top. The axe's purpose
is completely utilitarian
and isn't suited for battle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个箱子，上面放着一把斧头。
这把斧头完全是为了实用而设计的，并不适合战斗。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a chest,
but more importantly,
there is a utility Axe
laid on top of it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个箱子，但更重要的是，上面放着一把实用斧头。^000000

scripts.text: Take the utility Axe.
scripts.translation: 拿走实用斧头

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFWithout shame or
an ounce of guilt, you
pick up the utility ^000000Axe^3355FF
and claim it as your own.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你毫无羞耻感，也没有一丝愧疚，捡起了这把实用^000000斧头^3355FF，并把它据为己有。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is just a normal
chest. There used to be
a utility ^000000Axe^3355FF on top of
it until you picked it up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一个普通的箱子。
在你拿走之前，上面放着一把实用^000000斧头^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have
found a shabbily
constructed barrel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个做工粗糙的木桶。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have
found a shabbily
constructed barrel.
You sense that there's
something inside, but
you need something to
smash the barrel open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个做工粗糙的木桶。
你感觉到里面有什么东西，但你需要某种东西来砸开这个木桶。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAxe in hand, you lift
it above your head and
swing it downwards,
smashing off the top of
the barrel. Inside, you find a
box topped with a metal plate.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你手持斧头，高举过头顶，用力向下挥砍，劈开了桶盖。里面有一个顶部带有金属板的盒子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe numbers one
through nine are
etched on the surface
of the metal plate on
top of the box you found,
like some kind of keypad...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF盒子上方金属板的表面刻着从1到9的数字，看起来像是某种密码键盘...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFDoing that probably won't
break open this keg. You'll
need to try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这样做可能无法打开这个木桶。
你需要尝试其他方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to enter
some numbers into the
metallic keypad. Remember,
you can only enter single
digit numbers at one time...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定在金属键盘上输入一些数字。
记住，你一次只能输入一位数字...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened...^000000

^3355FFYou decide to enter
some numbers into the
numberpad etched on the
metal plate on top of the box
you found inside the keg.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定在木桶内盒子上方金属板刻着的数字键盘上输入一些数字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe metal plate slides
open and you find a key
Key inside the box. You
to keep this ^000000Yellow Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF金属板滑开了，你在盒子里发现了一把钥匙。
你获得了^000000黄色钥匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It's likely that you did not
enter the correct numbers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
你输入的号码可能不正确。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the box with
the keypad in which you
found the ^000000Yellow Key^3355FF.
The box is now empty.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这就是那个带有密码键盘的盒子，你之前在里面找到了^000000黄色钥匙^3355FF。
现在盒子是空的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a box
topped with a metal
plate that looks like
a crudely made keypad.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一个顶部带有金属板的盒子，看起来像是一个粗糙制作的密码键盘。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a noisily
operating huge machine
with a front panel that has
a strange mark. There is a
keyhole on the machine
right next to this panel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一台正在嘈杂运行的巨大机器，前面板上有奇怪的标记。机器上有一个钥匙孔，就在这个面板旁边。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You probably need
to find the right key to
insert into the keyhole.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
你可能需要找到正确的钥匙插入钥匙孔。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a noisily
operating huge machine
with a front panel that has
a strange mark. There is a
keyhole on the machine
right next to this panel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一台正在嘈杂运行的巨大机器，前面板上有奇怪的标记。机器上有一个钥匙孔，就在这个面板旁边。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the
Yellow Key into the
keyhole and turn it,
causing the machine
to sputter and deactivate.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将黄色钥匙插入钥匙孔并转动，机器发出咔哒声并停止了运行。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice that the
^000000Status Light ^3355FFnext to the
bed has now turned off.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到床边的^000000状态灯^3355FF现在熄灭了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You probably need
to find the right key to
insert into the keyhole.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
你可能需要找到正确的钥匙插入钥匙孔。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt's a giant machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一台巨大的机器。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Status Light is
on. It looks like there's
something inside the
bulb, but you can't get
near it since it generates
incredibly scorching heat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF状态灯亮着。看起来灯泡里面有什么东西，但由于它产生极高的热量，你无法靠近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow, if you could
somehow shut down the
Power Generator in this
room, the bulb would be
cool enough for you to touch...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF现在，如果你能设法关闭这个房间里的发电机，灯泡就会冷却到你可以触摸的程度...^000000

scripts.text:
The Status Light
is now off and the
bulb has cooled down.
scripts.translation: 状态灯现在熄灭了，灯泡已经冷却。

scripts.text: Smash the light bulb.
scripts.translation: 砸碎灯泡

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou smash the
Status Light's bulb
and discover another key.
You obtained a ^000000Black Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你砸碎了状态灯的灯泡，发现了另一把钥匙。
你获得了^000000黑色钥匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the remains
of a broken light bulb.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个破碎的灯泡残骸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found
a completely
cluttered desk.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张杂乱无章的桌子。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屉

scripts.text:
^3355FFVarious documents,
books and lab equipment
are scattered on the desk.
But none of them seem
all that useful right now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF桌面上散落着各种文件、书籍和实验器材。
不过它们现在似乎都没什么用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder this desk, of
all conceivable places,
you find a ^000000Short Stick^3355FF
that you decide to keep.
You never know when
you'll need one of those.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在所有你能想到的地方中，你竟然在这张桌子下面发现了一根^000000短棍^3355FF，你决定把它收起来。
说不定什么时候用得上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found your ^000000Short Stick^3355FF.
Sadly, there are no more
hidden treasures for you to
discover beneath this desk.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里就是你之前找到^000000短棍^3355FF的地方。
遗憾的是，桌子下面没有更多隐藏的宝藏供你发现了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe desk drawer is
locked and probably
with good reason. After all,
you just tried to invade this
private and intimate space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张桌子的抽屉锁着，而且很可能有充分的理由。
毕竟，你刚才试图闯入这个私密的空间。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're back at the
messy desk which
is probably used by
a high ranking executive
who has someone else
do his desk tidying for him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你回到了这张杂乱的桌子前，它可能属于某位高管，而且他肯定有专人帮他整理桌面。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屉

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlas, no matter how much
you rummage through it,
the clutter on the desk
proves to be useless to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF唉，无论你怎么翻找，桌面上的杂物对你来说似乎都毫无用处。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn issue of the
Dancer magazine,
''Harmonic Lick'' catches
your eye, but you really
shouldn't be interested
in that publication just
because of the pictures.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一本舞者杂志《和声乐句》吸引了你的目光，但你真的不应该仅仅因为里面的图片就对这本刊物感兴趣。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn issue of the female
entertainment magazine,
''Magnum Break'' catches
your eye, but adventurers
have no time to look at
pictures of beautiful men.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一本女性娱乐杂志《怒爆》
吸引了你的目光，但冒险者可没空看帅哥的图片。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder the desk, you
discover another Short
Stick which happens to
fit perfectly into the other
Short Stick you found earlier.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在桌子下面，你发现了另一根短棍，它恰好能完美地接在你之前找到的那根短棍上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou combine the two
lesser sticks to create
a stick that is superior
to the sum of its parts.
You are now the proud
bearer of a ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将两根较短的棍子组合起来，创造出了一根超越部分之和的棍子。
你现在自豪地拥有了一根^000000长棍^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk drawer is
locked shut and probably
always will be. It's likely
that nothing really valuable
is inside, aside from perhaps
a hip flask or a candy stash.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张桌子的抽屉锁得严严实实，而且可能永远都打不开。
里面可能没有什么真正值钱的东西，除了也许是一个酒壶或一堆糖果。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is cluttered
with all sorts of random
objects, but such is its
destiny as office equipment.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这张桌子上堆满了各种杂七杂八的东西，但这正是办公设备的宿命。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屉

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlas, no matter how much
you rummage through it,
the clutter on the desk
proves to be useless to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF唉，无论你怎么翻找，桌面上的杂物对你来说似乎都毫无用处。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's part of a newspaper
here, but it's only the Comics
section which, of course, isn't
informative enough for world
savvy adventurers like you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里有一份报纸的残页，但只有漫画版块，当然，这对像你这样见多识广的冒险者来说信息量是不够的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you found
one of two Short Sticks
to make your ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.
There isn't anything else
under here, so it's impossible
to make your stick any longer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里是你找到两根短棍之一用来制作^000000长棍^3355FF的地方。
下面没有其他东西了，所以你的棍子不可能再变长了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk drawer is
locked very securely.
The owner of this desk
was wise to provide a
measure of drawer security.
But why put sticks under the
desk? This is most curious...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张桌子的抽屉锁得非常牢固。
这张桌子的主人很明智，采取了抽屉安全措施。
但为什么要把棍子放在桌子下面？
这太奇怪了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a bed
in which the sheets
are slovenly arranged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张床，床单凌乱地铺在上面。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上没有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
对某些人来说，这可能是一个不变的真理。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder the bed, you
discover a ^000000Short Stick^3355FF
which you decide to
keep. You never know
when certain, seemingly
useless objects will save you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在床下，你发现了一根^000000短棍^3355FF，你决定把它收起来。
你永远不知道，某些看似无用的物品何时会救你一命。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a bed
in which the sheets
are slovenly arranged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张床，床单凌乱地铺在上面。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上没有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
对某些人来说，这可能是一个不变的真理。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder the bed, you
discover another Short
Stick which happens to
fit perfectly into the other
Short Stick you found earlier.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在床下，你发现了另一根短棍，它正好能完美地接在你之前找到的那根短棍上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou combine the two
lesser sticks to create
a stick that is superior
to the sum of its parts.
You are now the proud
bearer of a ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将两根较短的棍子组合起来，创造出了一根超越部分之和的棍子。
你现在自豪地拥有了一根^000000长棍^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a bed
in which the sheets
are slovenly arranged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张床，床单凌乱地铺在上面。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上没有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
对某些人来说，这可能是一个不变的真理。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn a distant and
dusty corner beneath
the bed, you manage to
spot an object. If only you
could reach it somehow...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在床下远处布满灰尘的角落里，你勉强看到了一个物体。
要是能想办法够到它就好了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try to reach
the object by using
your Short Stick. After
a few attempts, you had no
choice but to admit that your
stick just wasn't long enough.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你试着用短棍去够那个物体。
尝试了几次后，你不得不承认，你的棍子还是不够长。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately,
whatever you used to
try to reach the object
didn't work. You'll have
to think of something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，无论你用什么去够那个物体都没用。
你得想点别的办法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a messy
bed that may be more
than meets the eye.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张凌乱的床，它可能并不像表面看起来那么简单。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上没有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
对某些人来说，这可能是一个不变的真理。^000000

dusty corner beneath
the bed, you manage to
spot an object. If only you
could reach it somehow...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在床下远处布满灰尘的角落里，你勉强看到了一个物体。
要是能想办法够到它就好了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWith Long Stick in
hand, you manage to
reach the object and drag
it under the bed towards you.
You now possess the ^000000Cube^3355FF
that was under the bed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF手持长棍，你终于够到了那个物体，并将其从床下拖到了身边。
你现在拥有了床下的那个^000000立方体^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately,
whatever you used to
try to reach the object
didn't work. You'll have
to think of something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，无论你用什么去够那个物体都没用。
你得想点别的办法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a bed
in which the sheets
are slovenly arranged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一张床，床单凌乱地铺在上面。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上没有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
对某些人来说，这可能是一个不变的真理。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
managed to find some
sort of strange ^000000Cube^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你找到某种奇怪的^000000立方体^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see an empty
bottle and a goblet.
It looks like you
missed the party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到一个空瓶和一个高脚杯。
看起来你错过了那场派对。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the goblet.
scripts.translation: 检查高脚杯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside the goblet,
you find a ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF
which you decide to keep.
However, you'll need to get
rid of that rust somehow.
Perhaps you can dip the key
in some corrosive chemical?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在高脚杯里，你发现了一把^000000生锈的钥匙^3355FF，你决定把它收起来。
不过，你得想办法除掉上面的锈迹。
也许可以把钥匙泡在某种腐蚀性化学剂里？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the goblet where
you found that ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你找到那把^000000生锈的钥匙^3355FF的高脚杯。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is goblet cup where
you found that ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你找到那把^000000生锈的钥匙^3355FF的高脚杯。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a bottle
containing slightly
corrosive chemicals
that is sitting on the ledge.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF架子上放着一个瓶子，里面装着略带腐蚀性的化学剂。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you tried to
pour the chemicals on
wasn't affected at all.
You should try pouring the
chemicals on something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF无论你把化学剂倒在哪里，都没有产生任何影响。
你应该试着把化学剂倒在别的东西上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a bottle
containing slightly
corrosive chemicals
that is sitting on the ledge.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF架子上放着一个瓶子，里面装着略带腐蚀性的化学剂。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPouring the chemicals
on the Rusty Key removes
the rust, making it usable
again. Now that it is clean,
the Rusty Key has become
a sparkling ^000000Green Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF将化学剂倒在生锈的钥匙上，锈迹被去除了，钥匙又能使用了。
现在它变得干净了，生锈的钥匙变成了一把闪闪发光的^000000绿色钥匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you tried to
pour the chemicals on
wasn't affected at all.
You should try pouring the
chemicals on something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF无论你把化学剂倒在哪里，都没有产生任何影响。
你应该试着把化学剂倒在别的东西上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese are the chemicals
that you used to clean the
Rusty Key so that it was
restored to its original glory,
becoming the ^000000Green Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你用来清洁生锈的钥匙，使其恢复原本光彩，变成^000000绿色钥匙^3355FF的化学剂。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
cabinet that contains
many drawers. Perhaps
something useful is inside?
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个有很多抽屉的柜子。
里面也许藏着什么有用的东西？

scripts.text: Open
scripts.translation: 开门

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, the
cabinet has been locked.
You'll need the right key
in order to open the drawers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不幸的是，柜子被锁住了。你需要正确的钥匙才能打开抽屉。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
cabinet that contains
many drawers. Perhaps
something useful is inside?
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个有很多抽屉的柜子。
里面也许藏着什么有用的东西？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the Green Key
and finds that it fits into
one of the drawer keyholes.
You open the drawer and
obtain a strange ^000000Polygon^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起绿色钥匙，发现它正好能插入其中一个抽屉的锁孔。你打开抽屉，获得了一个奇怪的^000000多边形^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you tried
did not succeed in
opening this cabinet.
Think. Think of how
locks are unlocked...
Then you'll find the
answer you seek.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你尝试的方法没能打开这个柜子。想想看。想想锁是怎么被打开的...然后你就会找到你想要的答案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the locker
where you used the
Green Key to open one
of the Drawers and obtained
a ^000000Polygon^3355FF. You're pretty happy
with your Polygon and don't
need to open the other drawers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你用绿色钥匙打开其中一个抽屉并获得^000000多边形^3355FF的地方。你对你的多边形很满意，不需要打开其他的抽屉了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a strange
tube that seems to
contain something.
Underneath the tube is
a thin plate with a keyhole
and a card insertion slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个奇怪的试管，里面似乎装着什么东西。试管下方有一块薄板，上面有一个锁孔和一个卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You'll probably need
to find the right key for
the keyhole and the correct
card to insert into the slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF什么也没发生。你大概需要找到适合锁孔的钥匙，以及正确的卡片插入插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a strange
tube that seems to
contain something.
Underneath the tube is
a thin plate with a keyhole
and a card insertion slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个奇怪的试管，里面似乎装着什么东西。试管下方有一块薄板，上面有一个锁孔和一个卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Black Key
into the keyhole, causing
the experiment tube to open
and reveal an ^000000Oval^3355FF which you
you choose to take with you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将黑色钥匙插入锁孔，试管随之打开，露出了一个^000000椭圆形^3355FF，你决定把它带走。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened...^000000

^3355FFThis is where you
obtained the ^000000Oval^3355FF.
As you look around
the tube's location,
you notice an artificial
ground fissure which
can probably open up...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你获得^000000椭圆形^3355FF的地方。当你环顾试管周围时，你注意到地面上有一道人工裂缝，它似乎可以打开...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a narrow,
rectangular card slot
in front of the tube.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF试管前方有一个窄长的矩形卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the
Laboratory Permit
into the slot and the
man made fissure in the
ground splits open, revealing
an underground staircase.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将研究所进出卡片插入插槽，地面上的人工裂缝随之裂开，露出了一段通往地下的楼梯。^000000

scripts.text: Go downstairs
scripts.translation: 下楼

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou walk down
the long flight
of winding stairs...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你沿着长长的蜿蜒楼梯走下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThis is where you
obtained the ^000000Oval^3355FF.
As you look around
the tube's location,
you notice an articial
ground fissure which
can probably open up...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你获得^000000椭圆形^3355FF的地方。当你环顾试管周围时，你注意到地面上有一道人工裂缝，它似乎可以打开...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个盒子，上面有三个形状各异的孔。^000000

scripts.text: Oval Hole
scripts.translation: 椭圆孔

scripts.text: Cubic Hole
scripts.translation: 立方孔

scripts.text: Polygon Hole
scripts.translation: 多边形孔

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个盒子，上面有三个形状各异的孔。^000000

scripts.text: Oval Hole
scripts.translation: 椭圆孔

scripts.text: Cube Hole
scripts.translation: 立方孔

scripts.text: Polygon Hole
scripts.translation: 多边形孔

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Oval
into the Oval shaped
hole where it fits perfectly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将椭圆放入椭圆形的孔中，完美契合。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThe Oval shaped hole
already has an Oval in it.
Besides, it's not you have
any Ovals to spare, anyway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF椭圆形的孔里已经有一个椭圆了。
而且，你手头也没有多余的椭圆。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou insert the Cube
into the Cubic hole
and it clicks into place.
Your formal Kindergarten
training is finally justified.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将立方体放入立方形的孔中，咔哒一声卡紧了。
你终于证明了自己在幼儿园接受的正式培训是有用的。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou already placed
a Cube into the hole.
You could take it back
out and put it in again,
but that would just be
a total waste of time.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你已经把立方体放进孔里了。
你可以把它拿出来再放进去，但那纯粹是浪费时间。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFFortunately, the
nondescript Polygon
that you have is exactly
the same shape as this
nondescript Polygonal hole.
The Polygon fits perfectly,
almost as if it were destiny.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF幸运的是，你手中的这个普通多边形与这个普通的多边形孔形状完全一致。
多边形完美契合，仿佛命中注定一般。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThe Polygon is already
inserted into the hole.
Trust that this is as much
as this Polygon can do for you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF多边形已经插入孔中了。
相信这就是这个多边形能为你做的极限了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes that
are now filled with the
objects you've inserted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个盒子，上面有三个形状各异的孔，现在这些孔已经被你插入的物体填满了。^000000

scripts.text: Open the box.
scripts.translation: 打开盒子

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou open the box
and find that there's
a small card labeled
''Laboratory Permit'' inside.
You pocket this ^000000Laboratory
Permit^3355FF, knowing that you
will be needing it later.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你打开盒子，发现里面有一张写着
“^000000研究所进出卡片^3355FF”的小卡片。
你将它收好，知道之后会用到它。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the open box
which used to contain
the ^000000Laboratory Permit^3355FF.
This box is no longer
useful to you now, but
once upon a time, its
mysteries were a challenge.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你找到了那个曾经装着
^000000研究所进出卡片^3355FF的打开的盒子。
这个盒子对你已经没用了，但曾经，它的谜题是一个挑战。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've come upon a
door that leads outside.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一扇通往室外的门。^000000

scripts.text: Exit
scripts.translation: 出口

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found a passage that
seems to lead somewhere,
but you get the feeling that
you shouldn't enter it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一条似乎通向某处的通道，但你觉得现在不应该进去。^000000

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
You're right, that was
wrong of me. Thanks
for letting me go. Since
you did me a favor, I'll
sell you some tonic that
I use to run really fast.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
你说得对，是我做错了。
谢谢你放过我。既然你帮了我，我就卖给你一些我用来跑得飞快的药水吧。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
I can only sell up to
three of my secret tonic
to you since that's all
I have. Each one will
cost 15,000 zeny. So
what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
我只有三瓶这种秘制药水，所以最多只能卖给你三瓶。
每瓶售价15,000 Zeny。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Give me 1.
scripts.translation: 给我1瓶

scripts.text: Give me 2.
scripts.translation: 给我2瓶

scripts.text: Give me 3.
scripts.translation: 给我3瓶

scripts.text: No, I'm fine.
scripts.translation: 没有，我没事

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Well...
You're just gonna
let me go, then?
That's awful generous.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
那...你就这样放过我？
真是大方啊。
谢谢，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
