scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒险者？
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇的上城区。不过，恐怕这个区域不会给你提供太多刺激的经历。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Not to be rude or
anything, but this town
should be safe enough for
you to explore. I mean, you
just seem to be kind of new
at this adventurer thing...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
别误会，我不是故意冒犯，但这镇上应该足够安全，你可以放心探索。我是说，你看起来像是刚入行的冒险者...

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz has passed
away, but the look on
his face seems very
peaceful and content.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF迪戈茨已经离世，但他脸上的神情显得非常安详和满足。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz is seriously
injured from a wound
by a knife that is still
embedded in his belly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF迪戈茨伤势严重，一把刀还插在他的腹部。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Digotz...?
Oh no, let me
get you some help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
迪戈茨...？
天哪，让我去叫人来帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
H-hey... It's the
adventurer... Man,
that Maku. He always
did bring me bad luck...
It's too late for me and
I don't have much time...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嘿...是你啊，冒险者...唉，又是马库。他总是给我带来厄运...
我大限已至，时间不多了...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Those guards I told you
about... The ones who don't
want the poor and the rich to
mingle? I... Guess they found
I was gonna meet my old pal.
I just wanted to see him...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我之前跟你提过的那些卫兵...就是那些不希望穷人和富人混在一起的人？
我...我想他们发现我要去见我的老伙计了。
我只是想看看他...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
This guy... In a black
suit... He just... He just
stabbed me! I... God. It's
been so long since I've talked
to him. We'll hang out and have
fun, just like the good old days.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
那个家伙...穿着黑色西装...他...他刺了我一刀！天哪。
我已经很久没和他说过话了。我们要像以前那样一起玩乐，重温旧梦。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I missed my buddies, but now...
Now I can hear them calling me.
Now we can all be together just
like we all promised. Yeah...
I was wrong. Life's too short
to be angry with your frie--
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我很想念我的伙伴们，但现在...
现在我能听到他们在呼唤我了。现在我们可以像当初承诺的那样永远在一起了。是的...
我错了。人生苦短，不该对朋友怀有愤--

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz stopped breathing.
You remove the Knife from
his lifeless body as a final
courtesy to a man who
dearly loved his friends.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF迪戈茨停止了呼吸。
你从他那失去生机的身体上拔出那把刀，作为对这位深爱朋友的男子最后的敬意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Wh-whoa, I need to
get ready! That Maku's
gonna make fun of me if
I look too rich and pampered.
Damn! Where did I put all of
my fashionable street clothes?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哇哦，我得赶紧准备一下！如果我看起来太有钱太娇贵，马库肯定会嘲笑我的。
该死！我把那些时髦的街头衣服放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even if Benkaistein
did come back, I don't
think I could forgive Maku.
In fact, you know what?
I think I'd even be madder!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
即使本凯斯坦真的回来了，我也不觉得我能原谅马库。
事实上，你知道吗？
我觉得我会更生气！

scripts.text: Show Benkaistein's Journal.
scripts.translation: 出示本凯斯坦的日志

scripts.text: Don't show Benkaistein's Journal.
scripts.translation: 不展示本凯斯坦的日志

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Why am I so ticked off?
^3355FF*Sigh*^000000 You have something
to show me? Huh? Benkaistein
wanted me to read this diary
of his? Sure, why not? I do
owe him a lot over the years...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我为什么这么生气？
^3355FF*叹气*^000000 你有什么要给我看的吗？嗯？
本凯斯坦想让我读他的这本日记？好吧，为什么不呢？多年来我确实欠他很多...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, me, Digotz and
Maku played this crazy flying
game. Basically, we make
these wings out of wood and
paper, jump off these hills
and try to fly. Dumb, I know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天，我、迪戈茨和马库玩了一种疯狂的飞行游戏。基本上，我们用木头和纸做翅膀，从山上跳下来尝试飞行。
很蠢，我知道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today it was my turn to
jump and flap my arms with
these fake, badly made wings.
It's not really a fun game when
I think about it. Boy, I hope
we don't do that again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天轮到我了，我挥舞着这些做工粗糙的假翅膀跳了下去。仔细想想，这游戏其实并不好玩。
天哪，希望我们别再玩这个了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh yeah, I remember that!
Maku wore the wings most
of the time, but I still hold
the record for staying in the
air the longest! Yeah, I was
a regular Kid Pegasus~
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦对，我记得那次！
马库大部分时间都戴着翅膀，但我保持着在空中停留最久的记录！
没错，我可是真正的飞马少年~

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Maku, Digotz and me went
outside of town. Of course,
we didn't tell anyone or else
we'd get in trouble. It was
a really exciting day. But
then, we ran into a monster!^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363马库、迪戈茨和我偷偷溜出了镇子。当然，我们没告诉任何人，不然肯定会惹上麻烦。那天真的非常刺激。但后来，我们遇到了一只魔物！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363I wanted to run away but Maku
and Digotz wanted to beat it so
that we could become heroes.
Of course, we got hurt pretty
bad and the monster got away.
Boy, mom was not happy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363我想逃跑，但马库和迪戈茨想打败它，这样我们就能成为英雄了。结果我们受了很重的伤，魔物也逃走了。天哪，妈妈当时很不高兴...^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Huh. I don't remember
that so well. But I know that
Benkaistein, me and Maku
weren't afraid of anything back
then. We must have been totally
nuts to fight a monster, though.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嗯。那段记忆有点模糊了。但我知道，那时候的本凯斯坦、我和马库什么都不怕。不过，敢去跟魔物打架，我们当时肯定都是疯了。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's been sick for three
days now. It's just a normal
cold and Maku keeps saying
it's Digotz's fault he got sick.^FFFFFF ^856363 But he's always asking me to
go visit him and see if he's okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363迪戈茨已经病了三天了。只是普通的感冒，马库一直说是迪戈茨自己活该生病。^FFFFFF ^856363但他总是让我去探望他，看看他好点了没有。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I think I remember being
pretty sick. Maku was worried?
I... I must have had a horrible
life threatening disease like,
um, Gonorrhitis. You know.
That might have been it.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我记得我病得很重。马库很担心我？我...我一定是得了什么危及生命的重病，比如，嗯，淋病。你知道的。可能就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Mom and dad keep telling
me not to hang out with Maku
anymore. Their reason is really
dumb, and I don't care if he is
poor. He's one of the best guys
that I'll ever know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363爸爸妈妈一直让我别再跟马库混在一起了。他们的理由真的很蠢，我才不在乎他穷不穷。他是我认识的最棒的人之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's family is really
rich and they don't want him
to see Maku anymore either.
But Digotz doesn't care.
I know he likes Maku a lot.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363迪戈茨家里很有钱，他们也不希望迪戈茨再跟马库来往了。但迪戈茨不在乎。我知道他很喜欢马库。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Well, we were a lot
younger and closer back
then, so... ^333333*Ahem!*^000000 Why did
Benkaistein even write that?!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嗯，那时候我们年纪小，关系也更亲密，所以... ^333333*咳咳！*^000000 本凯斯坦为什么要写那些东西？！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, the three of us
made an oath of brotherhood,
just like we read in the comic
book. We swore we'd always
be friends no matter what.
For always and for always.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天，我们三个像漫画书里那样，结下了兄弟之誓。我们发誓无论发生什么，永远都是朋友。永远，永远。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I... I was forced to make
that oath! And people do
change, you know! I mean,
we were basically just kids,
it's not like that oath really
means anything now, does it?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我...我是被迫立下那个誓言的！而且人总是会变的，你知道吗？我是说，我们当时基本上还是小孩子，那个誓言现在应该没什么意义了吧？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
That does it. I'm gonna
go see that Maku. I don't
miss him or anything, but
I gotta get him to cancel
that oath. And maybe I'll
beat up him a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
够了。我要去找那个马库。我并不是想念他什么的，但我必须让他取消那个誓言。也许我会揍他一顿。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I don't understand
why I'm so angry!
I'm starting to act
more like Maku, though,
don't get me wrong, it's
not like I care about the guy.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我不明白我为什么这么生气！我开始变得像马库一样了，别误会，我并不是在乎那个人。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even if Benkaistein came
back from wherever he was
studying, I don't think he'd be
able to get Maku to apologize
to me. That guy is just way
too stubborn for his own good!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
就算本凯斯坦从他在读书的地方回来，我觉得他也没法让马库向我道歉。那个人就是太固执了，对自己没好处！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, it's been a while.
What are you doing back
over here? And, um, did
you deliver that message
to Maku? Now when I think
about it, I was kind of--
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，好久不见。你回这边做什么？还有，嗯，你把那条消息带给马库了吗？现在回想起来，我其实有点--

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I delivered your message
word for word, and Maku
got angry, called you names
and has been threatening to
beat you up pretty badly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原封不动地转达了你的话，马库很生气，骂了你一顿，还威胁说要狠狠揍你。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
That no-good, dirty
lying rotten scoundrel!
If it weren't for those
guards, I'd head over to
the ghetto and beat Maku
up myself! That stupid guy!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
那个无赖、肮脏、撒谎成性的混蛋！要不是有那些卫兵拦着，我早就去贫民窟把马库揍一顿了！那个蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
During times like this,
I really miss ^FF0000Benkaistein^000000.
That guy would always have
an answer for this kind of
situation. Yeah, I think he's
in some far off town, studying.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
在这种时候，我真的想念^FF0000本凯斯坦^000000。遇到这种情况，他总是有办法解决。是啊，我想他在某个遥远的城镇读书。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Supposedly he's in that
place, whatever it's called,
since there's a ton of books
there that he can use. But
yeah, Benkaistein would
always be the mediator...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
据说他在那个地方，叫什么来着，因为那里有很多书供他使用。不过是啊，本凯斯坦总是那个调解人...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even back then, when
me, him and Maku used to
hang out, Benkaistein would
mediate if we got into some
argument. Still, he couldn't
do anything about Maku now...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
即使是在以前，我、他和马库一起出去玩的时候，如果我们吵架，本凯斯坦也会来调解。不过，现在他对马库也无可奈何...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I don't know why,
but I'm so angry!
Why am I stressing
out so much over this?!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我不知道为什么，但我好生气！我为什么要在意这件事？！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Still checking out
Uptown Lighthalzen?
Not like I'd care, but if you
do happen to see Maku,
deliver this little message
for me, sentence by sentence.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
还在里希塔乐镇的上城区闲逛吗？
虽然我不在乎，但如果你碰巧见到马库，请帮我逐句传达这句话。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
^FF0000Hopeless bastard!
^FF0000You're still a stubborn jerk!
^FF0000You owe me at least 3 lunches!
^FF0000Not to mention an apology!
^FF0000But who cares what you think?!
I'm so goddamn happy without you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
^FF0000没救的混蛋！
^FF0000你真是个固执的蠢货！
^FF0000你至少欠我三顿午饭！
^FF0000还有道歉！
^FF0000不过谁在乎你怎么想？！
没有你我开心得很！^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I know that the
opulence of Uptown
seems rather attractive,
but trust me. This place
is colorless. Now, have
you visited the poor district?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我知道上城区的繁华看起来很诱人，但相信我，这里毫无色彩。
那么，你去过贫民窟吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I did already...
scripts.translation: 是的，我去过了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I did already...
And I met someone
named Maku there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我去过了...
而且我在那里遇到了一个叫马库的人。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku?! Oh, he must have
mentioned something about
me. But I don't care what he
says, unless it's an apology
for being a fully blown jerk.
Ever since we were kids...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
马库？！噢，他肯定提过我。但我不在乎他怎么说，除非他是来为那个彻头彻尾的混蛋行为道歉的。
自从我们小时候...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Anyway, we used to be close,
but that guy was never a true
friend of mine! Like that one
time he cheated to beat me at
arm wrestling! Or when he never
thanked me for buying us lunch!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
总之，我们以前很亲近，但那家伙从来不是我真正的朋友！
就像那次他作弊赢了我的掰手腕！
或者他从不感谢我请他吃午饭！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Sure, he might have helped
me a little in meeting my first
girlfriend, but I'll never ever
forgive him for fixing me up
on the worst blind dates a
man can possibly experience!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
没错，他可能在我认识第一个女朋友时帮了点忙，但我永远不会原谅他给我安排那些男人可能经历过的最糟糕的相亲！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku doesn't know a damn
about friendship! Even if I did
want to see him, there are these
people who don't want the rich
to ever meet with the poor.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
马库根本不懂什么是友谊！
即使我想见他，也有这些人不希望富人和穷人见面。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
If Maku's fine, that's
good enough to hear for
me! There's no need for me
to go all the way over there
and check up on him! I only
have one regret though...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
如果马库没事，对我来说这就够了！
我不需要特意跑过去看他！我只有一个遗憾...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I only wish I had one
last chance to see Maku...
So that I could kick his sorry
ass myself! Yeah, that's right!
Arrogant bastard! But still,
I'm not able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我只希望能有最后一次见马库的机会...
这样我就能亲自揍他一顿！
没错，就是这样！
傲慢的混蛋！但即便如此，我也做不到...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
The security guards here
will never allow the rich and
poor to meet, fearing that
the poor will disturb the peace
and order of the city. It's a dumb rule made for dumb people.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
这里的保安绝不允许富人和穷人见面，担心穷人会扰乱城市的和平与秩序。这是为蠢人制定的愚蠢规则。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Still, it's pretty scary that
someone can get punished
for violating such a stupid
taboo, actually. Anyway, if
you see Maku again, tell
him this for me, got it?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
不过，违反这种愚蠢的禁忌真的会受到惩罚，这挺吓人的。总之，如果你再见到马库，替我告诉他这句话，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
^FF0000Hopeless bastard!
^FF0000You're still a stubborn jerk!
^FF0000You owe me at least 3 lunches!
^FF0000Not to mention an apology!
^FF0000But who cares what you think?!
I'm so goddamn happy without you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
^FF0000没救的混蛋！
^FF0000你真是个固执的蠢货！
^FF0000你至少欠我三顿午饭！
^FF0000还有道歉！
^FF0000不过谁在乎你怎么想？！
没有你我开心得很！^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
What are you still
doing hanging around
here? There's nothing
interesting in Uptown
for you to see, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
你还在这里闲逛什么？
上城区没有什么值得你看的，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Gosh...!
Just hearing about
Maku makes me so feel
so upset for some reason!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
天哪...！
光是听到马库的名字我就莫名地感到心烦意乱！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒险者？
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇的上城区。不过，恐怕这个区域不会给你提供太多刺激的经历。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
My name is Digotz,
just another citizen
of Upper Lighthalzen.
I hope that you enjoy
your stay in my hometown.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我叫迪戈茨，只是里希塔乐镇上城区的一名市民。
希望你在我的家乡玩得开心。

scripts.text: Do you know someone named Maku?
scripts.translation: 你认识一个叫马库的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku? Maku. Yes, he's my
childhood friend. Or he was,
anyway. Now he's just a jerk.
In any case, we can't hang
out, even if we wanted to,
for several reasons.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
马库？马库。是的，他是我的儿时玩伴。或者说曾经是。
现在他只是个混蛋。
无论如何，即使我们想，由于几个原因，我们也无法在一起闲逛。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Hey, why am I even
talking about this? It's
not like I'm bothered by
the fact me and Maku aren't
pals anymore. You know what?
Just forget everything I said.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嘿，我为什么要谈论这个？
我和马库不再是朋友这件事并没有困扰我。
你知道吗？
忘掉我说的一切吧。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒险者？
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇的上城区。不过，恐怕这个区域不会给你提供太多刺激的经历。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Feel free to take
a look around if you
so wish. I'm actually
glad to see somebody
aside from the stuck up
rich people who live here.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
如果你愿意，可以四处看看。
我很高兴看到除了住在这里的势利眼富人之外的人。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Why is this guy so
late? Once he shows
up, I swear, I'm gonna...!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
这家伙怎么这么晚？
等他来了，我发誓，我要...！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, what is that? You want
I should read this journal?
Er, okay, but I'm none too
comfortable going through
somebody's diary. It's just
kinda... creepy, you know?
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嘿，那是什么？你想让我读这本日志？
呃，好吧，但我翻别人的日记实在有点不习惯。就是...
有点瘆人，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Arrrrgh! Whenever I hear
about that Digotz, I get so
peeved! Is that guy giving
me the brushoff just because
I'm not a rich guy like he is?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
啊啊啊！一听到迪戈茨那个名字我就火大！他是不是因为我不像他那样有钱才不理我？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
RrrrRrrrr....
RrrrrRRRrrRR....
GGGGGRRRRR...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
咕咕咕...
咕咕咕咕...
嘎嘎嘎...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What the hell are you
still doing around here?
You must have better things
to do than talk to a ruffian
like me or that snobby and
totally prickish Digotz.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
你他妈还赖在这里干嘛？
你肯定有比跟像我这样的混混，或者那个势利眼、自命不凡的迪戈茨说话更好的事做吧。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Man, I need to blow off some
steam! Sure, me and Digotz
were buds before and maybe
we might seem like friends now,
but not anymore, though we used
to be closer than this. Argh!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
真是的，我得发泄一下！
没错，我和迪戈茨以前是死党，现在看起来也许还是朋友，但已经不是了，虽然以前我们比现在更亲近。
啊！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, what are you
doing back over here?
I thought I recommended
going over to check out
Uptown Lighthalzen. This
place is pretty run-down...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嘿，你怎么又回来了？
我刚才不是建议你去里希塔乐镇的上城区看看吗？
这地方挺破旧的...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, you're one of
those adventurers, eh?
Welcome to the ghetto.
Nothing too adventurous
here, but hey, you can
explore all you want.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嘿，你是那些冒险者之一吧？
欢迎来到贫民窟。
这里没什么冒险的，不过，你可以随便逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Why is Digotz
so late? This isn't
like him at all. Maybe
something's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[马库]
迪戈茨怎么这么晚？
这完全不像他啊。
难道出什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Eh, he might have
some kinda reason for
being late, but if he don't,
I've been saving a whole
six pack of kickass to open,
just for him. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[马库]
呃，他可能有什么理由迟到，但如果不是，我特意留了一整箱超棒的酒给他开。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, this thing is
Benkaistein's. I haven't
seen that guy in a long while.
Ah, so he gave it to you for me
to read? Alright, I owe him a
favor or two, so I oughta...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嘿，这东西是本凯斯坦的。
我好久没见那家伙了。
啊，所以他是让你给我读的？好吧，我欠他两个人情，所以我应该...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, me, Digotz and
Maku played this crazy flying
game. Basically, we make
these wings out of wood and
paper, jump off these hills
and try to fly. Dumb, I know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天，我、迪戈茨和马库玩了一种疯狂的飞行游戏。基本上，我们用木头和纸做翅膀，从山上跳下来尝试飞行。
很蠢，我知道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today it was my turn to
jump and flap my arms with
these fake, badly made wings.
It's not really a fun game when
I think about it. Boy, I hope
we don't do that again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天轮到我了，我挥舞着这些做工粗糙的假翅膀跳了下去。仔细想想，这游戏其实并不好玩。
天哪，希望我们别再玩这个了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What is he talking about?!
That game was real fun!
Yeah, I usually wore the
wings and Digotz always
wanted to wear them too.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
他在说什么？！
那个游戏真的很好玩！
对，我通常戴翅膀，迪戈茨也总想戴。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Maku, Digotz and me went
outside of town. Of course,
we didn't tell anyone or else
we'd get in trouble. It was
a really exciting day. But
then, we ran into a monster!^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363马库、迪戈茨和我偷偷溜出了镇子。当然，我们没告诉任何人，不然肯定会惹上麻烦。那天真的非常刺激。但后来，我们遇到了一只魔物！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363I wanted to run away but Maku
and Digotz wanted to beat it so
that we could become heroes.
Of course, we got hurt pretty
bad and the monster got away.
Boy, mom was not happy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363我想逃跑，但马库和迪戈茨想打败它，这样我们就能成为英雄了。结果我们受了很重的伤，魔物也逃走了。天哪，妈妈当时很不高兴...^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That's right! Back then,
the three of us weren't
afraid of anything! Of course,
Digotz got beat up the most.
But I gotta say, he was also
the most fearless of us.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
没错！那时候，我们三个什么都不怕！
当然，迪戈茨被打得最惨。
但我得说，他也是我们中最无畏的。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digot's been sick for three
days now. It's just a normal
cold and Maku keeps saying
it's Digotz's fault he got sick.^FFFFFF ^856363 But he's always asking me to
go visit him and see if he's okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363迪戈茨已经病了三天了。
只是普通的感冒，马库一直说是迪戈茨的错才让他生病的。^FFFFFF ^856363但他总是让我去探望他，看看他是否没事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Wh-what?! No, I wasn't
worried at all! That must
have been the time Digot
caught Clymonia. You know,
that, uh, horrible disease. No
one should have that one!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
什-什么？！不，我完全不担心！那肯定是迪戈茨感染克吕莫尼亚症的时候。
你知道，就是那个，呃，可怕的疾病。没人应该得那个！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Mom and dad keep telling
me not to hang out with Maku
anymore. Their reason is really
dumb, and I don't care if he is
poor. He's one of the best guys
that I'll ever know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363爸爸妈妈一直让我别再跟马库混在一起了。他们的理由真的很蠢，我才不在乎他穷不穷。他是我认识的最棒的人之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's family is really
rich and they don't want him
to see Maku anymore either.
But Digotz doesn't care.
I know he likes Maku a lot.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363迪戈茨家里很有钱，他们也不希望迪戈茨再跟马库来往了。但迪戈茨不在乎。我知道他很喜欢马库。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, the three of us
made an oath of brotherhood,
just like we read in the comic
book. We swore we'd always
be friends no matter what.
For always and for always.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦的日志]
^856363今天，我们三个像漫画书里那样，结下了兄弟之誓。我们发誓无论发生什么，永远都是朋友。永远，永远。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, that's true,
I guess, but people
change! Besides, we got
that idea from a comic book!
Well, if he apologizes first,
I guess I better forgive him.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嗯，那倒是真的，但人会变的！而且，我们的想法是从漫画书里学来的。好吧，如果他先道歉，我想我还是应该原谅他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good...
Because Digotz said
that he'll be coming
by in a few days.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好...
因为迪戈茨说他几天后会来。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What?! He's really coming
here? What for? It's too late
to patch things up! Still, I'd be
a real prick if I didn't see him. Alright, fine! I'll teach that guy
a lesson once he's here!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
什么？他真的要来？为了什么？
现在补救已经太晚了！
不过，如果我不见他，我才是个真正的混蛋。好吧，行！等他来了，我要给他点教训！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
And, um, gimme that
journal! I'm gonna read
more of it so I can make
fun of Digotz. Bwahahaha!
But yeah, um, thanks. Not
that I'm grateful or anything.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
还有，呃，把那本日志给我！我要多读点，好嘲笑迪戈茨。哇哈哈哈！
不过，呃，谢谢。不是说我很感激之类的。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
So, uh, I guess
I'll see you later.
Um, now I gotta get
ready for something.
^333333(But not to see Digotz!)^000000
scripts.translation:
[马库]
那，呃，我想我们改天再见吧。
嗯，我现在得去准备点事情了。
^333333(但不是去见迪戈茨！)^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I can't...
I can't even beat him up
all properly because of
all those freakin' guards!
Arrrrrrrgh! Man, where's
Benkaistein when I need him?
scripts.translation:
[马库]
我连...
我连好好揍他一顿都做不到，全怪那些该死的卫兵！
啊————！本凯斯坦，我找他的时候他人在哪啊？

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
It looks like Maku
is starting to rage
just a bit too much.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF哎呀...
看起来马库开始有点失控了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Gggrrrr...

[Maku]
GRAAAAAAAAH~!
Who the hell does he
think he is, telling me
all sorts of crap!? Digotz,
you're not getting away
with this! Gonna wreck you!!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嘎啊啊啊啊啊~！
他以为他是谁啊，对我指手画脚的？！迪戈茨，你别想就这么算了！
我要把你揍扁！！

scripts.text:
^3355FFMaku's seething quickly
explodes into pure, violent
rage. You manage to calm
him down after a while, but
barely keep yourself from
getting killed in this outburst.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF马库的怒火迅速爆发成纯粹的暴力狂怒。
你花了好一会儿才让他冷静下来，但你自己也差点被这阵爆发给弄死。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
^333333*Pant pant* *Whew~*^000000
D-don't worry, I've got
a grip on myself now.
Thanks for not letting me
get too crazy. Times like
this, I really miss ^FF0000Benkaistein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
^333333*喘气* *呼~*^000000
别、别担心，我现在已经控制住了。
谢谢你没让我彻底发疯。这种时候，我真想念^FF0000本凯斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Benkaistein would always
make sure that I'd stay out
of fights. I really miss that
guy. Still, he ain't around...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
本凯斯坦总是能确保我不惹事。
我真的很想念那个人。不过，他不在...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Damn those guards!
If they weren't there,
I could just go over and
kick Digotz's ass! I swear,
if it weren't for them...!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
该死的卫兵！
要不是有他们在，我早就冲过去把迪戈茨揍得满地找牙了！
我发誓，要不是因为他们...！

scripts.text: Speaking of which...
scripts.translation: 说到这个...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Speaking of which...
I spoke to Digotz again.
He told me to give you a
message, but I'm not sure th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
说到这个...
我又和迪戈茨谈了一次。
他让我给你带个口信，但我不确定他——

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That no-good bastard
has a message for me?!
Oh, I'm soooo honored~
Tell me what that fink
has to say, line by line!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
那个混蛋居然有口信给我？！
哎呀，真是受宠若惊~
告诉我那个无赖说了什么，一字不漏地！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Hopeless bastard?!''
Well, at least he had
the stomach to say that.
Through somebody else
anyway! What else'd he say?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
“没救的混蛋？！”
哼，至少他还有胆量说出来。
虽然是借别人的嘴！
他还说了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Stubborn jerk?!''
Takes one to know one,
bastard! Why I oughta--
Grrr! What'd he say next?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
“固执的蠢货？！”
物以类聚，混蛋！我本该——
哼！他接着说了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Three lunches?!
I treated that guy to
lunch, like, fifteen times!
I tell you, the guy does not
know the meaning of friendship!
What else did that moron say?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
三次午餐？！
我请那个家伙吃了大概十五次午餐！
我告诉你，这家伙根本不懂什么是友谊！
那个白痴还说了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Me, apologize?!
He should be on his hands
and knees begging for my
frickin' forgiveness! That...
That selfish no-good stupid...
W-what else did he tell you?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
我，道歉？！
应该是他跪在地上乞求我的原谅才对！
那个...
那个自私的、该死的、愚蠢的...
他、他还跟你说了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Who cares what I think?!''
GRRRAAAH~!! Who cares
what he thinks!! ^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
I'm gonna murderlize that
dumb creep! He can't possibly
make me angrier than I am now!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
“谁在乎我怎么想？！”
嘎啊啊啊~！！
谁在乎他怎么想啊！！^333333*喘气*^000000
我要把那个蠢货杀了！他不可能让我比现在更生气了！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That's it.
It's decided. The
next time I see Digotz,
I'm gonna plaster his
face all over the floor.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
就这样。
决定了。下次见到迪戈茨，我要把他的脸狠狠拍在地上。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Wha...? I dunno if Digotz
would say something like
that. You sure you heard
him carefully enough? It's
been a while, but I know
how Digotz talks, man.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
什...？我不确定迪戈茨会说那种话。
你确定你听清楚了吗？
虽然已经很久没见了，但我还是知道迪戈茨怎么说话的，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Don't get me wrong, I don't
miss the guy or anything like
that and I don't feel sorry about
what happened. But if he ever
came to apologize to me, I'd
probably accept, you know.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
别误会，我并不是想念那个家伙之类的，我也对发生的事不觉得抱歉。但如果他真的来向我道歉，我大概会接受的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, after thinking
about it, of course.
I mean, I'm not the one
holding a grudge. It's all
that guy's fault! Sheeeesh!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
嗯，想清楚之后，当然是这样了。
毕竟，我才是那个没有记仇的人。都是那个家伙的错！真是的！

scripts.text: I actually met Digotz and...
scripts.translation: 我其实见过迪戈茨，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
You what...?!
You saw my old pal,
Digotz?! Er, I mean,
Mister Alexander Digotz,
who usedta be my buddy,
but obviously not anymore.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
你什么...？！
你见到我以前的哥们儿，迪戈茨了？！呃，我是说，亚历山大·迪戈茨先生，他以前是我的好朋友，但显然现在不是了。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Sure, we were real close
at one time, but that was
too long ago. It's been a
long time since we hung
out and he probably hates
my penniless guts and...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
没错，我们以前确实很亲密，但那都是很久以前的事了。我们已经很久没一起玩了，他大概很讨厌我这个穷光蛋，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Crud, just listen to
me, I sound like a wuss.
I don't miss Digotz! In fact,
I hate the guy, one hundred
percent! The next time I see
him, I'll beat him to a pulp!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
该死，听听我说的话，我像个胆小鬼一样。
我才不怀念迪戈茨！事实上，我百分之百讨厌那个家伙！下次见到他，我要把他揍得满地找牙！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I don't know if you know,
but actually, the people who
live here ain't allowed to
explore this whole city. It's
kind of taboo to talk about,
but what do I care, right?
scripts.translation:
[马库]
我不知道你知不知道，但住在这里的人其实是不允许探索整座城市的。谈论这件事有点禁忌，但我才不在乎呢，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Yeah, basically the rich
people here are too afraid
of the poor people comin' to
see them, so the security in
this city is pretty tight! Those
upper class guys are trash...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
是的，基本上这里的富人太害怕穷人来找他们了，所以这座城市的安保非常严密！那些上层阶级的人真是垃圾...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I didn't used to think
this way. I actually used
to have a pretty rich friend
till I found out he's not all
I thought he was. That
moron! Why's he like that?!
scripts.translation:
[马库]
我以前不是这样想的。我其实曾经有一个挺有钱的朋友，直到我发现他并不是我以为的那样。那个蠢货！他为什么那样？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Eh, forget about it.
Why am I even talking
about my personal life
to someone I just met
anyway? Sure, we all
do it, but still...
scripts.translation:
[马库]
呃，算了。
我为什么要把我的私生活告诉一个刚认识的人呢？
虽然大家都会这样做，但还是...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, when you get
bored of the ghetto,
you really oughta check
out the rich section of town.
I'm bitter, but I'll also admit
it's way nicer than this place.
scripts.translation:
[马库]
好吧，当你厌倦了贫民窟，你真的应该去看看富人区。
我虽然很嫉妒，但我也承认那里比这里好多了。

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
This is a study area where
you're not supposed to speak,
walk or even breathe loudly.
Still, students like Benkaistein can tune out the whole world
when they study hard enough...
scripts.translation:
[乔伊·乔里]
这是一个学习区，你不应该大声说话、走动，甚至大声呼吸。
不过，像本凯斯坦这样的学生，只要足够努力，就能屏蔽整个世界...

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
Benkaistein...?
He's in the north part
of this room. He's a real
nice guy, but a little anal.
Well, he's too organized
and he labels everything!
scripts.translation:
[乔伊·乔里]
本凯斯坦...？
他在这间教室的北边。他人很好，但有点强迫症。
嗯，他太有条理了，而且给一切都贴标签！

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
Property damage. Huh.
It has to do with lightning
and fire and water and stuff
like that? Here I thought it
meant, I dunno, buildings
getting wrecked or something.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊·乔里]
财产损坏。嗯。
这跟闪电、火、水之类的有关？
我还以为是指建筑物被毁之类的呢。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Were you able to bring
my journal to Digotz and
Maku? I'm pretty sure it'd
remind them of all the good
times we had. I know they
sure can be stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
你能把我的日记带给迪戈茨和马库吗？
我确信那会让他们想起我们在一起的美好时光。
我知道他们可能很固执...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, I really
appreciate all your
help. When I go back
home, I look forward to
seeing the two of them again.
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
总之，我非常感谢你的帮助。
等我回家，我很期待再次见到他们两个。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Until then, I need to research,
finish my thesis and accomplish
my academic goals. Oh, please
take this pass which will let you
go back and forth between the
rich and poor areas as my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
在那之前，我需要研究、完成我的论文并实现我的学术目标。
哦，请收下这张通行证，它可以让你在富人和穷人区之间自由往返，作为我的感谢。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, I wish you
safety in your travels,
adventurer. When the three
of us get together, I'll be
sure to let you know~
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
总之，祝你在旅途中平安，冒险者。
当我们三个聚在一起时，我一定会告诉你的~

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Aw nuts, this is
taking much longer
than I had expected.
Now where did I put
that thing? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
哎呀，这花的时间比我预期的要长得多。
我把那个东西放哪儿了？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, is that it?
Did you find my
journal? Quick, let
me check. Yes, yes...
This is it! Thank you
for finding this for me!
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
哦，是这个吗？
你找到我的日记了吗？快，让我检查一下。
是的，是的...
就是这个！谢谢你帮我找到这个！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Would you mind doing
a favor for me? It'd be
better if I talk to them
myself, but I'm too busy
working on this thesis...
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
你介意帮我一个忙吗？
最好是我亲自跟他们谈，但我现在太忙于写论文了...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Would you please give this
journal to Digotz and Maku?
I wrote in it when we were
really young, so it should
remind them of all the good
times we used to share.
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
请帮我把这本日记交给迪戈茨和马库好吗？
这是我们小时候写的，应该能让他们想起我们曾经一起度过的美好时光。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, this should at
least help them realize
how stupid they've been
acting. Thanks in advance,
and please take care of
Maku and Digotz for me.
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
总之，这至少能让他们意识到自己现在的行为有多愚蠢。
提前谢谢你了，也请帮我照顾好马库和迪戈茨。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Aw nuts, this is
taking much longer
than I had expected.
Now where did I put
that thing? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
哎呀，这花的时间比我预期的要长得多。
我把那个东西放哪儿了？嗯...

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps it would
be best if you help
Benkaistein look for
he is searching for.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF也许最好帮本凯斯坦找找他在找的东西。^000000

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Oh, you startled me!
Still, I'm aware that it's
hard to get my attention
once I immerse myself
in a book. So, how can
I help you, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
哎呀，吓我一跳！
不过我知道，一旦沉浸在书里就很难注意到别人。那么，冒险者，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Tell him about Maku and Digotz.
scripts.translation: 告诉他关于马库和迪戈茨的事

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, how are my friends
doing? Oh, what? They're
having a huge fight just
because one's rich and
the other one's poor?
That's pretty childish!
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
哦，我的朋友们最近怎么样？哦？他们因为一个有钱一个没钱就在大吵大闹？
这也太幼稚了！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
But then again, that's just
like them. *Sigh* I really want
to go back home and get those
two to make up, but I also need
to finish this thesis. Let's see... What can I possibly do from here?
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
不过话说回来，他们就是这样的人。*叹气* 我真想回家让他们和好，但我还得完成这篇论文。
让我想想...我现在能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, I know what I can do!
Wait, but where did I put it?
Oh, how could I lose something
so important? Wait! Would you
please wait a second while
I look for something?
scripts.translation:
[本凯斯坦]
哦，我知道该做什么了！
等等，我把它放哪儿了？
我怎么会把这么重要的东西弄丢呢？等等！请等一下，让我找找东西。

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Let's see, now.
Wind Magic, Black Magic,
Porings, ah, there it is.
Monster race properties.
Hopefully this contains
the information I need...
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
让我看看。
风魔法，黑魔法，波利，啊，在这里。
魔物种族特性。
希望这里面有我需要的信息...

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon briefly glancing at
this student's belongings,
you notice that the name
''Benkaistein'' is printed
on them. This is the friend
mentioned by Maku and Digotz!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你粗略地看了看这个学生的物品，发现上面印着“本凯斯坦”的名字。
这就是马库和迪戈茨提到的那位朋友！^000000

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
Benkaistein?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下...
本凯斯坦？

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
...The world of humans
and the world of demons,
yes, yes... No, what I'm
looking for is a reference
to the heavens or Asgard.
Hmm, this here might help...
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
...人类的世界和恶魔的世界，是的，是的...
不，我要找的是关于天堂或阿斯加德的记载。
嗯，这个可能有用...

scripts.text: Hey...

[{0}]
Hey...
Over here.
Benkaistein!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...
这边。
本凯斯坦！

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
...Oh, now that's a very
interesting observation.
If I can incorporate that
into my thesis without too
much trouble, my standpoint
would look much more solid...
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
...哦，这是一个非常有趣的观察。
如果我能不费太多力气把它融入我的论文，我的论点就会看起来更扎实...

scripts.text: HEY YOU...!

[{0}]
HEY YOU...!
BENKAISTEIN~!

[Passionate Student]
Oh, good heavens!
C-can't you keep
your voice down?
I-I'm trying to study!
No, wait. Have you been
calling me all this time?
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
哦，天哪！
你...你能不能小声点？
我...我在做研究！
等等。你刚才一直在叫我吗？

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Let's see, now.
Wind Magic, Black Magic,
Porings, ah, there it is.
Monster race properties.
Hopefully this contains
the information I need...
scripts.translation:
[热情的学生]
让我看看。
风魔法，黑魔法，波利，啊，在这里。
魔物种族特性。
希望这里面有我需要的信息...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis student seems to
be dilligently conducting
intensive research on some
academic subject. For now,
it would be best to leave him
alone so that he can study.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个学生似乎正在专心致志地进行某项学术研究。
目前，最好让他一个人安静地学习。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing
over here that you
really need anymore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里没有什么你真正需要的东西了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis book is labeled,
''Benkaistein's Journal
Vol. 6.'' This is probably
what Benkaistein was trying
to find, so it might be best to
bring this and show it to him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这本书的标签上写着
“本凯斯坦的日志第6卷”。这大概就是本凯斯坦一直在寻找的东西，最好把它带给他看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing of
any real interest
over here for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里暂时没有什么特别有趣的东西。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？？]
我...
我憎恨活着的人。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？？]
我...
我憎恨活着的人。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？？]
我...
我憎恨活着的人。

scripts.text:
[?????]
Honey, I'm sorry,
but I... We know how
hungry you are, but we
have nothing to feed you.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
亲爱的，对不起，但是...我们知道你很饿，可是我们没有东西给你吃。

scripts.text:
[?????]
*Sniff* I know, I know,
but somehow, that tragic
truth eats away at me just
a little bit more everyday...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
*吸鼻子* 我知道，我知道，但不知为何，那个悲惨的事实让我每天都更加痛苦...

scripts.text:
[?????]
D-damn it...!
Why do we have
to live like this?!
It's like we're less
than animals. I hate this!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
该死...！
为什么我们要过这种日子？！
简直比动物还不如。我恨透了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those voices weren't
just in my head, were they?
Hello...? Anybody there...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些声音不只是在我脑海里，对吧？
你好...？有人在吗...？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey, you won't
believe it! Rekenber
decided to hire us!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
嘿，你绝对不敢相信！雷根贝勒决定雇用我们了！

scripts.text:
[???????]
You sure that's so great?
Those big corporations
always take advantage
of the little guy. We're
probably gonna end up
slavin' away for our wages...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？？？]
你确定那是好事吗？
那些大公司总是欺负小人物。我们大概又要为了工资拼命干活了...

scripts.text:
[?????]
No, that's not the
case at all. I mean,
sure, we won't start off
with much responsibility,
but they'll pay us well!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
不，完全不是那样。我是说，当然，我们一开始不会承担很多责任，但他们给的薪水很高！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Well, we do need to eat.
If they're true to their word,
that'll be even better!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
嗯，我们确实需要吃饭。
如果他们说到做到，那就更好了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Waaaah!
Waaaaaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
哇啊啊！
哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[????]
Woman, shut this
baby up! Shut up, kid!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
女人，把这个婴儿弄安静点！闭嘴，小孩！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Honey, please...
He's just a baby!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
亲爱的，求你了...
他只是个婴儿！

scripts.text:
[????]
I don't care how
crummy this house is!
It's mine and I want quiet!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
我才不管这房子有多破！
这是我的房子，我要安静！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm hearing things
again! Where are all of
these voices coming from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我又听到声音了！
这些声音都是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Mommy, why don't those
dirty people get new clothes?
Don't they know it's gross?
They're scaring me...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
妈妈，为什么那些脏兮兮的人不穿新衣服？
他们难道不知道那样很恶心吗？
他们吓到我了...

scripts.text:
[???????]
Honey, don't look at
them and hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？？？]
亲爱的，别看着他们，快点走！

scripts.text:
[????]
Please, do you have
any spare change? I...
I need something to eat...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
请...请问您有零钱吗？我...
我需要买点吃的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is...
This is insane!
I must be hallucinating!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...这太疯狂了！
我一定是产生幻觉了！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Listen, I know you're
the newest hire, but you've
shown us a lot of potential.
I think you'd be a perfect
fit for this new position.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
听着，虽然你是新来的，但你展现出了很大的潜力。
我觉得你非常适合这个新职位。

scripts.text:
[???????]
Are you really serious?

[?????]
I'll tell it to you straight.
This new position will require
you to be away from home once
in a while, but that comes with
the new responsibilities.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
我直说了吧。
这个新职位偶尔需要你离家，但这伴随着新的职责。

scripts.text:
[?????]
But you'll receive
many new benefits that
I'm sure your family would
appreciate and you'll be
generously compensated.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
但你会获得许多新的福利，我相信你的家人会很高兴，而且你会得到丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text:
[???????]
...Alright, I'm in.

[?????]
So, what exactly did you
want me to do? I'm sorry,
I wasn't able to gather my
actual job function from
the presentation...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
那么，你具体想让我做什么？
抱歉，我在介绍会上没能搞清楚我的具体职责...

scripts.text:
[???]
Hee hee hee~
Don't worry about it.
Just relax and stay
right where you are.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
呵呵呵~
别担心。
就放松地待在原地吧。

scripts.text:
[?????]
Mmm. Alright.
I just thought that I was
supposed to go somewhere,
that's all. Um, shouldn't
I be getting ready...?
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
嗯。好的。
我只是以为我该去某个地方，仅此而已。嗯，我不该准备一下...？

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, don't worry about
that, either. All of the
arrangements will be
taken care of. You'll
be taken to that far
off place very soon...
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
哦，那个也不用担心。
所有安排都会处理好的。
你很快就会去那个遥远的地方...

scripts.text:
[????]
Oh, I'm so sorry to
hear that you want to
quit. Are you sure there
isn't anything we can do
to change your mind?
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
听到你想辞职，我很遗憾。你确定我们不能做点什么改变你的想法吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Well, I'm thinking of
retiring early and just
spending more time
with my family. But I won't
ever talk about the company
or any of its, well, secrets.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
嗯，我想提前退休，多陪陪家人。但我永远不会谈论公司或它的，嗯，秘密。

scripts.text:
[????]
I really appreciate
your honesty and sincerity.
You've really done a great
job for us and I can't thank
you enough for your years of
dedication to this company.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
我非常感激你的诚实和真诚。
你为我们做了很多，我无法感谢你对公司多年的奉献。

scripts.text:
[???]
Thank you, sir.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
谢谢您，先生。

scripts.text:
[????]
It would be a great loss
for this company to let you
go now. But I guess we have
no choice, since you've had
that horrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
现在让你离开对公司是个巨大的损失。但我想我们别无选择，既然你遭遇了那场可怕的事故。

scripts.text:
[???]
Sir...?
Accident...?
I don't understand
what you're talking ab--
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
先生...？
事故...？
我不明白你在说什么--

scripts.text:
[???]
N-no! Please...!
I didn't, I swear on
my life that I won't ever
say anything about this
place! I'm begging you,
for the love of god!
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
不！求求你...！
我没有，我发誓我永远不会说这个地方的任何事！
我求求你，看在神明的份上！

scripts.text:
[????]
Your life...?
Sorry, not good enough.
You should have known.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
你的命...？
抱歉，这不够。
你早该知道的。

scripts.text:
[???]
Ssstop! I have chil--
MY LEEEEGS!! OH MY GOD
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO
MY LEGS?! HELP ME, OH MY G--
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
住手！我有孩--
我的腿！！天哪你们对我的腿做了什么？！
救救我，天哪--

scripts.text:
[??]
Doctor Varmunt,
you've finally agreed
to join us. Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[？？]
瓦尔蒙特博士，你终于同意加入我们了。欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Well, I don't know if I agree
with this company's policies,
but the project you're offering
seems to be an opportunity that
comes once in a lifetime, so...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
嗯，我不确定我是否认同这家公司的政策，但你们提供的项目似乎是一生难遇的机会，所以...

scripts.text:
[??]
To be honest, this project
can only be a success with
your cooperation. We need
your genius and will provide
whatever you require.
scripts.translation:
[？？]
说实话，这个项目只有靠你的合作才能成功。
我们需要你的天才，并且会提供你所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
I'm flattered.
And of course, I'll
do my best. It's just
that this deal sounds
too good to be true...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我很荣幸。
当然，我会尽力而为。
只是这交易听起来好得让人难以置信...

scripts.text:
[??]
Amazing. You've accomplished
what most have thought to be
impossible ahead of schedule.
An imitation of Ymir's Heart!
This will surely spur Airship
and Guardian development~!
scripts.translation:
[？？]
太棒了。你提前完成了大多数人认为不可能的事。
依美乐的心脏的仿制品！
这肯定会推动飞空艇和守卫的开发~！

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
I still don't believe that
were able to do it. This is
a huge leap for science, even
if this imitation isn't as powerful as the real Ymir's Heart.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我仍然不敢相信我们做到了。这对科学来说是一个巨大的飞跃，即使这个仿制品不如真正的依美乐的心脏强大。

scripts.text:
[??]
Come, we must celebrate!
Let's go outside and have
a toast in your honor! Ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[？？]
来吧，我们必须庆祝！
让我们出去为你干一杯吧！哈哈~

scripts.text:
[??]
But why, Doctor Varmunt?
If you're unhappy with the
Rekenber Corporation for
any reason whatsoever...
scripts.translation:
[？？]
但是为什么，瓦尔蒙特博士？
如果你因为任何原因对雷根贝勒公司不满意...

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Well, I don't really
have a reason to remain
now that we've accomplished
what I've agreed to do. It's time for me to return and work on
my personal research.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
嗯，既然我们已经完成了我答应要做的事，我现在没有理由留在这里了。
是时候回去进行我的个人研究了。

scripts.text:
[??]
Please, Doctor Varmunt,
reconsider! You may have
full use of our facilities to
conduct your research. I'm
willing to make you an offer.
scripts.translation:
[？？]
请，瓦尔蒙特博士，再考虑一下！你可以完全使用我们的设施进行研究。我愿意给你一个报价。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
No, I can't...
If I continue to work
here, I'm afraid I might
make a lot of people
unhappy. But, thank
you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
不，我不能...
如果我继续在这里工作，我恐怕会让很多人不高兴。但是，谢谢你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[??]
Wait...
Doctor Varmunt.
You forgot your cane.
scripts.translation:
[？？]
等等...
瓦尔蒙特博士。
你忘了你的拐杖。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Since when have you
seen me use a cane?
And even if I did,
that one isn't mi--
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
你什么时候见过我用拐杖？
即使我用了，那根也不是我的--

you've finally agreed

scripts.translation: 瓦尔蒙特博士，你终于答应加入我们了。欢迎！

[??]
Wait...
Doctor Varmunt.
You forgot your cane.
scripts.translation:
[？？]
等等...
瓦尔蒙特博士。
你忘了你的拐杖。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Since when have you
seen me use a cane?
And even if I did,
that one isn't mi--
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
你什么时候见过我用拐杖？
即使我用了，那根也不是我的--

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something on
the floor, but you can't
really take a good look at
what it is right now. Perhaps
if you freed up more space
in your inventory...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上有东西，但现在看不清是什么。
也许腾出更多背包空间就能看清了...

scripts.text:
[???]
It's over.
I really want
to quit. This is
the end for me.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
结束了。
我真的想辞职。
这就是我的终点了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
^3131FFThis is the end!
This is the end!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟]
^3131FF结束了！
结束了！^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
He was right to say that
we'd be paid well, but going
through this much torture isn't
worth any sum of money in the
world to me. *Sigh* Money...
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
他说我们会得到丰厚的报酬，但经历这么多折磨，世界上没有任何金钱能弥补。*叹气* 金钱...

scripts.text:
[???]
She must be so worried
about me by now. And her
health is so bad. I'm such
a fool for leaving her behind.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
她现在一定很担心我。
而且她的身体很不好。
我真是个傻瓜，把她一个人留在那儿。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
Such a fool!
Such a fool!
*Squaaawk~*
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟]
傻瓜！
傻瓜！
*嘎——*

scripts.text:
[???]
Damn it!
Shut up, you stupid bird!
Be quiet for just a minute!
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
该死！
闭嘴，你这蠢鸟！
安静一分钟！

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
*Squaaaawk!*
Death Penalty!
Death Penalty!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟]
*嘎——！*
死刑！
死刑！

scripts.text:
[???]
Death penalty?
Where'd you learn
to say something weird
like that? Huh. That's...
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
死刑？
你从哪儿学会说这种奇怪的话？
嗯。那是...

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm the only one still
in this room. Everyone
else left and never came
back. If they were... And
I were to go out... Then...
Maybe I better not leave.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
我是这个房间里唯一还留着的人。
其他人都离开了，再也没有回来。如果他们... 
如果我出去... 那么...
也许我最好不要离开。

scripts.text:
[???]
If I could only give
this pendant back to
her, she wouldn't have
to worry about me that
much. But I might not
be able to get back...
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
如果我能把这个吊坠还给她，她就不会那么担心我了。
但我可能回不去了...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey there, been
waiting long? It's
time for you to finish
up your contract.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
嘿，等了很久吧？
是时候结束你的契约了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Finish up my...?
N-no! I've decided!
I'm not leaving this room!
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
结束我的...？
不！我决定了！
我不离开这个房间！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey hey, what the hell
are you talking about?
You came here to work,
didn't you? And now it's
time for you to collect, so...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
嘿，你在说什么呢？
你来这里是为了工作，不是吗？现在是时候领取报酬了，所以...

scripts.text:
[???]
N-no, l-let go of me!
Please let me go!
I want to see her again,
please let me see her...!
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
不，放开我！
请放开我！
我想再见她一面，请让我见她...！

scripts.text:
[??]
Hm? Who the hell
brought in this cheap
jewery? Someone must
have forgotten to throw
away their trash...
scripts.translation:
[？？]
嗯？谁把这种廉价的首饰带进来了？
一定是有人忘了扔掉垃圾...

scripts.text:
[????]
Yeah, it's just a
cheap trinket. That
pendant isn't even
worth picking up.
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
是啊，只是个廉价的小玩意。
那个吊坠甚至不值得捡起来。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou pick up an old
pendant from the ground.
No matter how hard you try,
you can't open its clasp to see
what this pendant contains.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF你从地上捡起一个旧吊坠。
无论怎么尝试，都无法打开它的扣环，看看里面藏着什么。^000000

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟]
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟]
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
No wonder you look
so weary. Come, let
me help relieve you
of the burden that
you are carrying.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
难怪你看起来如此疲惫。过来，让我帮你卸下你背负的重担。

scripts.text: Um, burden...?
Crazy old woman!
scripts.translation: 疯老太婆！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Ah yes, they may not
be apparent to you, but
my eyes can clearly see
them. Yes. You're being
followed by those things.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
啊，是的，也许你自己察觉不到，但我的眼睛能清楚地看到它们。
是的。那些东西正在跟着你。

scripts.text: Things?
scripts.translation: 东西？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yes. The best way I can
describe them is as evil
thoughts left in the world
when someone dies in
such a way that his grudge
survives to menace the living.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
是的。我能想到的最好的描述是：
当一个人以某种方式死去，其怨恨得以留存并威胁活人时，留在世间的邪恶念头。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Sometimes, these lingering
thoughts are created when
someone is broken hearted
or clings to this plane for the
sake of a loved one. Yes, those
thoughts are following you.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
有时候，这些残留的念头是在某人伤心欲绝，或为了所爱之人而眷恋此世时产生的。
是的，那些念头正在跟着你。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I don't know why they
are following you, but I'm
certain they're there. Have
you been experiencing chills
down your spine, cold sweats,
maybe even hearing voices?
scripts.translation:
[长老]
我不知道它们为什么跟着你，但我确信它们在那里。
你有没有感到脊背发凉、冷汗直流，甚至听到声音？

scripts.text: Yes! How do I get rid of them?
scripts.translation: 有！我该怎么摆脱它们？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, usually these lingering
thoughts have some sort of
physical anchor, an object
that has feelings attached
to it, something important
to its late owner.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
嗯，通常这些残留的念头会有某种物理锚点，一个附着了情感的物体，对其已故主人来说很重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
The rage they're directing
at you seems to be growing
and I can see the angry spirits
pulling at the hems of your
clothes. Tell me, have you
wronged anyone recently?!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
它们对你发出的愤怒似乎在增长，我能看到愤怒的亡灵拉扯着你衣服的衣角。
告诉我，你最近有没有得罪过谁？！

scripts.text: I don't... think so.
scripts.translation: 我...不觉得有

scripts.text: I can't remember every bad thing I've done!
scripts.translation: 我记不清我做过每一件坏事！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, you better do
something soon, before
the evil taints your mind
and drives you to insanity!
Now, I need to know for sure
if you've been hearing voices.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
嗯，你最好快点做点什么，在邪恶侵蚀你的心灵，让你发疯之前！
现在，我需要确切知道你是否听到了声音。

scripts.text: Y-yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是...是的，我听到了

scripts.text:
[Elder]
There's still hope.
The spirits are trying
to reach you for now, but
if you wait too long, you may
become a victim of their wrath.
Hurry, there is much to do!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
还有希望。
亡灵们目前只是在试图接触你，但如果你等待太久，你可能会成为它们愤怒的受害者。
快一点，还有很多事要做！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
You must appease these
forces by finding out what
happened to them in life.
Now, I don't possess great
power, but I can encourage
the spirits to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
你必须通过查明它们生前的遭遇来平息这些力量。
现在，我并没有强大的力量，但我可以鼓励亡灵指引你。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I can only have the spirits
reveal the places they wish
for you to search only once.
You must remember the
locations that I am about
to show you. Get ready...
scripts.translation:
[长老]
我只能让亡灵向你揭示它们希望你搜索的地方一次。
你必须记住我即将展示给你的地点。
做好准备...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yaaaaappp ---!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
呀啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
There! The locations
you must search should
be clear to you now! Don't
forget these placemarks!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
好了！
你应该已经清楚需要搜索的地点了！
别忘了这些地标！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Good luck, youngster.
I hope you can appease
the wrath of these spirits...
But as long as you let them guide you, you ought to be safe.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
祝你好运，年轻人。
希望你能平息这些亡灵的怒火...
只要让它们指引你，你应该就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Crazy...? Hm, you must
not quite understand what's
happening to you. Please do
not hesitate to come back to
me when you realize that you
need my help, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
疯了...？嗯，你似乎还没完全明白正在发生什么。
当你意识到需要我的帮助时，请随时回来找我，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I'm sorry, but there's
nothing more I can do for
you right now. But if you
find anything related to the
spirits that torment you,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
很抱歉，我现在无能为力。
但如果你找到了任何与折磨你的亡灵有关的东西，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Greetings, adventurer.
How goes your search for
the remains of the spirits
that still cling to this plane?
scripts.translation:
[长老]
你好，冒险者。
你寻找那些仍滞留于现世的亡灵遗物的进展如何？

scripts.text: Show him the Pendant.
scripts.translation: 给他看吊坠

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Oh my... There are some
incredibly powerful emotions
clinging to this pendant. If we
don't do anything about this,
you'll be cursed very soon.
This is what you must do.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
天哪...这个吊坠上附着着极其强烈的情感。
如果我们不采取行动，你很快就会受到诅咒。
这是你必须做的事。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Hurry and bring
^3131FF5 Holy Water^000000 and
^3131FF1 Bouquet^000000. The Holy Water
will purify this Pendant and
the Bouquet will comfort
the spirit of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
快带
^3131FF5瓶圣水^000000和
^3131FF1个花束^000000来。圣水将净化这个吊坠，花束将抚慰它主人的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
You don't have much
time, so return to me
as soon as possible!
It won't be long until
the spirits are consumed
by their supernatural rage...
scripts.translation:
[长老]
你时间不多了，请尽快回来！
亡灵们很快就会被超自然的愤怒吞噬...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Greetings, adventurer.
How goes your search for
the remains of the spirits
that still cling to this plane?
scripts.translation:
[长老]
你好，冒险者。
你寻找那些仍滞留于现世的亡灵遗物的进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Wait...
Why do I sense
that you've found
something, but have
not brought it with you?
You must retrace your steps!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
等等...
为什么我感觉你找到了什么，却没有带在身上？
你必须重新检查一遍！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Good, good.
All is in readiness.
Please be silent as
I focus my spirit for the
great task before me.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
很好，很好。
一切准备就绪。
请保持安静，我要集中精神完成眼前的大任务。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yaaaaapp ---!
scripts.translation:
[长老]
呀啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Whew! I've managed
to nullify this curse for you.
That still doesn't change the
fact that what happened to this
pendant's owner was tragic...
scripts.translation:
[长老]
呼！我成功为你解除了这个诅咒。
但这并不改变吊坠主人遭遇悲剧的事实...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Why don't you bring
this pendant to the place
where it really belongs?
I'm sure that would bring
great comfort to its owner.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
你为什么不把这个吊坠带到它真正该去的地方？
我相信那会给它的主人带来巨大的慰藉。

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly, the clasp on
the pendant pops open,
revealing a picture of a happy
couple. Somehow, the girl in
the picture, sitting uncomfortably^FFFFFF^3355FF in an old chair, looks familiar...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF突然，吊坠的扣环弹开了，露出了一张幸福情侣的照片。
不知为何，照片中那个坐在旧椅子上、^FFFFFF^3355FF显得不太自在的女孩，看起来很眼熟...^000000

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Hurry and bring
^3131FF5 Holy Water^000000 and
^3131FF1 Bouquet^000000 in order
for me to nullify this
curse. Do not forget to
bring the Pendant as well.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
快带
^3131FF5瓶圣水^000000和
^3131FF1个花束^000000来，以便我解除这个诅咒。
别忘了带上吊坠。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Predators are always
on the lookout for easy
prey. Be careful, youngster!
You look innocent enough
to become a victim in the city.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
掠食者总是在寻找容易下手的目标。
小心点，年轻人！
你在城里看起来人畜无害，很容易成为受害者。

scripts.text: About Lighthalzen
scripts.translation: 关于里希塔乐镇

scripts.text: About the Slum
scripts.translation: 关于贫民窟

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Lighthalzen might seem
like a splendid city at first,
but you'll quickly learn that
the poor are segregated from
the rich and treated as less
than second class citizens.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
里希塔乐镇乍看之下可能是一座繁华的城市，但你很快就会了解到，穷人被迫与富人隔离，甚至被当作二等公民对待。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
At first, separation between
the rich and poor districts was
subtly enforced. They built the
railroad right between the two
districts to make it easier for
the rich to ignore the poor.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
起初，贫富区的隔离只是隐性的。
他们在两个区域之间修建了铁路，让富人更容易无视穷人的存在。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
But now they even have
guards to make sure that
the poor can't bother the
rich. I'm pretty sure that
this segregation won't be
ending anytime soon...
scripts.translation:
[长老]
但现在他们甚至派了卫兵，确保穷人不会打扰到富人。
我很确定，这种隔离状态短时间内不会结束...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Now, I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation is
actually providing jobs for
people in the slums. Beggars
can't be choosers, so I'm sure
these jobs aren't that great.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
我听说，雷根贝勒公司实际上正在为贫民窟的人提供工作。
乞丐们别无选择，所以我相信这些工作条件不会太好。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
To live in the slum is to
be familiar with poverty,
disease, condemnation
and contempt. But we're all
still people, you know, so let
go of any of your misgivings.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
生活在贫民窟，意味着要熟悉贫穷、疾病、指责和蔑视。但我们毕竟都是人，所以请放下你的顾虑吧。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
We're struggling just
to survive here. At the
very least, please respect
that. It's a fact that the
people in the rich district
seem to keep forgetting.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
我们在这里只是勉强求生。
至少，请尊重这一点。
这是富人区的人似乎总是忘记的事实。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, if you need any
help around here or have
any questions, come back
and ask me. I get the feeling
that we'll probably meet again.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
好了，如果你在这里需要任何帮助，或者有任何问题，随时回来找我。
我有种预感，我们还会再见的。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Predators are always
on the lookout for easy
prey. Be careful, youngster!
You look innocent enough
to become a victim in the city.
scripts.translation:
[长老]
掠食者总是在寻找容易下手的目标。
小心点，年轻人！
你在城里看起来人畜无害，很容易成为受害者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey there, are
you feeling alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你好，你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Oh, thanks,
I'm fine. But...
Have we met before?
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
哦，谢谢，我没事。但是...
我们以前见过吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, we did.
You should know who
I am by now. Hey, you
didn't forget, did you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我们见过。
你现在应该知道我是谁了。
嘿，你没忘记吧？

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, how do I put this?
The fever she had for the
last few days. She's gotten
better, but she's forgotten
everything that's happened
in the past few weeks...
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哎呀，该怎么说呢？
她前几天发高烧。
现在好多了，但她忘记了过去几周发生的所有事情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Oh. I'm so
sorry. But maybe this
is for the best? Here,
I think you should keep
this pendant, though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...哦。真抱歉。
但也许这样是最好的？
拿着，我觉得你应该保留这个吊坠。

scripts.text:
^3131ffYou place the
old pendant
into her hands.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131ff你将旧吊坠放入她的手中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Possessed {0}]
^3131FFSetsu, please remember
that I'd never do anything
to hurt you. Forgive me for
leaving you behind. I hope
that one day we'll meet
again, little princess.^000000
scripts.translation:
[被附身的{0}]
^3131FF雪，请记住，我绝不会做任何伤害你的事。
原谅我抛下你。我希望有一天我们能再次相遇，小公主。^000000

scripts.text:
[Possessed {0}]
^3131FFUntil then, I want
you to be happy, okay?
Your brother's always
gonna be looking out for
you, one way or another...^000000
scripts.translation:
[被附身的{0}]
^3131FF在那之前，我希望你能幸福，好吗？
你的哥哥会一直守护着你，无论以何种方式...^000000

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
My brother's...
That's my brother's
voice! Brother!
scripts.translation:
[雪]
我哥哥的...
那是我哥哥的声音！哥哥！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh? What? Whoa...
What came over me?
The last thing I reme--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃？什么？哇...
我刚才怎么了？
我最后记得的是--

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
This is awkward.

^3131ffThis would be a good

scripts.translation: ^3131ff现在是个好机会，可以把那个...给她。^000000

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
Excuse me, I can't still
walk but I don't cry
anymore. I'm doing my best!
scripts.translation:
[雪]
抱歉，虽然我还无法行走，但我不再哭了。
我正在努力！

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
...
......
*Sigh...*
Hello, how are you?
scripts.translation: 你好，最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Oh, I'm fine,
thanks for asking.
I'm just waiting for
somebody, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
哦，我很好，谢谢关心。
我只是在等一个人而已。

scripts.text: Show her the Pendant.
scripts.translation: 给她看吊坠

scripts.text: Okay, have a good day.
scripts.translation: 好的，祝你今天愉快

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Okay,
bye-bye...
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
好的，再见...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, would you have
any idea who might
have owned this pendant?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个，你知道这个吊坠可能是谁的吗？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Oh, that's mine!
I gave it to my big brother
before he went away on some
sort of business trip. You must
be his friend, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
哦，那是我的！
我哥哥出远门出差之前，我把它送给了他。
你一定是他的朋友，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, um,
you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，呃，你知道吗...

scripts.text: Brutal Truth
scripts.translation: 残酷的真相

scripts.text: Break it to her gently
scripts.translation: 委婉地告诉她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...So basically, your
brother's @lhz_ghost, oh right,
did I mention he was dead?
Anyway, so he's not alive
anymore, but his spirit or
whatever is still around and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...简单来说，你哥哥是@lhz_ghost，对了，我说过他已经死了吗？
总之，他不在人世了，但他的灵魂什么的还在附近徘徊--

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
...
......

[Crippled Girl]
...Dead?
No! I don't believe you!
He can't die! He was the
bravest and the sweetest
and the-- Leave me alone!
Oh god, get the hell away!
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
...死了？
不！我不信！
他不能死！他是最勇敢、最温柔的而且--别碰我！
天哪，滚开！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...
......
Sheesh.
Don't kill the
messenger.

[Crippled Girl]
Did you meet my
big brother...?
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
你见过我哥哥...？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
My brother is a strong
person, and I should be
happy of that, because
nothing could happen
to him.
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
我哥哥是个很强的人，我应该为此感到高兴，因为他什么事都不会发生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, your big brother must be happy.
He'll come back sometime.
You should sleep to be healthy
once your brother returns.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然，你哥哥一定很幸福。
他总有一天会回来的。
为了哥哥回来时身体健康，你应该好好睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Yes! I must be okay
and be able to walk when my
brother come.
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
是的！我必须没事，这样哥哥回来时我就能走路了。

[Possessed {0}]
^3131FFUntil then, I want
you to be happy, okay?
Your brother's always
gonna be looking out for
you, one way or another...^000000
scripts.translation:
[被附身的{0}]
^3131FF在那之前，我希望你能幸福，好吗？
你的哥哥会一直守护着你，无论以何种方式...^000000

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
My brother's...
That's my brother's
voice! Brother!
scripts.translation:
[雪]
我哥哥的...
那是我哥哥的声音！哥哥！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh? What? Whoa...
What came over me?
The last thing I reme--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃？什么？哇...
我刚才怎么了？
我最后记得的是--

scripts.text:
^FF0000Tears fall from the
girl's face, then you...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000泪水从女孩的脸上滑落，然后你...^000000

scripts.text: Distract her
scripts.translation: 转移她的注意力

scripts.text: Comfort her
scripts.translation: 安慰她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, all of this was a play...
Y-yes a play, I was practising.
Ha ha~ Is it okay, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，这一切都是演戏...
是...是的，我在练习。
哈哈~ 可以吗，是不是？

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
Oh, you surprised me!
Even though I didn't think
it was really my brother, you know?
scripts.translation:
[雪]
哎呀，吓我一跳！
虽然我觉得那真的不是我哥哥，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

[Setsu]
I'll do my best!
I must be okay when my brother return.
He'll be very proud of me.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[雪]
我会努力的！
哥哥回来时我必须没事。
他一定会为我感到骄傲的。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我确信。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Crying have no use!
You're a very pretty
girl to be ruining your
face with useless tears.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哭泣没有用！
你长得这么漂亮，却用无用的泪水毁容。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should do your best
to be healthy for the time
your big brother return.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为了哥哥回来时身体健康，你应该尽力保持健康。

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
Yes...

[{0}]
Listen, when your brother
return you'll celebrate in
a beautiful place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听着，哥哥回来时，我们要在一个美丽的地方庆祝。

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
Really?
It's a promise then! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[雪]
真的吗？
那就说定了！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hope it'll be soon!
When I return I want you to be
able to walk. See you soon, then!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我希望很快！
我回来时希望你能走路。
那我们很快再见！

scripts.text:
[Setsu]
I'll try hard!
scripts.translation:
[雪]
我会努力的！

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Did you meet my
big brother...?
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
你见过我哥哥...？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
My brother is a strong
person, and I should be
happy of that, because
nothing could happen
to him.
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
我哥哥是个很强的人，我应该为此感到高兴，因为他什么事都不会发生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, your big brother must be happy.
He'll come back sometime.
You should sleep to be healthy
once your brother returns.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然，你哥哥一定很幸福。
他总有一天会回来的。
为了哥哥回来时身体健康，你应该好好睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Yes! I must be okay
and be able to walk when my
brother come.
scripts.translation:
[腿脚不便的女孩]
是的！我必须没事，这样哥哥回来时我就能走路了。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000
^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

[Citizen]
I'm sorry, but another
epidemic is starting to
spread around the slums.
We're not going outside and we're keeping our children safe!
scripts.translation:
[市民]
很抱歉，但贫民窟里又开始流行新的传染病了。
我们不敢出门，必须保护孩子们的安全！

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Not to be unfriendly,
but you should be careful
too. The living conditions
of this area aren't exactly
sanitary, you know?
scripts.translation:
[市民]
不是故意不友好的，但你自己也要小心。
这一带的居住条件并不卫生，你知道吗？

scripts.text: *Shhhzzzzzzz!*

[{0}]
H-huh?!
What was that?
That can't be the
wind, I must be
hearing things again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？！
刚才那是什么？
不可能是风声，我一定是又幻听了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait. I thought I was
rid of those thoughts
or spirits, whatever was
haunting me before. Maybe
they still want me to do
something for them. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

也许它们还想让我为它们做点什么。嗯...

[{0}]
I get the feeling that
all of their suffering

Corporation^000000 and that

scripts.text: Corporation History
scripts.translation: 公司历史

scripts.text: Rekenber's Businesses
scripts.translation: 雷根贝勒的业务

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Rekenber was established
400 years ago, around the
same time as the foundation
of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根贝勒成立于400年前，大约与秀发兹发德共和国建国的时间相同。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We began as the ''Zent Zerter
Lighthal Research Center,''
named after our first chairman.
In 560 A.W. (After War), our
organization was renamed after
our new chairman, Mr. Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我们最初名为“森特·泽特莱特哈尔研究中心”，以我们的首任会长命名。
在战后560年，随着新任会长雷根贝勒先生的上任，组织也改名为雷根贝勒。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Mr. Rekenber expanded the
Corporation's purposes, but
also founded the Regenschirm
Laboratory to continue this
company's original goal of
scientific research.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根贝勒先生扩大了公司的业务范围，同时也建立了雷根席尔姆实验室，以延续公司最初科学研究的目标。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
In the year 700 A.W.,
^FF0000Doctor Varmunt^000000 joined
Regenschirm. It was his work
in science that enabled the
Rekenber Corporation to grow into the nation's biggest company.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
在战后700年，
^FF0000瓦尔蒙特博士^000000加入了雷根贝勒。正是他在科学领域的研究，使雷根贝勒公司成长为全国最大的企业。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
In addition to merchandising,
freight transport and trading,
the Rekenber Corporation is
also heavily involved with
providing the Airship service,
one of our major projects.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
除了商品销售、货运和贸易之外，雷根贝勒公司还深度参与飞空艇服务，这是我们的主要项目之一。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Rekenber is involved in
almost any business that
you can imagine. Remember
that Rekenber is the name
that you can trust.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根贝勒涉足几乎您能想到的所有行业。
请记住，雷根贝勒是您值得信赖的名字。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
If you'd like to know more
about our mission statement,
please refer to the Rekenber
Guidebook located to my side.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
如果您想了解更多关于我们的使命宣言，请查阅我身旁的
《雷根贝勒指南》。
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。
