scripts.text:
^3131FF#The Vision^000000
In the pursuit of knowledge,
Rekenber will search the
Rune-Midgarts continent for
ancient relics. We hope to make
significant scientific progress by learning the secrets of the past.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF#愿景^000000
在追求知识的道路上，雷根贝勒将在卢恩·米德加兹大陆搜寻古代遗迹。我们希望通过了解过去的秘密，取得重大的科学进步。

scripts.text:
By making scientific
headway, we hope we can
improve current technologies
to provide more convenient
and affordable services in
the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 通过科学上的进步，我们希望改进现有技术，在秀发兹发德共和国提供更便捷、更实惠的服务。

scripts.text:
^3131FF#The Commitment^000000
Although magic and the
power of the gods has always
maintained an aura of mystery
and superstition, Rekenber hopes^FFFFFF ^3131FF to understand these forces from
a more logical standpoint.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF#承诺^000000
尽管魔法和神的力量一直保持着神秘和迷信的色彩，雷根贝勒希望^FFFFFF ^3131FF从更理性的角度去理解这些力量。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Our goal is to make
the lives of our customers
easier and more enjoyable
by making the ancient power
of the gods more accessible
by means of new technologies.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000我们的目标是通过新技术使神的力量更易获取，从而让顾客的生活更轻松、更愉快。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
No one shall
interrupt my
research! If you
dare, I'll simply...
Eat you. Eat you alive.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
谁都不许打扰我的研究！
如果你敢的话，我就...
吃掉你。把你活活吃掉。

scripts.text: No... N-no!
scripts.translation: 不...不不！

scripts.text: Do you need any help?
scripts.translation: 需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Out of my sight,
microcephalic fool!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
滚出我的视线，小头蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Huh? You think I have
the luxury of remembering
the face of every part-timer
I've fired? Get lost, or I'll
treat you to the pain of
being eaten alive!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哈？你以为我有闲心记住每一个被我解雇的临时工的脸吗？
滚远点，不然我就让你尝尝被活活吃掉的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You again?!
What the hell do
you want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
又是你？！
你到底想从我这里得到什么？！

scripts.text: Let me speak with you.
scripts.translation: 让我和你对话

scripts.text: Sorry for bothering you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打扰你了

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I don't have time to
waste with drivel! I'm
too busy with my research!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我没时间听你胡扯！
我正忙着做研究呢！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah, but wait! I am collecting
something. Yes, bring me the
thing I must collect. Yes, yes.
Here's a hint... It's round...
Shiny... Kids love playing games with them! Oh, I said too much!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
啊，等等！我正在收集一些东西。
没错，把我需要收集的东西带给我。
是的，是的。
给你一个提示...它是圆的...
亮晶晶的...小孩们喜欢拿它们玩游戏！
哎呀，我说太多了！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
''Sorry?!'' Do you
think ''sorry'' will
get back that precious
minute I've lost yelling
at you?! Get the hell out!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
“抱歉”？！
你以为一句“抱歉”就能弥补我对你大吼大叫浪费的那宝贵一分钟吗？！
给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Yes...! Beads!
You brought them!
You're not as dumb
as I thought you'd be!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
是的...！玻璃珠！
你带来了！
你并没有我想象的那么蠢！

scripts.text: Why do you want Glass Beads?
scripts.translation: 你为什么想要玻璃珠？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
..................
I take that back!
You should know by
now that I would never
tell you why I neeeeed
these Beads. Bweh-heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
..................
我收回刚才的话！
你现在应该知道了，我绝不会告诉你我为什么需要这些玻璃珠。
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
This favor you've done
is worth a small chat and
I can spare a minute or two
for you inane questions. So
what is it you want to know?!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你帮了这个忙，值得我跟你聊几句。
我可以抽出几分钟回答你那些愚蠢的问题。
所以，你想知道什么？！

scripts.text: Ask about hobbies
scripts.translation: 询问爱好

scripts.text: Ask about work
scripts.translation: 询问工作

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Hyuu~ I think you're
just a little too innocent
to know about my secret
hobby. Yes, yes, I couldn't
tell you possibly, it'd be
so weird, so strange...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
呼呼~ 我觉得你太天真了，不可能知道我的秘密爱好。
是的，是的，我绝对不可能告诉你，那太奇怪了，太诡异了...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh. Oh no, oh no,
I couldn't possibly...
It's a-- I-It's a secret.
You wouldn't want to know
anyway. Bweh-heh-heh-heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哦。哦不，哦不，我绝对不可能...
这是一个-- 这是一个秘密。
反正你也不想知道。
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh, I don't know if you
can call it work. After all,
I do research whatever it is
I want. And they pay me to
do it! This is the best place
for a scientist like me, yes.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哦，我不知道你能不能称之为工作。
毕竟，我想研究什么就研究什么。
而且他们还付钱让我做！
这对像我这样的科学家来说是最好的地方，没错。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Now, in a perfect world,
my test subjects would be
much more cooperative, but
I suppose I cannot blame
them. Not that I cause them
undue suffering or anything...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
现在，在一个完美的世界里，我的实验对象应该会更配合一些，但我想我不能责怪他们。
毕竟我没有给他们造成过度的痛苦什么的...

scripts.text: What kind of research?
scripts.translation: 什么类型的研究？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Well, I couldn't tell you
exactly. But don't you
worry, the discovery I'm
working on will benefit the
entire world, you'll see.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嗯，我不能确切地告诉你。
但别担心，我正在进行的发现将会造福整个世界，你会看到的。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Let's just say that once
I'm successful, I'll satisfy
one of mankind's most primal
instincts, the desire to become
powerful and gain dominance
over those that are weaker.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
这么说吧，一旦我成功了，我将满足人类最原始的欲望之一，那就是变得强大，并支配那些弱者。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I haven't made as much
progress as I'd like, but
no matter. It's only a matter
of experimentation! Yes, to
make mankind stronger and
better and more powerful and--
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我的进展没有我预期的那么快，但这没关系。这只是实验的问题！没错，让人类变得更强大、更优秀、更强大，而且——

scripts.text: Um, what are you testing on?
scripts.translation: 呃，你在拿什么做实验？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
What do you know?
I better get back to
work if I wish to keep
on schedule. I can't afford
the leisure of speaking with
you any longer. Bweh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你懂什么？
如果我想保持进度，最好还是回去工作。我可没那么多闲工夫跟你聊天。嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I don't have time to
waste with drivel! I'm
too busy with my research!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我没时间听你胡扯！
我正忙着做研究呢！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah, but wait! I am collecting
something. Yes, bring me the
thing I must collect. Yes, yes.
Here's a hint... It's round...
Shiny... Kids love playing games with them! Oh, I said too much!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
啊，等等！我正在收集一些东西。
没错，把我需要收集的东西带给我。
是的，是的。
给你一个提示...它是圆的...
亮晶晶的...小孩们喜欢拿它们玩游戏！
哎呀，我说太多了！

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Excuse me, but you are
not allowed to be in here.
If you have questions regarding
the Rekenber Corporation, I can
direct you to someone qualified
to give you an answer.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
抱歉，您不能进入这里。
如果您有关于雷根贝勒公司的问题，我可以为您引荐一位有资格回答的人。

scripts.text: About the Slums
scripts.translation: 关于贫民窟

scripts.text: About Secretary Slierre
scripts.translation: 关于秘书苏埃伊

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
The slums? All I know
is that this corporation
specifically targeted that
area in order to provide ample
opportunity for employment.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
贫民窟？我只知道这家公司特意针对那个地区，以提供充足的就业机会。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm Sueii Slierre,
the personal secretary
for the chairman of the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我是苏埃伊·斯利埃尔，雷根贝勒公司会长的私人秘书。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Did you have something
else to ask? I can only
divulge information that is
public knowledge, but I can
tell you who to contact for
more specific inquiries.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
您还有其他问题吗？我只能透露公开的信息，但我可以告诉您该联系谁以获取更具体的咨询。

scripts.text: About the Laboratory
scripts.translation: 关于实验室

scripts.text: About the Corporation
scripts.translation: 关于公司

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Rekenber is perhaps the
biggest contributer of the
Regenschirm Laboratory.
Their work will benefit the
entire Midgard continent, hence our highly involved support.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
雷根贝勒或许是雷根席尔姆实验室最大的贡献者。
他们的工作将造福整个米德加尔特大陆，因此我们给予了高度支持。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
A representative at the
Help Desk will be happy
to assist you if you have
more inquiries regarding
the Regenschirm Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
如果您有关于雷根席尔姆实验室的更多疑问，服务台的代表很乐意为您提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm sorry, but I don't have
any special information
regarding our corporation.
Why don't you ask one of
our representatives at the
Help Desk to learn more?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
抱歉，我没有关于我们公司的特殊信息。
您不妨去问问服务台的代表，了解更多详情？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
You're back? I really
doubt that I can be of
any assistance to you.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
您回来了？我真的很怀疑我能为您提供任何帮助。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Research
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫的研究

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
.............!

[Sueii Slierre]
How do you know
Wolfchev? Are you an
acquaintance of his or...?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
您怎么认识沃尔夫切夫的？您是他的熟人，还是...

scripts.text: I'm a friend of his.
scripts.translation: 我是他的朋友

scripts.text: Oh, we're family, you know...
scripts.translation: 哦，我们是亲戚，您知道的...

scripts.text: I've heard about him before, so...
scripts.translation: 我之前听说过他，所以...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Well, Wolfchev is not
only brilliant, he's also
a respected professional.
He should be doing just fine.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
嗯，沃尔夫切夫不仅才华横溢，而且是一位受人尊敬的专家。
他应该过得很好。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Ah, you should be
very proud of Wolfchev.
In addition to being a
genius, Wolfchev is also
quite the professional,
truly a model scientist.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
啊，您应该为沃尔夫切夫感到骄傲。
除了是个天才，沃尔夫切夫还非常专业，真是一位模范科学家。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Ah yes, Wolfchev has
quite the reputation. In
fact, he's in such high
demand that Regenschirm
wants him on their staff.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
啊对了，沃尔夫切夫的名声很大。
事实上，他非常抢手，雷根席尔姆都想请他加入他们的团队。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Now if you'll excuse me,
I have many task to perform,
so please visit our Help Desk
if you have further inquiries.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
如果您不介意的话，我还有很多任务要处理，如果您还有疑问，请去我们的服务台咨询。

scripts.text: W-Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text: Alright, I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......

[Sueii Slierre]
Thank you for your
cooperation. As you well
know, the Help Desk is there
to answer any of your questions regarding the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
感谢您的配合。如您所知，服务台负责回答您关于雷根贝勒公司的任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm sorry, but please
understand that my office
isn't the place for visitors to
submit their general inquiries.
Please visit the Help Desk if
you have any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
很抱歉，请理解我的办公室不是访客提出一般性咨询的地方。
如果您还有任何问题，请去服务台咨询。

scripts.text: About Wolfchev's Research
scripts.translation: 关于沃尔夫切夫的研究

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I couldn't tell you any
more about Wolfchev.
But is there anything you
need to tell me about him?
Well, if you have something
to ask, be quick about it.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我无法告诉您更多关于沃尔夫切夫的事。
但是，有什么事需要我告诉他吗？
嗯，如果您有想问的，请快一点。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Past
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫的过去

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Test Subjects
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫的实验对象

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I remember hearing that he
received a high recommendation
to work here, but specifics elude me since I don't work in Human
Resources. There's a rumor that
he had a troubled love life...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我记得听说他得到了很高的推荐才来到这里，但具体细节我不清楚，因为我不在人力资源部工作。
有个传闻说他感情生活很坎坷...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
But aside from a few
rumors, we really don't
know much about Wolfchev's
personal life. But then again,
it may be unethical to pry too
much into our employee's lives.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
但除了几个传闻，我们真的不太了解沃尔夫切夫的私生活。
不过话说回来，过多打探员工的私生活可能是不道德的。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Wolfchev's test subjects?
Well, I know we have a policy
of using the most humane
methods depending on the
experiment. And of course, he should only be testing on animals.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
沃尔夫切夫的实验对象？
嗯，我知道我们有政策，根据实验情况使用最人道的方法。
当然，他应该只会在动物身上做实验。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's research is great!
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫的研究很棒！

scripts.text: His experiments are suspicious...
scripts.translation: 他的实验很可疑...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Yes, yes, I'd agree if
I understood science a
little bit better. Now, you'll
have to excuse me. I've been distracted long enough as it is...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
是的，是的，如果我更懂科学一点，我可能会同意。
现在，请原谅我。
我已经分心够久了...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
What exactly do you mean?
Are you sure that you haven't
misunderstood anything about
Wolfchev's work? You'll need
to illustrate your claim for us
to be on the same page...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
您具体是指什么？
您确定自己没有误解沃尔夫切夫的工作吗？
为了让我们达成共识，您需要提供具体的说明...

scripts.text: Show Evidence
scripts.translation: 出示证据

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou reveal the Handcuffs
you found in the laboratory,
and Secretary Slierre's face
is instantly shadowed by a
deeply troubled look.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿出了在实验室发现的犯人的手炼，秘书斯利埃尔的脸上瞬间笼罩上了一层深深的忧虑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......
What's Regenschirm up to?
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆在做什么？

scripts.text: What's Wolfchev up to?
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......

[Sueii Slierre]
So... You're
suspicious about
Wolfchev's research in
the Regenschirm Laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
所以...您怀疑沃尔夫切夫在雷根席尔姆实验室的研究？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Wait, what exactly
do you feel suspicious
about? Basically, which
party do you feel is most
at fault in this situation?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
等等，您具体对什么感到怀疑？
基本上，您认为在这个情况中，哪一方最应该负责？

scripts.text: Regenschirm
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆

scripts.text: Mr. Wolfchev
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫先生

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Let me assure you that
Regenschirm has a strict set
of protocals and procedures
to ensure safety and the
prevention of unnecessary
cruelty in experimentation.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
请让我向您保证，雷根席尔姆有一套严格的协议和程序，以确保安全并防止实验中出现不必要的不人道行为。

scripts.text: What about the creatures in Regenschirm?
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆里的生物呢？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Creatures? I would
guess that they're the
result of experimentation.
But I wouldn't know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
生物？我猜它们可能是实验的结果。
但我不能确定。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I can't be sure right
now, but this looks like
fairly concrete evidence.
We'll send some people over
to Regenschirm right away!
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我现在还不能确定，但这看起来是相当确凿的证据。
我们会立刻派人去雷根席尔姆！

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
For now, your claim
merits an investigation.
I'll let you know if we
find anything significant...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
目前，您的指控值得进行调查。
如果我们发现任何重要线索，我会通知您...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Evidence...?
I'm sorry, but you don't
seem to be carrying anything
that can be construed as proof.
I suggest you bring something that actually supports your claim.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
证据...？
很抱歉，您似乎没有携带任何可以作为证明的东西。
建议您携带一些真正支持您指控的物品。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
If you're finished,
I'd like to get back on
task. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
如果您说完了，我想继续工作。
请原谅我。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Hmm, have you come back
to address your claim about
Wolfchev's work? If you don't
have any evidence, then you
shouldn't be making rumors...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
嗯，您回来是为了处理关于沃尔夫切夫工作的指控吗？
如果您没有证据，就不应该散布谣言...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou reveal the Handcuffs
you found in the laboratory,
and Secretary Slierre's face
is instantly shadowed by a
deeply troubled look.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿出了在实验室发现的犯人的手炼，秘书斯利埃尔的脸上瞬间笼罩上了一层深深的忧虑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......
What's Regenschirm up to?
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆在做什么？

scripts.text: What's Wolfchev up to?
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......

[Sueii Slierre]
So... You're
suspicious about
Wolfchev's research in
the Regenschirm Laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
所以...您怀疑沃尔夫切夫在雷根席尔姆实验室的研究？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Wait, what exactly
do you feel suspicious
about? Basically, which
party do you feel is most
at fault in this situation?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
等等，您具体对什么感到怀疑？
基本上，您认为在这个情况中，哪一方最应该负责？

scripts.text: Regenschirm
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆

scripts.text: Mr. Wolfchev
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫先生

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Let me assure you that
Regenschirm has a strict set
of protocals and procedures
to ensure safety and the
prevention of unnecessary
cruelty in experimentation.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
请让我向您保证，雷根席尔姆有一套严格的协议和程序，以确保安全并防止实验中出现不必要的不人道行为。

scripts.text: What about the creatures in Regenschirm?
scripts.translation: 雷根席尔姆里的生物呢？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Creatures? I would
guess that they're the
result of experimentation.
But I wouldn't know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
生物？我猜它们可能是实验的结果。
但我不能确定。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I can't be sure right
now, but this looks like
fairly concrete evidence.
We'll send some people over
to Regenschirm right away!
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我现在还不能确定，但这看起来是相当确凿的证据。
我们会立刻派人去雷根席尔姆！

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
For now, your claim
merits an investigation.
I'll let you know if we
find anything significant...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
目前，您的指控值得进行调查。
如果我们发现任何重要线索，我会通知您...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Hmm. I can't consider
whatever you brought this
time as evidence that would
allay my doubts about your
claim. Now, if you'll excuse
me, I need to get back on task.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
嗯。我无法将您这次带来的东西视为能消除我疑虑的证据。
现在，请原谅我，我需要继续工作了。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh, I'd like to have
a word with you. Would
you please come back after
reducing the weight of the
items you are carrying please?
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
哦，我想和您说几句话。
请您在减轻携带物品的重量后再回来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh good, you're here.
You were right all along.
In our investigation, we found
that Wolfchev was conducting
unauthorized and very dangerous
research. I owe you our thanks.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
哦，太好了，您来了。
您一直是对的。
在我们的调查中，我们发现沃尔夫切夫正在进行未经授权且非常危险的研究。
我们要向您致谢。

scripts.text: What was he doing...?
scripts.translation: 他在做什么...？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
It turns out that Wolfchev
was kidnapping weak and sick
people from the slums and
using them as his guinea pigs.
Rest assured, he'll be punished
for his behavior, if not fired.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
原来沃尔夫切夫一直在从贫民窟绑架体弱多病的人，把他们当作实验品。
请放心，我们会对他的行为进行处罚，甚至可能将他解雇。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I think you deserve an
apology. Without your
report, our corporation's
reputation could have been
potentially damaged. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我觉得您应该得到一份道歉。
如果没有您的举报，我们公司的声誉可能会受到潜在损害。
谢谢您。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Yes, there's nothing so
taboo as trying to perform
Homunculus experiments
on people! Anyway, please
accept this as a token of
our gratitude, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
是的，没有什么比试图在人身上进行生命体实验更禁忌的了！
无论如何，请收下这份礼物，作为我们的一点心意，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Let me promise you
that Rekenber will ensure
that this kind of incident
will not be repeated and
we'll do everything in our
power to compensate for this...
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
我向您保证，雷根贝勒将确保此类事件不再发生，我们将竭尽全力进行补偿...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh, our investigation
of your claim is still in
progress. However, we
will let you know when any
new developments arise.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
哦，我们对您指控的调查仍在进行中。不过，一旦有新进展，我们会通知您。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm glad to know that
we have such proactive
and concerned customers
such as yourself to support
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
很高兴知道我们有像您这样积极主动且关心公司的顾客，支持雷根贝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Excuse me, but you are
not allowed to be in here.
Please visit the Help Desk
if you have any questions about
the Rekenber Corporation.
Thank you for cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[苏埃伊·斯利埃尔]
抱歉，您不允许进入这里。
如果您有关于雷根贝勒公司的问题，请前往服务台咨询。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
^3131FFThere's no trace of
that mad scientist. Only
his stacks of well organized
files remain here in the lab.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF那个疯狂科学家不见了。
只剩下他整理得井井有条的文件堆在实验室里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hello there~
Isn't Lighthalzen such
a wonder to behold with
all of its splendor and
magnificent beauty?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你好呀~
里希塔乐镇是不是充满了辉煌与壮丽，美得令人惊叹？

scripts.text: I guess.
scripts.translation: 我想是吧

scripts.text: Yes, it is.
scripts.translation: 是的，确实如此

scripts.text: Well, I don't know.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不知道

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Oh, and the weather is
so nice today, perfect
for a stroll in the park
or a lovely picnic. Ah~
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
哦，今天的天气真好，适合在公园散步，或者来一次愉快的野餐。啊~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Oh, I'm so glad you
agree. The people who
live here are so kind and
so happy, you can literally
feel everyone's gentle warmth.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
哦，很高兴你同意。
住在这里的人都很善良，也很幸福，你能真切地感受到每个人温和的温暖。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Well, maybe if you
don't see it right this
moment, I'm sure you'll
discover something to
love about this city soon.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
嗯，也许你现在还没看到，但我相信你很快会发现这座城市的可爱之处。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ha ha ha!
Anyway, I hope you
have a good day today~
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
哈哈！
总之，祝你今天过得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Yes, Lighthalzen
couldn't be perfecter.
Ahahahaha... But still...
Hm. Um. Oh, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
是的，里希塔乐镇完美无缺。
啊哈哈...不过...
嗯。呃。哦，算了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ha ha ha!
Anyway, I hope you
have a good day today~
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
哈哈！
总之，祝你今天过得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm? It's a little
cloudy today, isn't it?
It would be nice to stay
inside, listening to some
nice music while enjoying
a hot cup of tea, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
嗯？今天有点阴天，不是吗？
要是能待在屋里，听着美妙的音乐，再喝上一杯热茶，那该多好啊。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ahhh!
Such pleasant weather~
I'm so glad I'm outside
and enjoying the sunlight.
Feel it. It's so warm and
nice on your face, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
啊哈！
天气真好~
我很高兴能待在户外享受阳光。
感受一下，阳光照在脸上是不是很温暖舒适？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
The sun is gently
shining, the breeze is
gently blowing. Oh, this
weather could not be better!
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
阳光温柔地照耀着，微风轻柔地吹拂着。哦，这天气简直完美！

scripts.text: Yes, you're right.
scripts.translation: 是的，你说得对

scripts.text: Uh, what were you doing just now?
scripts.translation: 呃，你刚才在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Yes, right now is the
best time to be outside
and to enjoy all of this
fresh, wonderful air. Come,
take a deep breath with me.
Ooooh. Ahhhhhh~ Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
是的，现在正是走出户外，享受这清新美好空气的最佳时机。来，跟我一起深呼吸。
噢噢噢。啊哈~ 太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
...
......
I don't quite follow what
you're saying. I was merely
enjoying the sunny perfection
of Lighthalzen as usual...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
...
......
我不太明白你在说什么。我只是像往常一样，在享受里希塔乐镇完美的阳光而已...

scripts.text: But I heard you talking about something...
scripts.translation: 但我听到你在谈论什么...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
No! You must
have mistaken me
for somebody else!
Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
不！你一定是把我当成别人了！
好了，请原谅我失陪...

scripts.text:
^3355FFEven if it wasn't
Ghalstein that you
just heard, he reacted
pretty strongly to what
you said to him. Almost
as if he had something to hide... ^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF即使刚才听到的不是加尔斯坦，他对你的话反应也很强烈。
简直像是有什么事在隐瞒... ^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm? Judging from the
look on your face, you
apparently still believe
that I was involved in some
kind of clandestine meeting.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
嗯？看你的表情，你显然还认为我参与了某种秘密集会。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm sure of it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我确信！

scripts.text: Well...

[{0}]
Yes, I'm sure of it!
That was definitely you!
Your voice, your way of
speaking is unmistakable!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我确信！
那绝对是你！
你的声音，你的说话方式，我都认得出来！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Alright. Yes, it's
true that I did meet
someone in secret. But
what gives you the right
to interrogate me in this
rather aggressive fashion?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
好吧。是的，我确实秘密见过某人。
但你有什么权利用这种咄咄逼人的方式审问我？

scripts.text: I'm not interrogating...
scripts.translation: 我没有在审问...

scripts.text: Sorry about that.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，是我失言了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not interrogating
you. No, not at all.
It's, um, it's just...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没有在审问你。
不，完全不是。
只是，呃，只是...

scripts.text: Who are you dealing with?
scripts.translation: 你在和谁打交道？

scripts.text: I was just curious.
scripts.translation: 我只是好奇

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who are you dealing
with? I heard something
about some organization
that's supposedly very
powerful and I'm starting
to get really concerned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在和谁打交道？我听说有一个组织，据说非常强大，我开始真的很担心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
ignore hearing about
any kind of dangerous
corporation, even if
I wanted to. Turning my
back to this seems wrong...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得我无法忽视任何关于危险公司的传闻，即使我想这么做。对这件事视而不见似乎是不对的...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm...
You really
feel that way?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
嗯...
你真的这么认为吗？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Please give me
a moment. I need
some time to think
about how I can best
handle this situation.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
请给我一点时间。我需要时间思考如何最好地处理这种情况。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Just curious...?
Well, I hope that
you don't interfere
too much with other
people's lives just
out of curiosity.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
只是好奇...？
好吧，我希望你不要仅仅出于好奇就过多干涉别人的生活。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You really shouldn't
make something your
business if you're not
interested or willing
to commit. Now, if you
would excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
如果你不感兴趣或不愿意投入，真的不应该把别人的事当成自己的事。现在，请原谅我失陪了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry about that.
I didn't mean to
stick my nose into
your personal business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。我不是故意要插手你的私事。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Well, that's quite
alright. I accept
your apology, but
I must warn you
not to pry into my
personal affairs.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
没关系。我接受你的道歉，但我必须警告你，不要打探我的私事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
Now I don't know.
I suppose I could
be wrong, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
现在我不确定了。我想我可能是错的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
.......
Yes, I wouldn't
recommend running
around, indiscriminately
accusing random people
of doing strange things.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
......
是的，我不建议到处乱跑，毫无根据地指控随机的人在做奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I've come into a
decision and found
a way that I can let
you into my confidence
without putting the efforts
of my organization at risk.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
我已经做出了决定，并找到了一种方法，可以在不危及我们组织努力的情况下让你了解我的情况。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
As you may have already
guessed, I'm a member of an
organization whose ultimate
goal is to put an end to the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你可能已经猜到了，我是一个组织的成员，该组织的最终目标是终结雷根贝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
However, before I relate
more information regarding
my organization and its work, I shall require your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
不过，在我透露更多关于我的组织及其工作的信息之前，我需要你的合作。

scripts.text: How can I cooperate?
scripts.translation: 我该如何合作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I cooperate?
Um, what exactly is it
that you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该如何合作？
呃，你具体想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You do seem interested
in knowing more about us,
and we can also use your
expertise as an adventurer.
But first you must decide if
you will commit to cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你似乎确实想了解我们更多，我们也可以利用你作为冒险者的专业知识。但首先，你必须决定是否愿意合作。

scripts.text: I still don't get it...
scripts.translation: 我还是不明白...

scripts.text: Sure, I'll cooperate.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会合作

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Alright, let me make this 
clearer for you. You have
two choices.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
好吧，让我给你解释得更清楚一些。你有两个选择。

scripts.text: Two choices?
scripts.translation: 两个选择？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
 If you choose
to cooperate with us, you'll
need to periodically drink
this red magic tonic.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
如果你选择与我们合作，你需要定期饮用这种红色魔法药剂。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
The red tonic will allow
us to monitor your every
move so that we know you
won't betray us. You'll have to
continue cooperating or else
we won't give you the cure.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
红色药剂能让我们监控你的一举一动，以确保你不会背叛我们。
你必须继续合作，否则我们就不会给你解药。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Throughout our mission,
you'll need to take a red
tonic every so often to avoid
suffering fron unpleasant
consequences. When we
finish, you get the antidote.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
在整个任务期间，你需要时不时地服用红色药剂，以避免遭受不良后果。
当我们完成任务后，你会得到解药。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If you choose not to
cooperate, simply drink
this blue tonic, which will
erase every fragment of your
memory regarding our meeting.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
如果你选择不合作，只需饮用这种蓝色药剂，它会抹去你关于这次会面的一切记忆。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
So, what have
you decided to do?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
那么，你决定怎么做？

scripts.text: Don't cooperate
scripts.translation: 不合作

scripts.text: Cooperate
scripts.translation: 合作

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, good choice.
So will you take
this red tonic?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
啊，不错的选择。
那么，你要喝下这瓶红色药剂吗？

scripts.text: Do not take it.
scripts.translation: 不喝

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Very good.
Then please,
drink this right away.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
非常好。
那么请，立刻喝下去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou drink the red tonic.
It doesn't feel any different
from a Red Potion, but it
would be wise to cooperate
with Ghalstein until this
mission is accomplished.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你喝下了红色药剂。
感觉和红色药水没什么不同，但在任务完成之前，最好还是与加尔斯坦合作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You may feel a little
disoriented after drinking
this tonic for the first time.
I'll give you a moment to
steady yourself before we
talk about our mission.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
第一次喝这种药剂后，你可能会感到有些头晕。
我会给你一点时间缓一缓，然后再谈论我们的任务。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, good choice.
So will you take
this red tonic?
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
啊，不错的选择。
那么，你要喝下这瓶红色药剂吗？

scripts.text: Do not take it.
scripts.translation: 不喝

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Very good.
Then please,
drink this right away.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
非常好。
那么请，立刻喝下去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou drink the red tonic.
It doesn't feel any different
from a Red Potion, but it
would be wise to cooperate
with Ghalstein until this
mission is accomplished.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你喝下了红色药剂。
感觉和红色药水没什么不同，但在任务完成之前，最好还是与加尔斯坦合作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You may feel a little
disoriented after drinking
this tonic for the first time.
I'll give you a moment to
steady yourself before we
talk about our mission.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
第一次喝这种药剂后，你可能会感到有些头晕。
我会给你一点时间缓一缓，然后再谈论我们的任务。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You really feel
that way? Well, that's
a shame. Pity, really...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你真的是这么想的吗？
唉，真可惜。
真是遗憾...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou suddenly get the
weird feeling that someone
has been behind you this
entire time. As you slowly
turn around to look, you
were knocked unconscious...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你突然有一种奇怪的感觉，好像一直有人在你身后。
当你慢慢转身想看看时，你被击晕了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're forced to swallow
some strange pill which
immediately makes all your
thoughts hazier until it begins
to feel like your entire mind
is getting bleached somehow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你被迫吞下了一颗奇怪的药丸，它立刻让你的思维变得模糊，直到感觉你的整个大脑正在被某种方式漂白。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
So how are you feeling?
Any nausea that you may
be experiencing should
be going away very soon.
Anyway, let's get started.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你现在感觉如何？
你可能感到的恶心很快就会消失。
总之，让我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Rekenber Corporation
is closely affiliated with
Regenschirm, an underground
laboratory inhabited by strange
and suspicious creatures.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
雷根贝勒公司与雷根贝勒关系密切，那里是一个地下实验室，居住着各种奇怪且可疑的生物。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Your mission will be to
infiltrate this underground lab
and bring back evidence which
proves the existence of these
creatures. You must gather
various kinds of proof.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你的任务是渗透进这个地下实验室，并带回证明这些生物存在的证据。你必须收集各种类型的证据。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
But more importantly,
there is ^FF0000something there
that you have to bring
back to me^000000. I can't tell
you exactly what it is,
but trust me. You'll know.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
但更重要的是，那里有^FF0000一样东西，你必须带回来给我^000000。
我无法确切告诉你它是什么，但相信我。
你会知道的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If you search the
Laboratory enough,
you'll find what I'm
talking about. In any
case, you'll need to find
a way to get inside the lab.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
如果你在实验室里搜索得足够仔细，你就会找到我所说的东西。
无论如何，你需要找到进入实验室的方法。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
It might be helpful to
know that we've received
reports about disappearances
of people from the ^FF0000eastside
slums^000000. We believe they are
perhaps traveling illegally...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
知道这一点可能会有帮助：
我们收到了关于
^FF0000东区贫民窟^000000
有人失踪的报告。
我们认为他们可能正在非法旅行...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If someone there is
transporting people
without authorization,
maybe you can find a
contact who can sneak
you inside the Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
如果那里有人未经授权运送人员，也许你可以找到一个联系人，让他把你偷偷带进实验室。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
For now, it may be best
to start investigating the
eastside slums to see if you
can find somebody who can
get you inside the Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
目前，最好先开始调查东区贫民窟，看看能否找到能把你带进实验室的人。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
An error occurred.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, this looks like a
sufficient amount of
evidence for us to be
able to effectively attack
our enemy. I believe you're
ready for the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
啊，这看起来像是足够的证据，让我们能够有效地攻击我们的敌人。我相信你已经准备好接受下一个任务了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
But first, I believe it's
time for another red tonic
dose so that we can keep
monitoring you. Oh, and
don't worry, it's not addictive
or anything strange like that.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
但首先，我觉得是时候再给你一剂红色药剂了，这样我们才能继续监控你。
哦，还有，别担心，它不会上瘾，也没有任何奇怪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Now, find ^FF0000Gusharr^000000, one of
our members, ^FF0000near Juno^000000.
He will tell you about your
next mission. Show this to
him to prove that you are
working with us. Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
现在，去找^FF0000古沙尔^000000，他是我们的成员之一，在^FF0000朱诺附近^000000。
他会告诉你下一个任务。
向他出示这个以证明你在为我们工作。别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
When you get inside the
Laboratory, make sure that
you search around for any
records and get any sort of
concrete evidence we can
use. I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
当你进入实验室后，务必四处搜索任何记录，并获取任何我们可以使用的具体证据。
我会指望你的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
We'll need more evidence
than this from the Laboratory
to make any impact against our
enemy. I know what we need is
difficult to find, but I'm sure
that you can pull this off.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
我们需要从实验室获得更多证据，才能对我们的敌人造成任何影响。我知道我们需要找的东西很难找，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Please find Gushaar
in the vicinity of Juno.
He will give you all the
details for your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
请在朱诺附近找到古沙尔。
他会给你所有关于下一个任务的细节。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You've made the decision
to help us in order to learn
more about our organzation.
We appreciate all the help we
can get, but I hope you don't
regret getting in this deep.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你决定帮助我们，以便更多地了解我们的组织。我们感激任何帮助，但我希望你不会后悔卷入这么深。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
There's a certain price
for knowledge. I believe
you're capable of paying it,
but whether or not this ordeal
will be worthwhile to you is
difficult to determine.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
知识是有代价的。
我相信你有能力支付它，但这场磨难对你来说是否值得，很难确定。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You're so close to
accomplishing your
mission. If all goes as
planned, we can do some
real damage to our enemy.
And you'll finally be free.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
你离完成任务很近了。如果一切按计划进行，我们可以对我们的敌人造成真正的伤害。
而你最终将获得自由。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I can't believe what
happened. I just heard
that the president was
betrayed! This is horrible!
We'll have to start all over.
Was it all for nothing?!
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
我无法相信发生了什么。我刚刚听说总裁被背叛了！这太可怕了！
我们不得不从头开始。
这一切都白费了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
No. No, Jargeah would be
so disappointed in me if
I just gave up. I'll have to
follow our dream, no matter
what the obstacles are.
Jargeah, give me strength!
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
不。不，雅格亚会对我很失望，如果我就这样放弃了。我必须追随我们的梦想，无论障碍是什么。
雅格亚，给我力量！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Also, you've done a great
service for us. Although we
failed, you carried out your
missions perfectly. Here,
take this antidote so that
you'll finally be free of us.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
此外，你为我们做了很大的贡献。虽然我们失败了，但你完美地执行了你的任务。这里，拿着这个解毒剂，这样你最终就能摆脱我们了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I'd like you to take
this small gift, as way
of apology. We asked you
to do so much, but ultimately,
we weren't able to accomplish
what we set out to do. Still...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
请收下这份小礼物，作为我们的歉意。
我们让你做了很多事，但最终没能达成目标。
不过...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I'd like to thank you
for everything. Hopefully,
you found the answers
that you were looking for
when you decided to help
us. Farewell, faithful friend.
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
非常感谢你的一切。
希望你在决定帮助我们时，找到了你寻找的答案。
再见了，忠诚的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I hate being patient,
but the old adage is
true. He who runs away,
lives to fight another day.
But that day seems so
far off into the future...
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
我讨厌等待，但老话是对的。
留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。
但那一天似乎还很遥远...

scripts.text:
[??????]
^333333Hurry up, before
the others see you...^000000

[{0}]
(Wait a second...
That voice is
awfully familiar.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(等一下...
这个声音好熟悉。)

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: Keep listening.
scripts.translation: 继续听

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(That voice is
awfully familiar...
But what do I care?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(这个声音好熟悉...
但关我什么事？)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(This is too weird.
I guess I better keep
listening to see what
I can learn about this...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(这也太奇怪了。
我还是继续听听看，也许能了解到些什么...)

scripts.text:
[??????]
^333333So why did you tell
me to come to such
a dangerous place...?^000000

^3355FFThat's...^000000
That's ^660000Ghalstein's^3355FF voice!^000000

[????]
^666666Something unexpected
came up. Hence the sudden
change in plans. Now listen...^000000

^3355FFSuddenly, both of the
voices grew much quieter
as the two men spoke to each
other in low, hoarse whispers
that are almost inaudible.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF突然，两个声音都变得很轻。
两人用低沉沙哑的耳语交谈，几乎听不见。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
^333333Oh. That does
sound very urgent.
But it's not safe to
talk about this here.
Let's move somewhere
a little more secure.^000000
scripts.translation:
[加尔斯坦]
^333333哦。听起来很紧急。
但在这里谈论这些并不安全。
我们去个更安全的地方吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat other voice...
Whoever it belonged
to is gone! What's
going on here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF另一个声音...
它的主人不见了！
这里发生了什么？^000000

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Decisions, decisions.
Sometimes it's hard to
make a choice when it
isn't clear which one will
give you the most benefit.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
选择，选择。
有时候很难做出选择，因为不清楚哪一个能给你带来最大的好处。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
I think most of the good
things in life have some
kind of cost, but they're
usually worth it. I mean,
nothing would have any
worth without any cost, right?
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
我认为生活中大多数美好的事物都有某种代价，但通常都是值得的。
我的意思是，如果没有代价，任何东西都不会有价值，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Alright. Choose
your poison. I got
two different kinds of
tonics for you, red and blue.
So which one will you drink?
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
好的。选择你的毒药。
我有两种不同的药剂，红色和蓝色。
那么，你要喝哪一种？

scripts.text: Red Tonic
scripts.translation: 红色药剂

scripts.text: Blue Tonic
scripts.translation: 蓝色药剂

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Well, when you don't
make a decision, you
don't take action. And
when you don't take any
action, nothing happens.
Come on, don't be boring~
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
嗯，当你不做决定时，你就不会采取行动。
而当你不采取行动时，什么也不会发生。
来吧，别这么无趣~

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Red, huh? I like
your style. But, eh,
isn't there something
you want to show me first?
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
红色，是吗？
我喜欢你的风格。但是，呃，在你喝之前，是不是有什么东西要先给我看？

scripts.text: Oh, right!
scripts.translation: 哦，对了！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Hey... Umm...
Aren't you supposed
to be carrying some
sort of secret something?
I'd tell you want it was if we
weren't so, well, secretive.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
嘿... 呃...
你不应该随身携带某种秘密的东西吗？
如果我们不那么...
那么保密的话，我本来可以告诉你的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou suavely flash
your Membership Card
to Gushaar, who gives
you an approving nod.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你优雅地向古沙尔出示了你的会员卡，他满意地点了点头。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Yeah, that's what
I wanted to see. Good,
you're the one I've been
waiting here for. Alright,
just give me a second...
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
是的，这就是我想看的。
很好，你就是我在这里等待的人。好的，请稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Huh?! Oh geez, I almost
never make this mistake.
I'm sorry, I thought you might
have been someone else.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
什么？！哎呀，我几乎从不犯这种错误。
对不起，我原以为你可能是别人。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Blue...? Huh.
That shouldn't be
the one you want.
Well, if you're who
I think you are... Are you?
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
蓝色...？嗯。
那不应该是你想要的。
好吧，如果你就是我认为的那个人... 是吗？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Alright, first of all,
you should know why the
Rekenber Corporation is
our sworn enemy. Did you
know that it basically controls
the Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
好的，首先，你应该知道为什么雷根贝勒公司是我们的死敌。你知道吗，它基本上控制了秀发兹发德共和国？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
They're so powerful, they
manipulate everything in the
economy, media and even the
politics of this nation. There are other corporations, sure, but
they're nothing in comparsion.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
它们如此强大，操纵着这个国家的经济、媒体甚至政治。
当然还有其他公司，但相比之下它们微不足道。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Rekenber Corporation...
They've even got a hold on
all the other companies, simply
by bribing politicians to pass
the bills they want passed.
This isn't a real republic...
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
雷根贝勒公司...
它们甚至控制了所有其他公司，仅仅是通过贿赂政客让他们通过想要的法案。
这不是一个真正的共和国...

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
The ultimate goal of our
group, ''Secret Wing,'' is to
establish true independence
in the Schwarzwald Republic
by destroying Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
我们组织“秘密之翼”
的最终目标，是通过摧毁雷根贝勒公司，在秀发兹发德共和国建立真正的独立。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Fortunately, the new president
of the Schwarzwald Republic,
Mr. Weierstrass, is sympathetic
to our cause. He is working with us to bring about a revolution and
overthrow Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
幸运的是，秀发兹发德共和国的新总裁魏尔斯特拉斯先生对我们的事业表示同情。
他正与我们合作，推动革命并推翻雷根贝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Your mission will be to
visit with the president and
bring back any information
he may have for us. Remember,
because of his position, you can only see him during certain hours.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
你的任务将是拜访总裁，并带回他可能有的任何信息。记住，由于他的职位，你只能在特定时间见他。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
I hope you understand
''Secret Wing's'' ultimate
goal now. In any case, you've
got to meet our president,
Karl Theodor Weierstrass.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
我希望你现在理解“秘密之翼”的最终目标了。无论如何，你必须见我们的总裁，卡尔·特奥多尔·魏尔斯特拉斯。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
It won't be easy to see
such an important man,
so show your Secret Wing
Membership Card to his
secretary and there should
be very little hassle.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
见到这样重要的人物并不容易，所以向他的秘书出示你的秘密之翼会员卡，应该就不会有太多麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Because of his schedule,
you'll only be allowed to see
him from ^FF00008:00 PM to 11:00 PM^000000,
and from ^FF000011:00 AM to 2:00PM PST^000000.Good luck on this mission, friend.
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
由于他的日程安排，你只能在^FF0000晚上8:00到11:00^000000，以及^FF0000上午11:00到下午2:00^000000见他。
祝你在任务中好运，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Rekenber...
I shall see your
destruction if it's the
very last thing I do!
scripts.translation:
[古沙尔]
雷根贝勒...
哪怕这是我最后的任务，我也要见证它的毁灭！

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Good day, how
may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Oh. I'm fine, thanks.
scripts.translation: 哦，我很好，谢谢

scripts.text: I want to meet the president~
scripts.translation: 我想见见总裁~

scripts.text: W-who are you...?

[Hes O'Neil]
Since this is an
important government
building, please keep
in mind that certain areas,
monitored by guards, are
off limits to visitors.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
这里是重要的政府建筑，请注意，某些由卫兵监控的区域禁止访客进入。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
President Weierstrass?
Do you have an appointment
to meet with him today?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
魏尔斯特拉斯总裁？
请问您今天有预约见他吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Alright, let me see.
May I please have your
name so that I can look
it up in today's schedule?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
好的，让我看看。
请告诉我您的名字，以便我在今天的日程中查询。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
{0}?
I'm sorry, but I can't find
your name on the list. You
can only visit the president
if you have an appointment.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
{0}？
很抱歉，我在名单上找不到您的名字。
只有预约了才能拜访总裁。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
I'm so sorry, but because
the president is an incredibly
busy man, he can only make
time to see the people who
have an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
非常抱歉，由于总裁非常忙碌，他只能抽出时间见有预约的人。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Hmm...?
I'm the personal
secretary to the
president of the
Schwarzwald Republic,
if that's what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
嗯...？
如果您是指这个的话，我是秀发兹发德共和国总裁的私人秘书。

Good day, how
may I help you?

您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Show Secret Wing Card.

scripts.text: I'm here to see the president.

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second...
You don't seem to
be carrying your
''Secret Wing''
Membership Card.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下...
你似乎没有携带
“秘密之翼”
会员卡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou suavely flash

scripts.translation:
^3355FF你优雅地出示了
“秘密之翼”
会员卡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh... I see.
The president has
been expecting you.
Please, right this way.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
哦...我明白了。
总裁一直在等您。
请，这边请。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh... I see.
I'm sorry, but you've
come too early for your
appointment. Would you
come back to see the
president later?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
哦...我明白了。
很抱歉，您来得比预约时间早了。
您稍后再来见总裁好吗？

scripts.text:

President Weierstrass?
Do you have an appointment
to meet with him today?
scripts.translation:

魏尔斯特拉斯总裁？

感谢您的配合。

scripts.translation:

非常抱歉，由于总裁非常忙碌，他只能抽出时间见有预约的人。

scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
这里是重要的政府建筑，请注意，某些由卫兵监控的区域禁止访客进入。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Hm? I thought the
president was supposed
to give you some kind of
file, but perhaps I was
mistaken? Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
嗯？我以为总裁应该要给您一些文件，但我可能记错了？让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Hello, may I be
of any assistance?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I brought this.
scripts.translation: 我带来了这个

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Ah, the file folder
I needed. I'm so sorry
to trouble you. Thank
you so much for your help.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
啊，正是我需要的文件夹。
真是麻烦您了，非常感谢您的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
I'm sorry, but the
president is currently
outside on business.
Please come back to
visit him another time.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
很抱歉，总裁目前正在外出公干。
请您改日再来拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh, the president
is expecting you.
Please, go right
on ahead, sir.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
哦，总裁正在等您。
请进吧，先生。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh, the president
is expecting you.
Please, go right
on ahead, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
哦，总裁正在等您。
请进吧，女士。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
The President has given the order that 
nobody is allowed to enter this place.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
总裁已下令，任何人不得进入此地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, you will change your mind after listening to my explanation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，听完我的解释后，您会改变主意的。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
...............
Is it something very important?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
...............
这是非常重要的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是最重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Alright then, there you go.
(Whisper) I hope you will become his source of strength.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
好吧，请进吧。
（低声）希望您能成为他的力量源泉。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
The president said that you're welcome to visit him anytime.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
总裁说，您随时都可以来拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
I'm sorry...
It seems that the
president would like
to have some privacy now.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
很抱歉...
看来总裁现在需要一些私人空间。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are in the
President's House.
Arms are prohibited
without authorization in
this government building.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
您已进入总裁官邸。
未经授权的武器在此政府建筑内是被禁止的。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[?????]
I see.
Then...

[Guard]
Ah, Mr. Keshnaar.
Are you leaving?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊，克什纳尔先生。
您要离开了吗？

scripts.text:
[Keshnaar]
Yes, it's about time
for me to depart. Ah,
and may I ask who this
young gentleman here is?
scripts.translation:
[克什纳尔]
是的，我该出发了。啊，请问这位年轻绅士是谁？

scripts.text:
[Keshnaar]
Yes, it's about time
for me to depart. Ah,
and may I ask who this
lovely young lady is?
scripts.translation:
[克什纳尔]
是的，我该出发了。啊，请问这位年轻女士是谁？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Mr. Keshnaar,
I present {0}.
{1}, allow me
to introduce Eridan Keshnaar.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
克什纳尔先生，向您介绍{0}。
{1}，请允许我介绍埃里丹·克什纳尔。

scripts.text:
[Keshnaar]
A pleasure to meet you.
Now, if you would excuse
me, I have some business
to attend to. Good day~
scripts.translation:
[克什纳尔]
很高兴见到您。
那么，失陪了，我还有些公务要处理。再见~

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Take care,
Mr. Keshnaar.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
请保重，克什纳尔先生。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Please wait a moment.
Currently, the president
is seeing another guest.
Thank you for your patience.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
请稍等片刻。
目前总裁正在接待另一位客人。
感谢您的耐心等待。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Now you may enter
and speak with the
president. Thank you
for waiting all this time.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
现在您可以进入与总裁对话了。
感谢您一直以来的等待。

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢

scripts.text: Who was that gentleman...?
scripts.translation: 那位绅士是谁...？

scripts.text:
A Mister {0}
has arrived to see you now.
scripts.translation: {0}先生现在已抵达，要与您见面。

scripts.text:
A Missis {0}
has arrived to see you now.
scripts.translation: {0}女士现在已抵达，要与您见面。

scripts.text:
A Miss {0}
has arrived to see you now.
scripts.translation: {0}小姐现在已抵达，要与您见面。

scripts.text:
[Mr. President]
Oh, you're early!
I'm sorry, but would you
please wait one minute?
scripts.translation:
[总裁先生]
哦，你来得真早！
抱歉，请再等一分钟好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Yes, sir.
My apologies, but would
you please wait until the
president is ready?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
是的，先生。
抱歉，请等待直到总裁准备好。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, Mr. Keshnaar is the
government negotiator from
the Rekenber Corporation.
He often visits the president
to discuss various issues.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
哦，克什纳尔先生是来自雷根贝勒公司的政府谈判代表。
他经常拜访总裁讨论各种事务。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Greetings.
You may enter to
see the president.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
您好。
您可以进入见总裁了。

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Karl]
How did you get in here?
Please leave this place
immediately! Security...!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你是怎么进来的？
请立刻离开这里！
保安...！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, welcome~
I understand that you
must have had a lot of
trouble coming here.
It's a pleasure to
finally meet you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，欢迎~
我想你一定经历了很多麻烦才来到这里。
很高兴终于见到你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
As I'm sure Ghalstein
has told you, ''Secret Wing''
was formed to overthrow the
evil Rekenber Corporation.
Now, I'm sure that you must
have some questions for me...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
正如加尔斯坦告诉你的那样，
“秘密之翼”是为了推翻邪恶的雷根贝勒公司而成立的。
现在，我想你一定有很多问题要问我...

scripts.text: Secret Wing's Background
scripts.translation: 秘密之翼的背景

scripts.text: Rekenber's Purpose
scripts.translation: 雷根贝勒的目的

scripts.text: Secret Wing's Goal
scripts.translation: 秘密之翼的目标

scripts.text: Details about my mission
scripts.translation: 关于我的任务详情

scripts.text: I'm ready for my mission.
scripts.translation: 我已准备好执行任务

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Rekenber has been
unopposed for a very long
time. Our nation is unhappy
with their rule, but since our
country lacks solidarity, the
people can do nothing.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
雷根贝勒已经独大很久了。
我们的国家对他们的统治感到不满，但由于缺乏团结，人民无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But one day, I was contacted
by some people who claimed to
share my sentiments against
the Rekenber Corporation.
Later, I learned that they were
from the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
但有一天，我收到了一些人的联系，他们声称与我一样，反对雷根贝勒公司。
后来我得知，他们来自卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Apparently, they were
facing some aggressive
competition from Cool
Event Corp, which is
actually backed by the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
显然，他们正面临来自酷活动公司的激烈竞争，而后者实际上由雷根贝勒公司支持。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We decided to pool our
resources to deal with what
we perceived as a common
enemy. Before long, we gathered
more devotees to our cause and
formed the ''Secret Wing.''
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我们决定整合资源，共同应对我们眼中的共同敌人。不久，我们聚集了更多信徒，并成立了“秘密之翼”。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It may be helpful for
you to know that our
direct contact to the
Kafra Corporation is the
^FF00003rd Security Team^000000. Oh, did
you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
也许你需要知道，我们与卡普拉公司的直接联系是
^FF0000第三安全队^000000。
哦，你还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's true that companies
exist to create money, but
the Rekenber Corporation
is much more nefarious.
They actually want to dominate the entire Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
虽然公司存在的目的是赚钱，但雷根贝勒公司更加险恶。
他们实际上想要统治整个米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
In fact, the chairman of
that company is shrouded
in mystery. Although I'm
the president, I go through
many difficulties just to
send a message to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
事实上，那家公司的会长笼罩在神秘之中。
虽然我是总裁，但仅仅为了给他传递一条消息，我就必须经历重重困难。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's disheartening,
but we really have no
idea what their true goals
and plans might be. Now, did
you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
这令人沮丧，但我们真的不知道他们的真正目标和计划是什么。那么，你还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
''Secret Wing's'' only
goal is to destroy the
Rekenber Corporation in
order to break the Schwarzwald Republic free from its oppression.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
“秘密之翼”唯一的目标就是摧毁雷根贝勒公司，以摆脱秀发兹发德共和国对其的压迫。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Of course, we realize
that it will take time and
a lot of sacrifice to make
this a reality. Now, do you
have anything else to ask?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
当然，我们意识到这需要时间和大量的牺牲才能实现。
那么，你还有什么要问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, your next mission.
I'm ready to give you
some of the details if
you no longer have any
questions to ask. Let me
know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，你的下一个任务。
如果你不再有其他问题，我准备给你一些细节。当你准备好时请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Very well, then.
Your mission will not
be too difficult, but it does
have great urgency so you
must accomplish it as soon
as you can. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
很好。
你的任务不会太难，但非常紧急，所以你必须尽快完成。
明白了吗？

scripts.text: Wait, I have one more question!
scripts.translation: 等等，我还有一个问题！

scripts.text: Yes sir, Mr. President.
scripts.translation: 是的，总裁先生

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? I thought you
didn't have any more
questions. However, I still
have the luxury to give you
any answers that I can provide.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯？我以为你没有其他问题了。
不过，我还有余力给你一些我能提供的答案。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm glad to hear that.
Alright, give me a second
to search for this file before
I explain the mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
很高兴听到这个。
好的，给我一点时间查找这份文件，然后再向你解释任务。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Now, you must first visit
the Kafra Headquarters in
Al De Baran and meet someone
named ^FF0000Benith^000000. She will tell you
all about your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
现在，你必须先去艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部，见一位名叫^FF0000贝尼斯^000000的人。
她会告诉你关于你下一个任务的所有事情。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Be careful and do not
freely mention anything
about ''Secret Wing'' or
your cooperation with us as
it may jeopardize our goals.
Hurry, time is of the essence.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
小心行事，不要随意提及“秘密之翼”
或你与我们的合作，因为这可能会危及我们的目标。
快去吧，时间紧迫。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, before I forget,
please bring this file
folder to ^FF0000Ms. Hes O'Neil^000000
for me before you leave.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，差点忘了，请在你离开之前，把这个文件夹带给^FF0000赫斯·奥尼尔女士^000000。
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hurry and complete
the mission given to
you by Benith, who is
in the Kafra Headquarters
in Al De Baran. It is a very
urgent, high priority task...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
快去完成贝尼斯在艾尔帕兰卡普拉总部交给你的任务。
这是一个非常紧急、高优先级的任务...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? I was expecting
for you to bring me
back an important file.
Please hurry, our entire
organization is at stake!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯？我原本期待你带回来一份重要文件。
请快点，我们整个组织都岌岌可危！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, you're here.
Good work, I hear that
the mission was a success.
An official success anyway.
...............................

[Karl]
Poor, dear sweet
Jargeah. Why him?
Must fate be so cruel
and harsh? I still can't
believe he's gone. Just
last week, we were...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
可怜、亲爱的雅格亚。为什么是他？
命运为何如此残酷无情？
我仍然无法相信他已经离开了。
就在上周，我们还...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm sorry. You didn't
know him that well, but
all those who did know
him, loved him. And I can
say that with pride. L-let
me check the files a minute...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
抱歉。你和他并不熟，但所有认识他的人都爱他。
我可以自豪地说这一点。
让...让我检查一下档案...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm. After completely
reviewing this file, I've
found that it offers some
great leads, but it's still not
enough hard evidence to
really hurt Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯。在彻底审查这份档案后，我发现它提供了一些很好的线索，但还不足以成为真正重创雷根贝勒的硬证据。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
However, according to
this, there's a researcher
from Rekenber named
Shinokas who vanished all
of a sudden. Apparently, he
knew some kind of secret.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
不过，根据这份档案，雷根贝勒有一位名叫希诺卡斯的研究员突然失踪了。
显然，他知道某种秘密。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Luckily, my men have
reported sightings of
Shinokas somewhere in
Einbroch. He's certainly
out there. But what does
he have to hide?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
幸运的是，我的人报告说在艾音布罗克看到了希诺卡斯。
他肯定在那里。
但他有什么要隐瞒的？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We must learn his
secret if we hope to
do any lasting damage to
the Rekenber Corporation.
Your next mission is to
find Shinokas. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
如果我们希望给雷根贝勒公司造成持久的伤害，就必须查明他的秘密。
你的下一个任务是找到希诺卡斯。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And please hurry.
I don't want our enemies
to discover Shinokas before
we can get him to talk.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
请快点。
我不希望我们的敌人在我们让他开口之前先找到希诺卡斯。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm sorry, but it's
taking me a long time
to analyze the information
in this file. A-and Jargeah
sacrificed himself to get
it for us. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Jargeah...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
抱歉，解析这份档案中的信息花了我很长时间。
而雅格亚为了得到它献出了生命。
^333333*叹气*^000000 雅格亚...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Why don't you relax
while I peruse this
file? I should be done
with this soon, hopefully...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
在我翻阅这份档案的时候，你不妨休息一下。
希望我很快就能看完...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ymir's Heart Pieces?
Is that what they're
trying to collect?
What are they going
to do with something
so incredibly dangerous?!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
依美乐心脏堆积物？
这就是他们试图收集的东西吗？
他们打算用如此危险的东西做什么？！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Huh. This new information
raises some new questions.
Fortunately, we have a new
lead from the spy who got
us the info on Shinokas.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯。这个新信息引发了一些新的疑问。
幸运的是，我们从那个提供希诺卡斯情报的间谍那里得到了新的线索。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We've recently learned that
Shinokas managed to access
the Regenschirm Secret Archive, a lab affiliated with Rekenber.
That's how Shinokas was able
to learn so much about them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我们最近得知，希诺卡斯设法进入了雷根席尔姆秘密档案室，那是雷根贝勒旗下的一个实验室。
希诺卡斯就是这样了解到关于他们的这么多信息的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It will be difficult
and very dangerous to
access this archive, so
I want you to meet with
someone from the Kafra
Corporation near Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
进入这个档案馆将非常困难且极其危险，所以我想让你去见里希塔乐镇附近卡普拉公司的一位人员。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And don't worry...
She'll know exactly
who you are and
how to help you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
别担心...
她会确切地知道你是谁，以及如何帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We don't know how
helpful Shinokas's
information may be for
us, but we must learn
anything we can about
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我们不知道希诺卡斯的信息对我们有多大帮助，但我们必须了解关于雷根贝勒公司的一切。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There is so much we
don't know about them.
Their motives, their methods,
almost all of the important
details are still in the dark.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
关于他们，我们还有太多未知。
他们的动机、手段，几乎所有重要细节仍然笼罩在黑暗中。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
By all means, you
must find Shinokas and
see what you can learn!
Your efforts will not go
unrecognized, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
无论如何，你必须找到希诺卡斯，看看你能学到什么！
你的努力不会白费，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? What's wrong?
Now that I think about
it, you reacted as if you
recognized his name back
when I mentioned Shinokas.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯？怎么了？
现在回想起来，当我提到希诺卡斯时，你的反应好像认识他。

scripts.text: Oh, no. Not really.
scripts.translation: 哦，不。不是的

scripts.text: Actually, Shinokas is...
scripts.translation: 其实，希诺卡斯是...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Then it must be
my imagination.
Okay then, go and
find Shinokas, he
may be in grave
danger as we speak!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
那一定是我的错觉。
好吧，快去找到希诺卡斯，他此刻可能正处于危险之中！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Oh...
You've already met
Shinokas, did you?
You witnessed his 
death?! This is a very
strange coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
哦...
你已经见过希诺卡斯了？
你目睹了他的死亡？！
这真是奇怪的巧合。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I see, there must be
no need to investigate
Shinokas now. And you
did learn the secret for
which he was hunted...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我明白了，看来现在没必要再调查希诺卡斯了。
而且你也知道了他被人追杀的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Mr. President,
Ms. Hes O' Neil has an
urgent message for you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
总裁先生，赫斯·奥尼尔女士有紧急消息要向您汇报。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hmm...
Then please,
let her in.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯...
那就请让她进来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Sir, I'm sorry
for interrupting
you, but there's
something I need to
show you immediately!
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
先生，抱歉打扰您，但我有件必须立刻向您展示的事情！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright, let's
have it. Let me
see those new files.
Oh, these are--! Thank
you, Ms. O' Neil, you
may leave now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
好的，给我看看。
让我看看这些新档案。
哦，这些是——！
谢谢你，奥尼尔女士，你可以离开了。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Thank you sir.
Once again, let me
apologize for disturbing
your private conference.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
谢谢先生。
再次为打扰您的私人会议致歉。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright. Please let me
review these documents
to see if there are any
new developments in the
investigation involving
Shinokas and his secret...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
好的。请让我审阅这些文件，看看关于希诺卡斯及其秘密的调查是否有新的进展...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright, I just
completed reading
all of these new reports
from our field agents.
Thank you for waiting.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
好的，我刚读完所有这些来自我们特工的新报告。
谢谢你的等待。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We've recently learned that
Shinokas managed to access
the Regenschirm  Secret Archive,a lab affiliated with Rekenber.
That's how Shinokas was able
to learn so much about them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我们最近得知，希诺卡斯设法进入了雷根席尔姆秘密档案室，那是雷根贝勒旗下的实验室。
希诺卡斯就是这样了解到关于他们的这么多信息的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It will be difficult
and very dangerous to
access this archive, so
I want you to meet with
someone from the Kafra
Corporation near Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
进入这个档案馆将非常困难且极其危险，所以我想让你去见里希塔乐镇附近卡普拉公司的一位人员。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you keep looking around
the ^3355FFfields just outside of
Lighthalzen^000000, you'll certainly
find her. I'm sorry that I can't
tell you more, but we've got
to protect our security...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
如果你在^3355FF里希塔乐镇外^000000的野外四处寻找，肯定能找到她。抱歉我不能透露更多，但我们必须保护我们的安全...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And don't worry...
She'll know exactly
who you are and
how to help you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
别担心...
她会确切地知道你是谁，以及如何帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I apologize, but it's
taking me a long time
to go through all of the
reports in these files.
Please give me a little more
time to make sense of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
抱歉，但我花了很多时间来梳理这些档案中的所有报告。
请再给我一点时间来理清头绪。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I hope you continue
to keep up the good
work, not only for the
sake of the Schwarzwald
Republic, but for peace
on all of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我希望你能继续保持出色的工作，不仅为了秀发兹发德共和国，也为了米德加尔特全境的和平。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you find any
of that evidence in
the Secret Archive yet?
Hurry! The movements in
Rekenber Corporation are
making me feel really uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你在秘密档案室里找到那些证据了吗？
快一点！雷根贝勒公司的动向让我感到很不安。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, you're here.
I've already received a
message from Esuna
about your success.
If you would, please
let me read the file...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，你来了。
我已经收到艾斯娜关于你成功的消息了。
如果可以的话，请让我读一下这份档案...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, now everything is
clearer. Shinokas and his
friends were killed over
that piece of Ymir's Heart.
That's what the Rekenber
Corporation ultimately wants.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，现在一切都清晰了。希诺卡斯和他的朋友们是因为那块依美乐的心脏而被杀的。
这就是雷根贝勒公司最终想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But this raises some
new questions. What
are they planning to
do with Ymir's Heart?
It must be more powerful
than we had thought...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
但这引发了一些新的问题。他们打算用依美乐的心脏做什么？
它一定比我们想象的更强大...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We'll need even more
information. For now,
please go back to Esuna.
It seems that she just
received some critically
important intel to give you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我们需要更多的信息。现在，请回到艾斯娜那里。
看来她刚收到一些极其重要的情报要给你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Please hurry and meet
Esuna just outside of
Lighthalzen. Perhaps I am
getting paranoid, but I keep
getting the feeling that
Rekenber is on to us...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
请快点去里希塔乐镇外与艾斯娜会面。
也许是我多心了，但我总觉得雷根贝勒盯上我们了...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You don't have the
file? Retrieve it for
me as soon as you can.
It's imperative that I read
what Esuna has to report!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你没有那份档案？
尽快把它取回来。
我必须读到艾斯娜的报告！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, good to see you
again. I hear you have
some important news for
me, something of the utmost
urgency. But I fear the worst.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
啊，很高兴再次见到你。
听说你有重要消息要告诉我，而且十万火急。
但我恐怕是最坏的情况。

scripts.text: Give the file from Esuna.
scripts.translation: 交给艾斯娜的档案

scripts.text:
[Karl]
What...?
I can't believe this!
How can our security
be breached like this?!
Only someone from
really deep inside could...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
什么...？
难以置信！
我们的安保怎么会被这样突破？！
只有内部非常核心的人才能...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Please...
Would you go and
speak to Esuna one
more time? I need to
know more about how
all of this happened...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
拜托了...
你能再去和艾斯娜谈谈吗？
我需要知道这一切到底是怎么发生的...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
No...
I can't...
Kurelle? We've
worked together,
trusted each other
for years. No, it's not....
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
不...
我不相信...
库蕾尔？我们共事多年，彼此信任。不，不可能...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If it's true, then
that means I've been
playing into the enemy's
hands this whole time.
I've... I've got to know
and ask Kurelle myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
如果这是真的，那就意味着我一直被敌人牵着鼻子走。
我...我必须亲自去问库蕾尔。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
O'Neil!
Bring Kurelle in
here, right now!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
赫斯·奥尼尔！
马上把库蕾尔带进来！

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
...Yes, sir.
Right away.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奥尼尔]
...是的，总裁先生。
马上就来。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Advisor Kurelle
is here now.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
顾问库蕾尔已经到外面了。

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Hello, Mr. President.
What exactly did you
need from me today?
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
你好，总裁先生。
今天您找我有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you...
Why did you betray us?!
After all this time, why now?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
是你...？
你为什么要背叛我们？！
这么多年了，为什么偏偏是现在？

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
...
......
So you know.
Well, you're smarter
than I gave you credit for.
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
...
......
原来你知道。
看来你比我以为的要聪明。

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Ha ha ha~
Right, it was me.
Your right hand man.
I reported everything
you were doing to the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
哈哈~
没错，就是我。
你的左膀右臂。
我把你做的每一件事都报告给了雷根贝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But why...?
I thought we were
working together for
the greater good, to
do the right thing?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
但为什么...？
我以为我们是为了更大的利益，为了做正确的事才一起工作的？

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Forget that! I'm sick
of being second place
to you. All our lives, you've
always been on top. School,
athletics, politics. Well, here's my chance to finally beat you!
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
别提了！我受够了永远屈居你之下。从小到大，你总是站在顶端。学业、体育、政治。现在，我终于有机会打败你了！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I can't believe this. All
those years of friendship
were all a lie? We even
joined Secret Wing together.
This whole time, you were
harboring a silly grudge...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
难以置信。这么多年来的友谊竟然都是假的？我们还一起加入了秘密之翼。原来你一直怀有这种愚蠢的怨恨...

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Shut up! It's not a
silly grudge! ...You there.
Adventurer. Can't you see
this man is finished?! But
it's not too late. Join us.
Rekenber could use you.
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
闭嘴！这不是愚蠢的怨恨！...你，冒险者。难道你没看出来这个男人已经完蛋了吗？但还来得及。加入我们吧。雷根贝勒需要你。

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Now that I've helped
the Rekenber Corporation,
I'll get their support in the
next presidential election.
I'll beat you for sure, Karl!
Bwahahahahahaahahahhaah~!
scripts.translation:
[库蕾尔]
既然我帮助了雷根贝勒公司，下次总裁选举他们就会支持我。我一定会打败你的，卡尔！哇哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's all over for
now. This isn't good
at all. You're finished
here too. Go and talk to
^3355FFGhalstein^000000 again. It's time
we let you loose, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
现在一切都结束了。情况非常不妙。你在这里也完蛋了。去和^3355FF加尔斯坦^000000再谈谈吧。是时候放你走了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, where did I put the record?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，我把记录放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's you.....!
It's really been a long time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
是你.....！
真的好久不见了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, are you still having the idea to go against Rekenber?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，你还有对抗雷根贝勒的想法吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm not sure.
The Secret Wing has been disbanded and I am just another puppet they have, just like the previous presidents.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我不确定。
秘密之翼已经解散了，我现在只是他们手中的傀儡，就像之前的总裁一样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not long ago, the scientists of Regenschrim have stolen the research record and destroyed the machines that they used for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不久前，雷根席尔姆的科学家偷走了研究记录，并销毁了用于研究的机器。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
...!
Did you do that? 
I still fail to move on after the incident of my friends' betrayal and the disband of the Secret Wing...
You are really a great friend.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
...！
是你做的吗？
在朋友背叛和秘密之翼解散的事件之后，我一直无法释怀...
你真是个大好人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Didn't you speak about the research record just now?
Oh! Can you give me the record?
It will be a big trouble to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你刚才提到了研究记录？
哦！你能把记录给我吗？
这对他们来说会是很大的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you insist to go against them, I will give you the record.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你坚持要对抗他们，我就把记录给你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I am the president of this country.
I have failed before but I won't stop trying when there is still an opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我是这个国家的总裁。
我以前失败过，但只要还有机会，我就不会停止尝试。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You remind me of the day I made up my mind to rebuild this country.
How could I forgot such important responsibilities of mine.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你让我想起了我下定决心重建这个国家的那一天。
我怎么能忘记我肩负的重要责任呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's great.
Here's the record.
I hope you will make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了。
这是记录。
希望你能好好利用它。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Oh! That's some interesting information.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
噢！这是非常有价值的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have another good news. The Secret Wing has not given up yet. They are still working on the project and I hope that you won't be giving up on it too.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还有一个好消息。秘密之翼并没有放弃，他们仍在推进这个项目。我希望你也不要放弃。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
.....I feel so sorry for what I did.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
......我为我所做的一切感到抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Thank you for bringing this great gift. I will stay strong and work hard to achieve my target.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
谢谢你带来这份珍贵的礼物。我会保持坚强，努力工作以实现我的目标。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I will recruit the new batch of members and use them to let the world know about what the corporation had really done.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我将招募新一批成员，让他们向世界揭露这家公司的真面目。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Thank you so much. 
You can count on me to right what was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
非常感谢。
你可以指望我纠正过去的错误。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I am trying to recruit capable people who can help me to bring down Rekenber Corporation.
Thanks to you, I have enough information as a good beginning to nail them now down.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我正在招募有能力的人，帮助我扳倒雷根贝勒公司。
多亏了你，我获得了足够的信息，这是一个很好的开端，足以让他们现出原形。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I have had my men to gather some information and learned that Regenschrim had stopped operating now.
You have done well for the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我派人收集了一些情报，得知雷根席尔姆已经停止运作了。
你为秀发兹发德共和国做得很好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat the...?
You can hear
whispers coming
from the window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什...什么？
你听到从窗户传来低语声。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
^333333That's expected...
But... Why did...
... the president...^000000

^3355FFThe whispers grow
lower and lower until
you can no longer hear
anything. One of those
voices seemed so familiar...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF低语声越来越小，直到你再也听不见任何声音。其中一个声音听起来很熟悉...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Headquarters.
Here in the heart of
Kafra's operations, you
can be provided with special
services offered nowhere else!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
欢迎来到卡普拉总部。
在这里，卡普拉业务的核心地带，您可以享受其他地方无法提供的特殊服务！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
If you need anything,
please inquire the Kafra
Employees inside the building.
Thank you and have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
如果您有任何需求，请咨询大楼内的卡普拉职员。
谢谢，祝您愉快~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good day~
The Kafra Corporation is
always working to ensure
our customers' satisfaction.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
您好~
卡普拉公司始终致力于确保顾客的满意度。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I have a question.
scripts.translation: 我有一个问题

scripts.text: I'm fine, thanks.
scripts.translation: 我没事，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Sure, I'll answer your
question to the best of
my ability. However, I may
need to reference you to
another employee for
specialized information.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
当然，我会尽我所能回答您的问题。
不过，对于专业信息，我可能需要为您转接其他职员。

scripts.text: Do you know where I can find Benith?
scripts.translation: 你知道贝尼斯在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, Benith? Sure, you
can find her here inside
Kafra Headquarters to the
right somewhere. She wears
a special uniform, so you
can spot her easily.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
哦，贝尼斯？
是的，您可以在卡普拉总部右侧的某个地方找到她。
她穿着特殊的制服，所以很容易认出来。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Okay then,
have a good day!
Always remember
that the Kafra Service
will be on your side~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
好的，祝您今天愉快！
请永远记住，卡普拉服务永远在您身边~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Feel free to ask any
one of our conveniently
located employees if you
ever have need of Kafra's
special services. Thank
you and have a nice day~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
如果您需要卡普拉的特殊服务，请随时询问我们分布在各处的职员。
谢谢，祝您度过美好的一天~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
Glad you asked. Right now,
we're developing a brand new
program with Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
欢迎来到卡普拉总部。
卡普拉有什么新消息？
您问得好。目前，我们正在与酷活动公司合作开发一项全新计划。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This new program will
provide a direct teleport
service to dungeons for
the convenience of our
valued customers. Is
that not... exciting?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
这项新计划将为尊贵的顾客提供直达副本的传送服务，以方便大家使用。
这难道不...令人兴奋吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Due to technical issues,
Kafra Corp and Cool Event
Corp cannot provide teleport
services to the same dungeon,
so one common teleport service
provider will be selected.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
由于技术问题，卡普拉公司和酷活动公司无法同时为同一个副本提供传送服务，因此将选择一家通用的传送服务提供商。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Therefore, elections will
be held to determine which
company will provide this
Dungeon Teleport Service.
Please check the eligibility
requirements before voting.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
因此，将举行选举来决定哪家公司提供这项副本传送服务。
请在投票前查看资格要求。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
Glad you asked. Right now,
we're developing a brand new
program with Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
欢迎来到卡普拉总部。
卡普拉有什么新消息？
您问得好。目前，我们正在与酷活动公司合作开发一项全新计划。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This new program will
provide a direct teleport
service to dungeons for
the convenience of our
valued customers. Is
that not... exciting?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
这项新计划将为尊贵的顾客提供直达副本的传送服务，以方便大家使用。
这难道不...令人兴奋吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Due to technical issues,
Kafra Corp and Cool Event
Corp cannot provide teleport
services to the same dungeon,
so one common teleport service
provider will be selected.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
由于技术问题，卡普拉公司和酷活动公司无法同时为同一个副本提供传送服务，因此将选择一家通用的传送服务提供商。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We'd like to inform
you that the customers
will decide the teleport
service provider through
an election. Your vote will
be much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
我们要通知大家，顾客将通过选举决定传送服务提供商。
您的投票将备受期待。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Remember to take part
in the polls that will be
taking place in the cities
of Prontera and Juno.
Happy voting.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
请记得参与将在普隆德拉和朱诺举行的投票。
祝您投票愉快。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I can't wait!
scripts.translation: 我等不及了！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Uh oh...
Did you have a question?
In all honesty, I don't know
very much about the services
Kafra offers. My work is...
I'm in a different department.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
哎呀...
您有问题吗？
老实说，我对卡普拉提供的服务了解不多。
我的工作...我在不同的部门。

scripts.text: Oh, that's okay then.
scripts.translation: 哦，那没关系

scripts.text: Are you Benith..?
scripts.translation: 你是贝尼斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
*Whew!*
Oh good. Well, if you
do have any questions
about the Kafra Services,
please ask one of the regular
Kafra Employees. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
*呼！*
太好了。嗯，如果您对卡普拉服务有任何问题，请咨询普通的卡普拉职员。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Yes, that's me.
Is there anything
that I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
是的，就是我。
有什么我可以为您效劳的吗？

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是

scripts.text: Show Membership Card.
scripts.translation: 出示会员卡

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Really?
Okay, then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
真的吗？
好的，那么。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait...
You can't show
your ''Secret Wing''
Membership Card
if you don't have it!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等...
如果你没有
“秘密之翼”会员卡，就不能出示它！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Oh, I've been waiting
for you. Finally, I can
drop this promotional
pretense and get down
to business and tell you
about your mission.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
哦，我一直在等您。
终于，我可以放下这种宣传姿态，开始正事，告诉您关于您的任务了。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
As an experienced
adventurer, your specialty
is in retrieving items and
fighting against monsters.
We have a rescue mission
that suits your expertise.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，您的专长是获取物品和与魔物战斗。
我们有一个救援任务适合您的专长。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
One of our special
agents got into an
accident and is stuck
in ^FF0000Grim Reaper's Valley^000000,
located somewhere between
Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
我们的一名特工出了事故，被困在
^FF0000死神峡谷^000000，位于艾音布罗克和里希塔乐镇之间。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Our agent, Jargeah,
is reported to be hiding
near a broken bridge there.
All of our other agents are
assigned on other missions,
so you're all he has right now.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
我们的特工雅格亚据报正躲藏在那里一座断桥附近。
我们其他特工都在执行其他任务，所以目前只有你能帮他了。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
He's seriously wounded,
so please hurry before
the enemy can get to him...
