scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
他伤势严重，请快点赶过去，别让敌人先找到他...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
That makes one of u--
I mean, your participation
is very much appreciated.
Remember that Kafra is
always on your side.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
这样就算我们中的一员了——
我是说，非常感谢您的参与。
请记住，卡普拉永远站在您这边。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Please hurry and save
Jargeah. If the enemy
gets to him before we
do, all his efforts, as well
as his life, may be forfeit.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
请快点去救雅格亚。
如果敌人先找到他，他所有的努力，甚至他的生命，都可能付诸东流。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
You should be able to
find him near a broken
bridge in Grim Reaper's
Valley, which is located
somewhere between
Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
你应该能在死神峡谷的一座断桥附近找到他，那里位于艾音布罗克和里希塔乐镇之间。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Please hurry!
I don't want the enemy
to find Jargeah before
we do! His life and the
Secret Wing are at stake!
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
请快点！
我不希望敌人先找到雅格亚！
他的生命和秘密之翼都悬于一线！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Great, you're back,
and you even have the
information that Jargeah
managed to obtain. But...
Where's Jargeah? Is he...?
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
太好了，你回来了，而且你甚至拿到了雅格亚设法获取的情报。但是...
雅格亚呢？他...？

scripts.text: He's in a better place.
scripts.translation: 他去了更好的地方

scripts.text:
[Benith]
What...?! Noooo!
Comrade Jargeah!
I swear to you your
death won't be in vain!
Why did another good man
have to die? Answer me!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
什...什么？！不！
同伴雅格亚！
我向你发誓，你的死不会白费！
为什么又一个好人必须死去？回答我！！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
I can't... No. We must
first honor Jargeah's noble
sacrifice before we can allow ourselves the luxury of mourning
our loss. Let me read these files first before you deliver them...
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
我不能...不。我们必须先纪念雅格亚高贵的牺牲，然后才能允许自己哀悼失去他。
让我先看看这些文件，然后再让你交上去...

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Alright. Please take
this file to ^FF0000him^000000 now.
I believe you know
whom I am talking about.
The Secret Wing is counting
on you, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
好的。请把这个文件交给^FF0000他^000000。
我相信你知道我说的是谁。
秘密之翼正指望着你，勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
I swear by my father's
grave that the tears I shed
for Jargeah will only be
matched by the blood I will
spill in holy retribution.
Jargeah, watch over me!
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
我以我父亲的坟墓发誓，我为雅格亚流下的泪水，将只会被我为神圣复仇所流的鲜血所匹敌。
雅格亚，请保佑我！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
W-welcome to the
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
^333333Glad... You... Asked...^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝尼斯]
欢...欢迎来到卡普拉总部。
卡普拉有什么新消息？
^333333高...兴...你...问...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Can't hold out...
Much longer. They...
They better send
someone soon...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
^333333*咳嗽 咳嗽*^000000
撑不住了...
再撑不了多久了。他们...
他们最好快点派人来...

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt's a wounded man...!^000000

[{0}]
H-hey...!
Are you hurt?
Do you need any he--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你好...！
你受伤了吗？
你需要什么帮--

scripts.text:
[?????]
N-no..!
Get away, do-gooder!
Don't attract attention,
they're gonna find me!
Don't worry, don't ask,
j-just get the hell away!
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
不...不！
走开，多管闲事的人！
别引起注意，他们要找到我了！
别担心，别问，快...快滚开！

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Can't hold out...
Much longer. They...
They better send
someone soon...
scripts.translation:
[？？？？？]
^333333*咳嗽 咳嗽*^000000
撑不住了...
再撑不了多久了。他们...
他们最好快点派人来...

scripts.text: Jargeah?
scripts.translation: 雅格亚？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
^333333*Cough Gasp*^000000
H-how do you know my...
Never mind that. Who...
What... What organization
are you working for...?
scripts.translation:
[雅格亚]
^333333*咳嗽 喘息*^000000
你...你怎么知道我的...
算了。你...
你...你是为哪个组织工作的...？

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
Th-thank goodness!
You finally came for me.
If you came a little later,
I'd be a goner. H-here,
t-take this with you...
scripts.translation:
[雅格亚]
谢...谢天谢地！
你终于来救我了。
再晚一点，我就没命了。给，把这个...拿去吧...

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
Oh... Oh no.
*Cough cough*
I think... It might
T-tell Cilantro that...
Tell her I still lov-- ^333333*Huk*^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅格亚]
噢...噢不。
*咳嗽 咳嗽*
我想...我可能得告诉香菜...告诉她我还爱-- ^333333*咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
No... No, you're
not the one who's
supposed to come
for m-me... ^333333*Huk*^000000

^3355FFThis isn't good.
Jargeah just passed
out in a very ugly way.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF情况不妙。
雅格亚以非常难看的方式昏了过去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so you left the
wounded man alone. Not
exactly the best moral choice.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF于是你丢下那个受伤的男人离开了。
这可不是什么好的道德选择。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Everything's getting
darker. So c-cold...

[????]
Here,
Come this way.

^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I've been waiting for you.
We don't have much time,
so I'll explain quickly. Your
mission is to sneak into the
Rekenber Corporation and
steal incriminating evidence.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我一直在等你。
时间不多，我长话短说。你的任务是潜入雷根贝勒公司，窃取罪证。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
However, this place won't
be easy to infiltrate and
there'll be more security
because they learned about
what happened with Shinokas
and... and Jargeah. Jargeah...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
不过，这个地方不容易渗透，而且因为希诺卡斯和...和雅格亚的事，安保会更严密。雅格亚...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
You'll need to acquire
identification through one
of our agents who's managed
to get in really deep without
arousing any suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你需要通过我们的一名特工获取身份证明，他已深入内部，且未引起任何怀疑。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Afterwards, find the
^FF0000Secret Archive^000000, disable the
security system and steal
that evidence as quickly as
possible. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
之后，找到
^FF0000秘密档案室^000000，关闭安保系统，并尽快窃取证据。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
For now, use the pass you
have for the Rekenber buildings
and meet up with Agent ^FF0000Lestin^000000.
He'll explain everything else,
so be careful and don't let
them get suspicious of you!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
现在，使用你手中的通行证进入雷根贝勒大楼，与特工^FF0000莱斯廷^000000会合。
他会解释其余的一切，小心行事，别让他们起疑！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Use the pass that you
have to enter the Rekenber
buildings and find Secret
Agent Lestin. Remember
that he's undercover...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
使用你手中的通行证进入雷根贝勒大楼，找到特工莱斯廷。
记住，他是卧底...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Good work.
Please bring this file
to President Weierstrass
right away. We'll also be
directly sending information
as a safeguard measure.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
干得好。
请立刻把这个文件交给魏尔斯特拉斯总裁。
我们也会直接发送情报作为保障措施。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I know it's sudden, but
there's a new development.
I can't explain it now, but you
have to check on the president
for me first. Plus, this new
intel needs to be confirmed...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我知道很突然，但出现了新情况。
我现在无法解释，但你必须先替我去确认总裁的情况。另外，这份新情报需要核实...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
You're back. Listen,
you could not have helped
us out at a worse time. We
just learned that something
horrible has happened...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你回来了。听着，你来得太不巧了。我们刚得知发生了可怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I can't give you all
the details now, but
you've got to give this
file to the president as
quickly as you can. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我现在不能告诉你所有细节，但你必须尽快把这个文件交给总裁。
快！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
What are you waiting
for?! It's important that
you give that file to the
president as soon as
possible! It's bad news,
but he deserves to know...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你在等什么？！
必须尽快把那份文件交给总裁！虽然消息很坏，但他有权知道...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Good, you're back.
Listen, all members of
Secret Wing need to leave
the Schwarzwald Republic
immediately! We've been
severely compromised...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
很好，你回来了。
听着，秘密之翼的所有成员都必须立即离开秀发兹发德！我们已经严重暴露了...

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
We've been tremendously
damaged. A lot of agents
died to give us this intel,
but we've been betrayed.
The president's closest
aide totally sold us out...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我们遭受了重创。许多特工为了获取这份情报而牺牲，但我们被出卖了。
总裁最亲近的助手彻底背叛了我们...

scripts.text: Who could have done such....?
scripts.translation: 谁会做出这种事...？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I can't believe Kurelle
did this to us. And there's no
way we can save the president.
Even if we wanted to, we need
to stick with our contigency
plan. We all knew the risks...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我无法相信库蕾尔会对我们做出这种事。
而且我们已无法拯救总裁。
即使我们想救，也必须执行备用计划。我们都知道其中的风险...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Kurelle has been secretly
meeting with directors from
Rekenber Corporation and
his mansion is littered with
incriminating evidence...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
库蕾尔一直在秘密会见雷根贝勒公司的总监们，他的宅邸里到处都是罪证...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Damn it! We have no
choice but to abandon
the president now! But
this won't mean that his
sacrifice, and Jargeah's
death, will be vain!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
该死！我们别无选择，只能暂时放弃总裁！
但这并不意味着他的牺牲，以及雅格亚的死亡是徒劳的！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Still, aside from a few
agents, almost all of Secret
Wing must pull out of the
Schwarzwald Republic for
now so that we can live to
fight another day.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
尽管如此，除了少数特工外，秘密之翼的几乎所有人现在都必须撤出秀发兹发德，以便我们留得青山在，日后还能再战。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
For now, this is
goodbye. Take care...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
暂时，这就是告别了。保重...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
You know what's weird?
Why do they use blue and
red wires when they make
bombs? There's so many
others you could use, like
pink or yellow or or green...
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
你知道奇怪的是什么吗？
为什么制作炸弹时要用蓝色和红色的线？
明明可以用很多其他颜色，比如粉色、黄色或者绿色...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Hey, here's a completely
hypothetical question. Let's
say you find a bomb and it's
about to go off. You better
cut a wire! So which one are
you gonna cut? Red or blue?
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
嘿，这里有个完全假设性的问题。假设你发现了一个炸弹，它马上就要爆炸了。
你最好剪断一根线！
那你打算剪哪根？红色还是蓝色？

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 红色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 蓝色

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Red, eh...?
...................
Heh, yeah, just like
in the movies. I like
the way you think~
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
红色，是吗...？
...................
呵，没错，就像电影里演的一样。
我喜欢你的思维方式~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou surrepticiously
check the researcher's
ID badge and see that the name ''Lestin'' is written on it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你偷偷检查了研究员的ID徽章，上面写着名字“莱斯廷”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
So...
Is there anything
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
那么...
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Alright then.
Just be quiet when
you're in the Laboratory.
The people here work
pretty feverishly and get
irritated pretty easily, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
好的。
在实验室里请保持安静。
这里的人工作起来非常狂热，而且很容易烦躁，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
So what exactly did
you need? I'm just an
ordinary researcher,
so I don't know how
much help I could be...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
那你具体需要什么帮助？我只是个普通的研究员，不知道能帮上多少忙...

scripts.text: Show Secret Wing Card.
scripts.translation: 出示秘密之翼会员卡

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Whoa, whoa~!
Careful where you
flash that! Okay, I know
who you are. But we better
continue this someplace
a bit more private...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
哇哦，哇哦~！
小心你亮出那个东西！
好吧，我知道你是谁了。
但我们最好找个更私密的地方继续谈...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Blue, huh? Yeah,
that's what everyone
else here picks. Now
what color would I pick?
Well, that's a secret~
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
蓝色，是吗？没错，这里其他人都会选这个。那我会选什么颜色呢？
嗯，那是个秘密~

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Geez, I've been so
tired lately. Work?
Forget it, I'm gonna
just kick back today~
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
天哪，我最近太累了。工作？
算了，今天我就好好放松一下~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
This is a restricted
area. Please leave
immediately.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
这是限制区域。
请立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
This place should be
safe enough for us to talk
for now, so please listen
carefully. Esuna must have
told you that they beefed
up security lately, right?
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
这里应该足够安全，我们可以暂时在这里交谈，请仔细听我说。
艾斯娜应该告诉过你，最近这里加强了安保措施，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Anyway, since my location
is being monitored, I can't
risk going inside there. You
need to sneak in on your own
when the guards change shifts. It's an old trick, but it works.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
总之，由于我的位置正在被监控，我不能冒险进去。
你需要在卫兵换班时独自潜入。这是个老把戏，但很有效。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My pass will get you inside,
but you'll only be able to
stick around for 3 minutes
at a time. The Secret Archive is to the right of this laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
我的通行证能让你进去，但你每次只能停留3分钟。
秘密档案室在这间实验室的右边。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
When you're finished,
come back and give me
the pass since it'll be real
suspicious if I don't have it.
Good luck to you. This job
is risky, but not impossible.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
完成后，回来把通行证还给我，如果我不在，会很可疑。
祝你好运。这项任务有风险，但并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Remember, you gotta
sneak past that set of
two guards while they're
changing shifts. If you hide
behind a corner and wait for
a bit, you should get lucky.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
记住，你必须在两名卫兵换班时溜过去。如果你躲在拐角处等一会儿，应该能走运。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Once you sneak into the
Secret Archive, look for
the File Search Engine that
should be right next to the
door. You gotta use to find
specific information, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
一旦潜入秘密档案室，寻找就在门边的文件检索引擎。
你必须使用它来查找特定信息，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My suggestion? You really
ought to look for any files
containing any information
regarding ^3355FFRekenber's secret
that Shinokas discovered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
我的建议是？
你最好查找任何包含
^3355FF希诺卡斯发现的雷根贝勒的秘密^000000
相关信息的文件。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Remember that this pass
will get you into the Secret
Archive for only 3 minutes
at a time. Be really careful
and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
记住，这张通行证每次只能让你在秘密档案室停留3分钟。
务必小心，别被抓到！

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My pass will get you inside,
but you'll only be able to
stick around for 3 minutes
at a time. The Secret Archive is to the right of this laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
我的通行证能让你进去，但你每次只能停留3分钟。
秘密档案室在这间实验室的右边。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
When you're finished,
come back and give me
the pass since it'll be real
suspicious if I don't have it.
Good luck to you. This job
is risky, but not impossible.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
完成后，回来把通行证还给我，如果我不在，会很可疑。
祝你好运。这项任务有风险，但并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
You found what you were
looking for? That must have
been like looking for a needle
in a haystick, but you managed
to do it. Great work, guy~
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
你找到你要找的东西了吗？
那一定像是在大海捞针，但你做到了。干得好，伙计~

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
It's a good thing you
found that when you did.
Although it'd help to steal
even more intel, sticking
around even longer makes
it easier for us to get caught.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
幸好你找到了那个。
虽然多偷一些情报会有帮助，但停留时间过长会增加我们被抓的风险。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Alright, you better get
out of here and find Esuna
now. Watch your back and
be careful. We're not all
clear until this is all over.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
好了，你最好赶紧离开这里，去找艾斯娜。小心身后，注意安全。在一切结束之前，我们都不安全。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Esuna should be right
outside of the city of
Lighthalzen where you
found her last time. She'll
know that you're coming.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
艾斯娜应该在里希塔乐镇外，你上次找到她的地方。
她知道你要来。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Oh man...
Everyone here is
getting too paranoid
for their own good!
You better steer clear
from this place for now.
scripts.translation:
[莱斯廷]
天哪...
这里每个人都变得过于多疑了！
你最好暂时远离这个地方。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you approach
the corner, you can
hear hushed whispers
just over the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你走近拐角处时，你可以听到墙那边传来低语声。^000000

scripts.text:
[Senior Guard]
Hey, my shift is over.
Hurry and get the next
guy to relieve me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[资深卫兵]
嘿，我的班结束了。
快点叫下一个人来接班，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie Guard]
Already?
Wow, time sure
flies fast. Fine,
wait here a bit.
scripts.translation:
[新人卫兵]
已经结束了？
哇，时间过得真快。好吧，请稍等一下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the guards left
his post, and now there
is only one remaining
guard monitoring this area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一名卫兵离开了岗位，现在只剩下一名卫兵在监控这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
[Senior Guard]
Criminy...
I need to go to
the bathroom. Well,
I'm sure nothing will
happen while I'm gone.
scripts.translation:
[资深卫兵]
该死...
我得去上厕所。嗯，我走开的时候应该什么事都不会发生。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou listen to the
guard's footsteps as
they grow fainter and
fainter into the distance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你听着卫兵的脚步声越来越远，直到消失在远处。^000000

scripts.text: Sneak in now.
scripts.translation: 现在潜入

scripts.text: Wait for another chance.
scripts.translation: 等待其他机会

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the perfect
opportunity to infiltrate
the Secret Archive! You
approach the door and
find a device where you
can insert Lestin's card pass.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是潜入秘密档案室的绝佳机会！
你走近大门，发现了一个可以插入莱斯廷卡片的装置。^000000

scripts.text: Insert Card
scripts.translation: 插入卡片

scripts.text: Retreat
scripts.translation: 撤退

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou forgot to bring
the card pass that
you got from Lestin.
You need it in order
to open this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你忘记带莱斯廷给你的卡片了。
你需要它才能打开这扇门。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter inserting the
pass, a panel within
the door slides open,
revealing a numeric keypad.
You need to input the correct
password to open the door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF插入卡片后，门内的面板滑开，露出了一个数字键盘。
你需要输入正确的密码才能打开门。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Beep~*
You hear a pleasant
sounding electronic chirp,
signaling that you have input
the correct password. The door
automatically slides open.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*哔~*
你听到一声悦耳的电子提示音，表明你输入了正确的密码。
门自动滑开了。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Retreat
scripts.translation: 撤退

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You have 3 minutes to
search the Information Archive.
When this time elapses, you
will be automatically sent
outside for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
你有3分钟的时间搜索信息档案室。
时间一到，出于安全考虑，你将被自动传送出去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许现在不是进入秘密档案室的最佳时机。
至少，你是这样认为的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Eeeeeee*
The door emits an
unnerving, high pitched
screech after you input
the password. You really
should try to input it again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*吱——*
输入密码后，门发出令人不安的高频尖叫声。
你真的应该再试一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]
*Gzzzzz*
You have entered the
password incorrectly
3 times. Please stand by
for managerial assistance.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
*滋滋*
你连续3次输入了错误的密码。
请等待管理人员协助。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh!
You better get
out of here before
you get caught!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕！
在你被抓到之前，最好赶紧离开这里！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许现在不是进入秘密档案室的最佳时机。
至少，你是这样认为的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许现在不是进入秘密档案室的最佳时机。
至少，你是这样认为的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis machine can be
used to locate specific
documents within the
Secret Archive. However,
you must enter the correct
keywords to in order to find
specific file locations.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这台机器可用于在秘密档案室中定位特定文件。
但是，你必须输入正确的关键词才能找到特定文件的位置。

scripts.text: Search Engine.
scripts.translation: 搜索引擎

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^663300- Search Engine Initiated -
- Please enter a keyword -
 
*Search Engine
is case sensitve.
Please do not use
capital letters.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300- 搜索引擎已启动 -
- 请输入关键词 -
 
*搜索引擎区分大小写。
请不要使用大写字母。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Kafra Corporation and
Cool Event Corp are
located in Arena 3-2.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于卡普拉总公司和酷活动公司的文件位于竞技场3-2。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Shinokas are located
in Arena 1-5.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于希诺卡斯的文件位于竞技场1-5。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
S.T.E.I.N are considered
highly classified and
cannot be accessed
through this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于S.T.E.I.N的文件属于高度机密，无法通过此系统访问。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Ymir's Heart are ranked
as highly classified and
cannot be accessed
through this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于依美乐的心脏的文件属于高度机密，无法通过此系统访问。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
2nd Class documents on
President Karl Weierstrass
are located in Area 1-7. For
more highly classified files
on Weierstrass, please use
a higher security archive.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于卡尔·魏尔斯特拉斯总裁的二级文件位于区域1-7。
如需查阅关于魏尔斯特拉斯的更高级别机密文件，请使用更高安全级别的档案库。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Einbroch are stored
in Area 6-1.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于艾音布罗克的文件存储在区域6-1。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Lighthalzen are stored
in Area 3-3.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于里希塔乐镇的文件存储在区域3-3。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Rekenber are highly classified and cannot be accessed by this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
关于雷根贝勒的文件属于高度机密，无法通过此系统访问。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Keyword not found.
Please search another
archive or increase
access permissions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索结果]
未找到关键词。
请搜索其他档案库或提升访问权限。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Engine Close]
File search has been
canceled. Please be aware
that sudden shutdown may
cause system errors.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜索引擎关闭]
文件搜索已取消。
请注意，突然关闭可能会导致系统错误。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis machine can be
used to locate specific
documents within the
Secret Archive, However,
you no longer need to
search through the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这台机器可用于在机密档案库中定位特定文件。
不过，你现在不再需要搜索这些文件了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这是限制区域。
如果没有特别授权，请保持距离。
谢谢配合。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door is shut, but
there is a device that
looks sort of like the
entry keypad that was on
the other side of this door.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF门是关着的，但有一个装置，看起来有点像这扇门另一侧的入口键盘。^000000

scripts.text: Manipulate device.
scripts.translation: 操作装置

scripts.text: Investigate further.
scripts.translation: 进一步调查

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you touch the
device, it automatically
responds and the door
quickly slides open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一旦你触摸装置，它会自动响应，门迅速滑开了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有成千上万的文件需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分钟内在这里找到有价值的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait, one of these files
looks pretty incriminating.
It seems to contain the
kind of information that
you've been looking for.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等，其中一份文件看起来很有罪证。
它似乎包含你一直在寻找的那种信息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717A piece of Ymir's Heart
was uncovered in one of
the mines in Einbech and
immediately transported to
the Laboratory for research.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717在艾音贝赫的一座矿场中发现了一块依美乐心脏堆积物，并立即被运往实验室进行研究。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717However, something
happened to the miners
who discovered the piece
of Ymir's Heart. Apparently,
a beast from Einbroch folk
lore inhabited the area...^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717然而，发现依美乐心脏堆积物的矿工们发生了意外。
显然，艾音布罗克民间传说中栖息在该地区的野兽...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有成千上万的文件需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分钟内在这里找到有价值的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis looks like a file
containing information
on President Weierstrauss.
Perhaps there's something
in here that might be helpful.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这看起来像是一份包含魏尔斯特拉斯总裁信息的文件。
也许这里有一些可能有用的东西。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Karl Weierstrass has
been a long distinguished
politician in the Schwarzwald
Republic and was elected as
its president in the year 984.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717卡尔·魏尔斯特拉斯是秀发兹发德共和国一位久负盛名的政治家，于984年当选为该国的总裁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although he has enjoyed
high popularity ratings and
success in his endorsing his
policies, Wierstrass is rumored
to be have some sort of feud
against Rekenber.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717尽管他享有高支持率并在推行其政策方面取得成功，但据传魏尔斯特拉斯与雷根贝勒之间存在某种敌对关系。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although there is no
need to bring this to the
attention of the media, it
is highly recommended
to monitor his activities
throughout his term...^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717虽然没有必要让媒体注意到这一点，但强烈建议在整个任期内监控他的活动...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a great amount
of information in this file,
but it doesn't look like any
of it will be of help to you.
You should continue with
your search for evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件包含大量信息，但看起来对你没有任何帮助。
你应该继续寻找证据。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件看起来不包含任何对你有帮助的证据。
你应该继续翻阅其余的文件。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有成千上万的文件需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分钟内在这里找到有价值的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a file
containing information
on the Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你找到了一份文件，其中包含关于卡普拉总公司和酷活动公司的信息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Rekenber Corporation.
in an effort to expand its
power into the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, will cooperate with
and support Cool Event Corp.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717雷根贝勒公司为了将其势力扩展至卢恩·米德加兹王国，将与酷活动公司进行合作并提供支持。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although this partnership
has been greatly successful,
Kafra Corporation has been
working to check Cool Event
Corp's explosive growth.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717尽管这次合作取得了巨大的成功，但卡普拉总公司一直在努力遏制酷活动公司的爆发式增长。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717More than Kafra Corporation's
lobbying, Kafra's 3rd Security
Team stands as a formidable
threat to our success. One of
our highest priorities is to
investigate their activities.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717除了卡普拉总公司的游说活动外，卡普拉第三安保队构成了对我们成功的巨大威胁。
调查他们的活动是我们最高优先级的任务之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717It is believed that Kafra's
3rd Security Team has alrady
placed secret agents in key
strategic locations within
the Schwarzwald Republic.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717据信，卡普拉第三安保队已经在秀发兹发德共和国的关键战略地点安插了特工。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file is very intriguing,
but it doesn't really cover
any information that can be
considered incriminating.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这份文件非常引人入胜，但它并没有涵盖任何可以被视为定罪证据的信息。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件看起来不包含任何对你有帮助的证据。
你应该继续翻阅其余的文件。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有成千上万的文件需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分钟内在这里找到有价值的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717...After negotiating with
the existing residents, all of
the property rights were sold
and the city was renamed
''Lighthalzen'' in 865.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717...在与现有居民谈判后，所有产权均已售出，该城市于865年更名为“里希塔乐镇”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717The city was then separated
into three districts. These are
the common trade district, the
old residential district and
the Rekenber Headquarters.
.................^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717随后，该城市被划分为三个区域：
普通商业区、旧居民区以及雷根贝勒总部。
.................^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file covers
Lighthalzen's history.
However, the founding of
the city is common knowlege,
so this document probably won't
have any significant evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件记载了里希塔乐镇的历史。
然而，城市的建立是众所周知的事情，因此这份文件可能不包含任何重要证据。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件看起来不包含任何对你有帮助的证据。
你应该继续翻阅其余的文件。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有成千上万的文件需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分钟内在这里找到有价值的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717........
Our organization purchased
all of western Einbech and
began construction of Einbroch
in 927 in order to obtain more
pieces of Ymir's Heart.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717........
我们的组织买下了艾音贝赫西部地区的所有土地，并于927年开始建造艾音布罗克，以获取更多依美乐心脏堆积物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Unofficially, each and
every single factory belongs
to the Rekenber Corporation.
Their highest priority is
to uncover Ymir Heart Pieces...^000000
scripts.translation:
[机密情报]
^8C1717非官方地讲，每一家工厂都属于雷根贝勒公司。
他们的最高优先级是寻找依美乐心脏堆积物...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlthough this file contains
surprising information about
Einbroch, none of it can be
considered to be incriminating
evidence against Rekenber.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF虽然这份文件包含关于艾音布罗克的惊人信息，但其中没有任何内容可以被视为针对雷根贝勒的定罪证据。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这份文件看起来不包含任何对你有帮助的证据。
你应该继续翻阅其余的文件。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务将部分物品存入仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF周围散落着几台坏掉的机器，看起来完全没用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.
However, you catch the
glimmer of a dim light
amongst the scrap metal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF周围散落着几台坏掉的机器，看起来完全没用。
然而，你在废铁中捕捉到了一丝微弱的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate it.
scripts.translation: 调查一下

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter digging through
the discarded machinery,
you find a strange rock that
is about as large as your fist
and shimmers with a faint glow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在翻找废弃的机器后，你发现了一块奇怪的岩石，大小约如拳头，散发着微弱的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: This might be important.
scripts.translation: 这可能很重要

scripts.text: This doesn't seem useful.
scripts.translation: 这似乎没什么用

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis weird rock
might be just the
thing that ^000000Ghalstein^3355FF
sent you here to find.
He was probably right
not to describe it to you.
Words alone aren't enough...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这块奇怪的岩石可能正是^000000加尔斯坦^3355FF
派你来寻找的东西。
他当时没有向你描述它，可能是对的。
光靠语言是无法形容的...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust because this rock
looks funny doesn't make
it any more special than
the countless number of
rocks you've seen in
your entire lifetime.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF仅仅因为这块岩石看起来奇怪，并不意味着它比你一生中见过的无数块岩石更特别。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat can possibly
be of value in this
pile of useless junk?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这堆没用的垃圾里怎么可能有什么有价值的东西？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF周围散落着几台坏掉的机器，看起来完全没用。^000000

scripts.text:
[Patch]
Tell me what you want.
scripts.translation:
[帕奇]
告诉我你想要什么。

scripts.text: Current Variables
scripts.translation: 当前变量

scripts.text: How Many
scripts.translation: 数量

scripts.text: Shinokas - Quest Complete
scripts.translation: 希诺卡斯 - 任务完成

scripts.text:
[Kudiuu]
Holy...!
Will this place
ever get cleaned up?!
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 There's
so much dust here, it's
almost a health hazard!
scripts.translation:
[库迪乌]
天哪...！
这个地方到底什么时候才能清理干净？！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 这里的灰尘太多了，简直危害健康！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Just...
Leave me alone.
I feel nothing but
guilt when I see you.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
请...
别管我了。
看到你，我只感到愧疚。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Don't take it the wrong
way. I mean, it's not like
you did nothing wrong. I'm
the one who's... Geez. I wish
I could live the way you do.
Someday I'll be strong enough...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
别误会。我的意思是，并不是说你没做错什么。
是我...唉。我真希望能像你一样生活。
总有一天我会变得足够强大...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back. As usual,
you've done a good job. You
look exhausted: did you run
into those thugs again?
Why don't you take a rest?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿，你回来了。一如既往，你做得很好。你看起来很疲惫：
又遇到那些恶棍了吗？
不如休息一下？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kazien...
While I was fighting
those thugs, one of the
packages was accidentally
opened, and I saw what was
inside of those packages.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡济恩...
在我与那些恶棍战斗时，其中一个包裹意外打开了，我看到了包裹里的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-why are you supplying
those things? If we let those
packages get imported by
other countries, it can
cause a lot of trouble...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为-为什么你要提供这些东西？
如果让其他国家进口这些包裹，可能会引起很多麻烦...！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Stop. Please.
J-just stop it.
I don't want to
hear anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
停下。求你了。
就-就停下吧。
我不想再听了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold it, I deserve an
answer! How can you turn
a blind eye and provide just
anyone with ^FF0000hi-tech weapons
and guardians^000000? It's like you're
promoting war and violence!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我有权知道答案！
你怎么能视而不见，向任何人提供
^FF0000高科技武器和守卫^000000？这简直是在煽动战争和暴力！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And what about your little
brother Lyozien? He has
no idea what he's doing!
Don't we have a responsibility
to the world to make sure these
weapons aren't distributed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有你的弟弟廖齐恩？他根本不知道自己在做什么！
我们难道没有责任确保这些武器不被分发吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Shut up! You don't
know anything! Just
shut up! I'm doing this
for the sake of my family!
You don't know what it's like
to live in Lighthalzen's slums!
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
闭嘴！你什么都不知道！
给我闭嘴！我做这一切都是为了我的家人！
你不知道生活在里希塔乐镇的贫民窟是什么滋味！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
There'd be days when my
brother and I'd have nothing
to eat. So when I heard about
this job, I took it. What good
is world peace if I'm not even
alive to enjoy it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
有时候我和弟弟连饭都吃不上。所以当我听说这份工作，我就接了。如果我连命都没了，世界和平又有什么意义呢？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Now, my brother Lyozien is
a gentle soul, has nothing
but love for everybody. So, of
course I can't tell him what
I'm really doing--he'd never
agree to it, believe me.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我的弟弟廖齐恩是个温柔的人，对所有人都充满爱意。所以，我当然不能告诉他我真正在做的事——
相信我，他绝不会同意的。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I hate this job and what
I'm doing and I want to quit.
But then what? Go back to the
slums? Forget it. As long as
Lyozien is happy, I don't mind if I have to do the devil's work.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我讨厌这份工作，讨厌我在做的事，我想辞职。但然后呢？
回到贫民窟？算了吧。
只要廖齐恩幸福，我不介意去干魔鬼的活。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
At least this way, keeping
it all secret, I can protect
Lyozien from the ugly nature
of this job, even if I'm dirtying my hands, making money
off of other people's deaths.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
至少这样，通过保守秘密，我可以保护廖齐恩，让他远离这份工作的丑陋本质，即使我双手沾满鲜血，靠别人的死亡赚钱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But that still isn't right.
You're selling weapons so
that people can kill each other! Even if it's for the sake of
providing for your family...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但这依然不对。
你是在卖武器，让人们互相残杀！
即使是为了养家糊口...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look man, this is what
I decided. I don't care
what other people'll think.
I might go to hell when
I die, but that's my problem.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，这是我做的决定。
我不在乎别人怎么想。
我死后可能下地狱，但那是我的问题。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Besides, you adventurers
are always running around
with your swords and magic spells... Isn't that just as bad?
It's not the weapons or the power that's bad: it's how they're used.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
而且，你们冒险者总是拿着剑和魔法到处跑...
这难道不是一样吗？
错的不是武器或力量，而是它们的使用方式。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Granted, most of my clients
are pretty questionable, and
you adventurers usually use
your powers for good, but...
Damn it! Just... Don't come
back. I can't work like this...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
当然，我的大多数客户都挺可疑的，你们冒险者通常用力量做好事，但是...
该死！总之...别回来了。
我没法这样工作...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, I can't have
you working with me
and Lyozien anymore.
Sorry, but it's for Lyozien's
own good. That, and you
make me feel guilty...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，我不能让你继续和我和廖齐恩一起工作了。
抱歉，但这都是为了廖齐恩好。
而且，你让我感到愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey now, you better
get a move on. You gotta
assist another delivery to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿，你最好快点行动。
你得协助另一笔送往卢恩·米德加兹王国的货物。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Ah, I heard from Lyozien
that you guys finished your
delivery. You're probably
the best part-timer that I've
had in a long, long while.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
啊，我听廖齐恩说你们完成了送货。
你们大概是我很久以来遇到的最好的兼职人员了。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Anyway, we've got yet
another delivery for the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. It's
weird that we're getting more
orders from there, but orders from other countries are decreasing.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
总之，我们又有一笔送往卢恩·米德加兹王国的货物。
奇怪的是，来自那里的订单越来越多，但来自其他国家的订单却在减少。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Eh, I don't have the time
to wonder about stuff like
that. Lyozien's waiting for
you, so get to it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
呃，我没时间想这些。
廖齐恩在等你，所以快点去吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! During the last
delivery, I was attacked
by a group of thugs that
wanted to destroy the
packages? Why would
they want to do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！在上一次送货时，我被一群恶棍袭击了，他们想破坏包裹？
他们为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look... You're better
off not knowing. Or are
you asking me to pay you
more for this job since
you're risking your life?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着...你最好别知道。
还是说你想让我因为你在冒生命危险而给你多付点钱？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand that the
customer's confidentiality
is important, but I'd feel a
lot better if I knew what was
in those packages, and why me
and Lyozien are being attacked.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我理解顾客的保密性很重要，但如果我知道包裹里是什么，以及为什么我和廖齐恩会被袭击，我会安心很多。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Listen, I'm not obligated--
I can't tell you. Heck, I can't
even tell my own brother what's
in those packages. You can see
that, can't you? Anyway, you
can handle those thugs, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，我没有义务——
我不能告诉你。
天哪，我甚至不能告诉我亲弟弟包裹里是什么。你能理解吧？
总之，你能对付那些恶棍，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Right. Now get back to
the Airship and talk to
Lyozien again. Don't give
him any trouble and make
sure you protect him.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
没错。现在回到飞空艇，再和廖齐恩谈谈。
别给他添麻烦，并确保保护他。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
What are you doing
waiting around here
for? You've got a job to
do, so hurry up and do it~
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
你在这里等什么？
你有工作要做，所以快点去做吧~

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back. I got a
message from Rune-Midgarts,
telling us they received their
order. Good work! So how do
you like working with Lyozien?
He's one of my best men.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿，你回来了。我收到卢恩·米德加兹的消息，说他们收到了订单。
干得好！那么，你觉得和廖齐恩一起工作怎么样？
他是我手下最好的人之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, aren't you and
Lyozien supposed
to be brothers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你和廖齐恩不是兄弟吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whoa, he told you that?
I guess he feels that he
can trust you enough with
that kind of personal talk...
Yeah, he's my little brother.
And a better man than me...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哇，他都告诉你了？
看来他觉得已经足够信任你，才会跟你聊这些私事...
没错，他是我弟弟。
而且他比我强多了...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I've gotten my hands
pretty dirty doing this...
Oh, forget it. You came 
here for a job, right?
Luckily, I got another
delivery for you to work on...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我在这行里摸爬滚打，手上沾了不少脏东西...
算了，不提了。你是来找工作吧？
幸好，我正好还有一单送货任务交给你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, Kazien...
I was curious. What
exactly are we delivering?
I mean, not even Lyozien
doesn't know exactly what
is in those packages.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，卡济恩...
我有点好奇。
我们到底在送什么？
我是说，连廖齐恩都不清楚包裹里具体是什么。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Huh... Does that mean
you can't work with us if
you don't know exactly what
you're doing?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嗯...那意思是说，如果你不知道自己在做什么，就不能跟我们合作吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
 Come on, I told
you before--absolute secrecy.
It goes both ways, you know.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
拜托，我之前说过——
绝对保密。
这是双向的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, for your own good,
quit asking. Knowing what
you're delivering wouldn't
change a thing. Trust me.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，为了你好，别再问了。知道你在送什么也不会改变任何事。相信我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Anyway, this next job is
more of the same. Meet
Lyozien in the international
flight Airship and protect
another package destined
for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
总之，下一个任务还是老样子。去国际航线飞空艇找廖齐恩，保护另一个送往卢恩·米德加兹王国的包裹。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Alright, I'll see you
later. The important
thing is that you do the
best job that you can.
And don't give Lyozien
any trouble: that's my job!
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
好了，回头见。
重要的是你要尽力做好工作。
还有，别给廖齐恩添麻烦：
那是我的职责！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Lyozien is waiting for
you on the international
flight Airship, so go and
meet him there as soon
as you can. Alright then,
I'll see you later.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
廖齐恩正在国际航线飞空艇等你，所以尽快去那里和他碰面。那么，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back~
Great, I guess that means
that you've decided to work
for us! Alright, let me tell you about your first real job. As
always: ^FF0000keep it on the down-low^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿，你回来了~
很好，看来你决定为我们工作了！好吧，让我告诉你你的第一个正式任务。
一如既往：^FF0000保持低调^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Go to the Airship for the
international flights, not
the domestic ones, and meet
a man named ^FF0000Lyozien^000000 inside.
He's our courier that'll provide you with further instructions.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
去国际航线飞空艇，不是国内航线，在里面找一位名叫^FF0000廖齐恩^000000的人。
他是我们的信使，会给你进一步的指示。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh. You can talk to Lyozien
about the job, but definitely
not to anybody else. Anyway,
when you're done with what
he asks you to do, come back
to me for another job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦。你可以和廖齐恩谈工作，但绝对不能跟其他人说。总之，做完他让你做的事后，回来找我接下一个任务，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Don't forget...
Talk to ^FF0000Lyozien^000000, our
courier, on the Airship
for the international flights.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
别忘了...
去国际航线飞空艇找我们的信使^FF0000廖齐恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh, hey, it's you again.
Wait. No. You only remind
me of someone I've met. Um,
have we met before? I don't
remember at all. Oooh, I hate
being this busy, I can't focus!
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦，嘿，又是你。
等等。不。你只是让我想起了我认识的某个人。嗯，我们以前见过吗？我完全不记得了。
噢，我讨厌这么忙，我没法集中注意力！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Arrgh, this is not good.
We are this busy but we don't have enough people,
yet it is not that extrememly bad
to a point that we need to hire more people.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
啊，这情况不妙。
我们这么忙，但人手不够，不过也没坏到需要再招人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Will you step back? You are hindering my vision.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
你能退后一点吗？
你挡住我的视线了。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh, hey, it's you again.
Listen, you didn't come here
looking for a part time job,
did you? I already told you
that I can't bring myself
to trust you, you know?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦，嘿，又是你。
听着，你不是来找兼职工作的吧？我已经告诉过你，我没法信任你，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, you're not a bad guy,
so I'm sure you'd be perfect
for some other employer.
Don't feel bad... Um, what
was your name again? Wait,
did you even give it to me...?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，你不是坏人，所以我确信你会很适合其他雇主。别难过... 嗯，你叫什么来着？等等，你甚至没告诉我名字...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
So, were you able to
contact Garins? Or did
you encounter any problems?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
那么，你联系上加林斯了吗？还是遇到了什么问题？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I came back to
let you know that I haven't
been able to find a way inside
the Einbroch Laboratory. There
was the guard, but I couldn't
really tell him anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我回来是想告诉你，我还没找到进入艾音布罗克实验室的方法。
那里有卫兵，但我真的没法跟他说什么。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whaaaat~?
I'm sure he would
have let you in if you
told him that you had
to talk to Garins, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
什...什么~？
如果你告诉他你需要和加林斯谈谈，他肯定会让你进去的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But...
I thought you said
I'm not supposed to
tell anyone the details
of my assignment?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是...
你不是说我不应该告诉任何人任务细节吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Heh... Yeah.
Yeah, that's right.
Heh heh heh! Hahahaha!
Great! I'm happy to say,
buddy, you passed the test!
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿... 是啊。
没错，就是这样。
嘿嘿嘿！哈哈哈！
太好了！我很高兴地说，巴迪，你通过了测试！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-huh? But I never
even got to see Garins...
I didn't finish the task
that you assigned to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？但我甚至都没见到加林斯...
我没有完成你分配给我的任务。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Garins is just some
cool name I made up.
He doesn't really exist.
I just wanted to test your
trustworthiness, is all.
Now do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
加林斯只是我编的一个酷名字。
他根本不存在。
我只是想测试一下你的可靠性，仅此而已。
现在你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I guess.
Still, you just tricked
me! How am I supposed
to trust you now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我... 我想是吧。
不过，你刚才骗了我！
我现在该怎么信任你呢？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh... You...
You got a point, there.
Huh, now isn't that ironic? I'm sorry, pal, let me apologize.
Take some time, consider working for me, and then come back, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦... 你...
你说得有道理。
哈，这不是很讽刺吗？抱歉，伙计，让我道个歉。
花点时间考虑一下是否为我工作，然后回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
So, were you able to
contact Garins? Or did
you encounter any problems?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
那么，你联系上加林斯了吗？还是遇到了什么问题？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I wasn't able to
find him. In fact, I don't
think that Garins even works
at the Einbroch Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我没能找到他。事实上，我认为加林斯甚至不在艾音布罗克实验室工作。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whaaaat~?
That can't be true.
Well, how'd you
find that out?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
什...什么~？
这不可能。
那你是怎么发现这一点的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I happened to ask the
Laboratory Guard, but
he wouldn't even let me in.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我碰巧问了实验室卫兵，但他甚至不让我进去。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Uh oh...
I thought so.
I'm sorry, pal, but
you failed the test.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哎呀...
我就知道。
抱歉，伙计，但你没通过测试。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-huh? What?
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？什么？
你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
You told that to the guard,
but you weren't supposed
to let anyone know any detail
about your assignment. Yeah...
Garins is just a name I made
up. He doesn't really exist.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
你把这些告诉卫兵了，但你本不应该让任何人知道任务细节。是的...
加林斯只是我编的名字。
他根本不存在。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I know you meant well,
you know, doing whatever
you can to finish whatever
goal you have, but you can't
forget the details. Anyway,
sorry, but we can't use you...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我知道你是出于好意，你知道，尽你所能去完成你的目标，但你不能忘记细节。总之，抱歉，但我们无法使用你...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Remember, visit ^FF0000Garins^000000
in the ^FF0000Einbroch Laboratory^000000
and ^FF0000confirm that he received
his order^000000. We pride ourselves
in our clients' confidentiality,^FFFFFF  ^000000 so keep it secret, got it?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
记住，去^FF0000艾音布罗克实验室^000000
拜访^FF0000加林斯^000000，并^FF0000确认他收到了订单^000000。我们以客户的保密性为荣，^FFFFFF  ^000000所以保守秘密，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I'll just be waiting
around over here, so
once you're done with
that, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我就在这里等着，所以等你办完那件事后，回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Okay, I got it! Your first
assignment for us is pretty
simple, but think of it as
something of a trial run.
You know, for us to see
how reliable you are.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
好的，我明白了！你为我们的第一个任务相当简单，但你可以把它看作一种试运行。
你知道，为了让我们看看你有多可靠。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
All you gotta do is head
to Einbroch, find the Lab
there, and find a researcher
named Garins. You need to
confirm whether he safely
received his order from us.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
你只需要去艾音布罗克，找到那里的实验室，并找到一位名叫加林斯的研究员。你需要确认他是否安全地收到了我们寄出的订单。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Simple stuff, yeah?
Now, you can't let anyone
know about your assignment.
Otherwise, we can't trust you
for more important stuff. And
I really wanna trust you.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
很简单，对吧？
现在，你不能让任何人知道你的任务。
否则，我们就无法信任你处理更重要的事情。而且我真的很想信任你。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Remember, visit ^FF0000Garins^000000
in the ^FF0000Einbroch Laboratory^000000
and ^FF0000confirm that he received
his order^000000. We pride ourselves
in our clients' confidentiality, so keep it secret, got it?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
记住，去^FF0000艾音布罗克实验室^000000
拜访^FF0000加林斯^000000，并^FF0000确认他收到了订单^000000。我们以客户的保密性为荣，所以保守秘密，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I'll just be waiting
around over here, so
once you're done with
that, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我就在这里等着，所以等你办完那件事后，回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
We're so busy, we barely
have enough people to cover
our workload right now. Still,
it's not so bad that we gotta
invest in some new hires.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我们忙得不可开交，现在人手几乎不够用了。不过还好，还没到必须立刻招新人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh hey, sorry buddy,
but you mind stepping
back? It's just that you're
blocking my view is all.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦，嘿，抱歉，伙计，你介意往后退一点吗？
只是你挡住我的视线了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, did you just say
that you need help?
I'd like to help solve
your problem, er, for
a nominal fee or some
kind of reward. You know...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你刚才说需要帮忙？
我想帮你解决这个问题，当然，是收取一点小费或者某种报酬。你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, alright~
I could use an extra
hand if you're willing
to work part time. Plus,
you're a straight shooter.
I like that. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嘿，好啊~
如果你愿意做兼职，我确实需要多一双手。
而且，你是个直率的人。
我喜欢这样。让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Awww, I'm sorry, pal.
I know you mean well, but
to put it bluntly, you're not
not strong enough for this
kinda work. Hey, but if you put on
some muscle, ask me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哎呀，抱歉，朋友。
我知道你是一番好意，但直白地说，你的力气还不足以胜任这种工作。
嘿，如果你能练出点肌肉，再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Yeah, okay. You look like
you can handle this. But
are you the type of person
I can trust? Hey, you can
keep confidential information
without telling anyone, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
嗯，好的。你看起来能胜任这份工作。但是，你是那种我可以信任的人吗？
嘿，你能保守机密，不告诉任何人，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, of course.
scripts.translation: 是的，当然

scripts.text: Nope, I love giving away secrets.
scripts.translation: 不，我热爱分享秘密

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Great, great.
I guess we can just
get down to business,
then. Let me think. First,
I should give you something
easy to do to test you out...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
很好，很好。
看来我们可以直接谈正事了。
让我想想。首先，我应该给你一件简单的事做做测试...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Awww, man.
I can't hire you
if you're gonna blab
your mouth. Sorry buddy,
but I can't afford to take
any risks. You understand...
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哎呀，真是的。
如果你到处乱说，我就不能雇你了。
抱歉，伙计，我承担不起任何风险。
你懂的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
We're so busy, we barely
have enough people to cover
our workload right now. Still,
it's not so bad that we gotta
invest in some new hires.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
我们忙得不可开交，现在人手几乎不够用了。不过还好，还没到必须立刻招新人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh hey, sorry buddy,
but you mind stepping
back? It's just that you're
blocking my view is all.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
哦，嘿，抱歉，伙计，你介意往后退一点吗？
只是你挡住我的视线了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Lately, Kazien seems
to be having a hard time
managing his business.
Always complaining that
he lacks the manpower...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近，卡济恩似乎在经营生意上遇到了困难。
他总是抱怨人手不足...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't know what kind of
business he's conducting,
but why don't you help him
out? I don't believe that any
particularly special skills are
required for some positions.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我不知道他在做什么生意，但为什么你不帮他一把呢？
我相信某些职位并不需要特别特殊的技能。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, if you're interested,
you can find Kazien inside
the corporation building.
Young people like him should
never be too proud to ask for help. He still needs to learn...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，如果你感兴趣，你可以在公司大楼里找到卡济恩。
像他这样的年轻人不应该因为求助而感到骄傲。他还需要学习...

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Hold it! This is
a restricted area to
the public! Unless you
have some special business,
you'll have to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[实验室卫兵]
站住！这里是禁止公众进入的区域！
除非你有特别的事务，否则你必须立刻离开。

scripts.text: Actually, I do have business here.
scripts.translation: 实际上，我确实有事务要办

scripts.text: Whoa, I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 哇，我这就走！

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Yes? State the nature
of your business here,
as well as any person that
you wish to contact inside
of this laboratory facility.
scripts.translation:
[实验室卫兵]
是吗？请说明你在这里的事务性质，以及你想在这个实验室设施内联系的任何人。

scripts.text: I need to see Mr. Garins...
scripts.translation: 我要见加林斯先生...

scripts.text: I'll... come back later.
scripts.translation: 我...稍后再来

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to see Mr. Garins
and confirm that he received
a package that was sent to him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要见加林斯先生，并确认他是否收到了寄给他的包裹。

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Garins, eh?
Alright, let me check
the employee list. Hmm...
Garins... Garins... Eh?
He's not here. Maybe you
came to the wrong place?
scripts.translation:
[实验室卫兵]
加林斯？
好的，让我查一下员工名单。嗯...
加林斯...加林斯...咦？
这里没有这个人。你是不是来错地方了？

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Sorry, but it looks like
you've wasted your time.
We don't have a Garins
working here. Anyway,
I still can't allow you to
enter the laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[实验室卫兵]
抱歉，看来你白跑一趟了。
我们这里没有叫加林斯的员工。
总之，我还是不能让你进入实验室。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll... come back later.
(^333333I better speak to Kazien
and let him know I'm having
trouble getting past this
guard. Otherwise, I might
never finish this job!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...稍后再来。
(^333333我得去和卡济恩谈谈，告诉他我被这个卫兵拦住了。
不然，我可能永远都完不成这个任务了！^000000)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, I'm leaving!
(^333333I better speak to Kazien
and let him know I'm having
trouble getting past this
guard. Otherwise, I might
never finish this job!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，我这就走！
(^333333我得去和卡济恩谈谈，告诉他我被这个卫兵拦住了。
不然，我可能永远都完不成这个任务了！^000000)

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public. Unless you
have some kind of special
authorization, I'm going
to have to ask you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[实验室卫兵]
此区域禁止公众进入。
除非你有特殊的通行证，否则我必须请你离开。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, I hear from my
brother that you can't work
with us anymore because
of some scheduling conflict.
I'm sorry to hear that: it was
really good working with you...
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嘿，我听说因为排班冲突，你不能再和我们合作了。
听到这个消息我很遗憾：
和你共事真的很愉快...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh good, you're back.
Mr. Ahman just left and
picked up his goods. We're
done here, so all you have to
do now is report to my
brother in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
哦，你回来了。
阿赫曼先生刚走，已经取走了他的货物。我们这边结束了，你现在只需要去里希塔乐镇向我哥哥汇报即可。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
You sure you're alright?
You seem kind of upset.
Do you need to take a
break or something?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
你确定没事吗？
你看起来有点不高兴。
需要休息一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Heya, keep up the
good work. Once you
talk to Mr. Ahman inside
Izlude Airport, we'll be
done with this delivery.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嘿，继续加油。
等你在依斯鲁得机场和阿赫曼先生谈完，这次配送任务就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Whoa, you were great!
There were more of them
this time, but you easily
dispatched them. Great job!
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
哇，你太厉害了！
这次它们更多，但你轻松就解决了。干得好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks, but...
Now I'm really worried
about what could be in
those packages. Are you
sure you don't know, Lyozien?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢，但是...
我现在真的很担心那些包裹里装的是什么。
你确定不知道吗，廖齐恩？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
You don't know when to
stop, do you? Nah, I don't
know at all. Besides, so long
as my brother says it's a bad
idea, then I don't wanna find
out for myself. Oh, hey...
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
你真是没完没了啊。
不，我完全不知道。而且，既然我哥哥说这是坏主意，那我也不想自己去弄清楚。哦，对了...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Here's a little
something to refresh
yourself after that fight.
Keep up the good work, okay?
Then, we'll be done once you
contact Mr. Ahman in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
给你一点小东西，让你在那场战斗后恢复一下。
继续加油，好吗？
然后，等你联系上依斯鲁得的阿赫曼先生，我们就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Okay, just like before, we
gotta get these packages to
Mr. Ahmam. When we arrive
in Izlude, find Mr. Ahman in
the Airport and tell him that
his packages have arrived.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
好的，和之前一样，我们要把这些包裹送到阿赫曼先生那里。当我们到达依斯鲁得时，在机场找到阿赫曼先生，告诉他他的包裹到了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
W-wait...
Did you hear that?
I heard--I think it's them.
Those thugs are back! Don't
let them damage the packages!
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
等...等一下...
你听到了吗？
我听到--我想是它们。
那些恶棍又回来了！
别让他们损坏包裹！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I heard that you upset
Kyozien a little bit with
your questions. I mean,
I totally understand, but
you gotta remember that
we've got obligations.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
我听说你的问题让卡济恩有点不高兴。我是说，我完全理解，但你得记住，我们有我们的职责。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I know that these packages
might be putting us in danger,
but I trust my brother. If he says those thugs are bad guys, then
they're definitely bad guys.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
我知道这些包裹可能会让我们陷入危险，但我信任我哥哥。如果他说那些恶棍是坏人，那他们肯定就是坏人。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Yeah, ever since we were
kids, Kyozien has always
been right. Even though
I'd like to know what's in the
boxes, I don't ever wanna
disappoint him, you know?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
是啊，从小时候起，卡济恩总是对的。虽然我很想知道箱子里装的是什么，但我永远不想让他失望，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Anyway, that's
enough chit-chat
for now. Let's get
back to work, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
好了，闲聊就到这里。
让我们继续工作，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I'm lucky that you're
around to keep those
thugs off our backs, eh?
Hey, when you're ready for
another job, just talk to
my brother Kazien, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
有你在身边帮我赶走那些恶棍，真是我的幸运，不是吗？
嘿，当你准备好接下一个任务时，直接去找我哥哥卡济恩，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
So you spoke to
Mr. Ahman already?
Good, good. Now we can
go back to the Schwarzwald
Republic for our next job.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
你已经和阿赫曼先生谈过了吗？
很好，很好。那我们现在可以回秀发兹发德共和国，准备下一个任务了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Just talk to my brother
Kazien and he should give
you any details you need
to know. Man, it's good
that you're working for us.
Those thugs frighten me...
[Lyozien]
Now I feeel much more secure.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
直接去找我哥哥卡济恩，他会告诉你所有你需要知道的细节。天哪，真高兴你在为我们工作。
那些恶棍让我很害怕...
[廖齐恩]
现在我感觉安全多了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Now that those thugs are
gone, let's concentrate on
our task. Like before, just
get off at Izlude and then tell
Mr. Ahman that his packages
have arrived. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
既然那些恶棍已经走了，让我们专心处理任务吧。和之前一样，在依斯鲁得岛下船，然后告诉阿赫曼先生他的包裹已经送达。回头见~

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh, thank you!
You saved my life!
As you can tell, I'm
not much of a fighter...
I just ran and hid when
those thugs appeared.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
哦，谢谢你！
你救了我的命！
你也看出来了，我并不是什么格斗家...
当那些恶棍出现时，我只是逃跑并躲了起来。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
That's one reason why
my brother has been hiring
you adventurers-- we need
packages from those hoodlums.
They're always after us...
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
这就是我哥哥一直雇你们冒险者的原因之一——
我们需要有人保护包裹，不被那些恶棍抢走。
他们总是纠缠我们...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Every time I see them,
they're yelling things like
we're the servants of evil,
or that the packages must
be destroyed. Boy, I sure
am glad that you're here!
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
每次看到他们，他们都在大喊大叫，说我们是邪恶的仆从，或者说必须销毁那些包裹。天哪，真高兴你在这里！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, we already have another
package to deliver all the way
to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
again. Can you believe it? We
seem to be doing a lot of
business around there lately.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嘿，我们又有另一个包裹要送到卢恩·米德加兹王国了。
你能相信吗？我们最近在那边的生意似乎很多。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
It's so far away from
home, but a job's a job.
We're obliged to do what
we're been assigned to do
until we qui--whoa. You
hear that? Wh-what was...?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
虽然离家很远，但工作就是工作。
我们有义务完成被分配的任务，直到我们辞——
哇。你听到了吗？什...刚才那是...？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Awwww, nuts!
It's those thugs!
I'll explain later, but
for now, please protect
the packages and make
sure they don't get them!
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
哎呀，糟了！
又是那些恶棍！
我稍后解释，但现在请保护好包裹，确保他们拿不到！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, would you go see
my brother Kazien to see
if he's got another job for
us to do? I'll just be over
here waiting when you need
to find me. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嘿，你能去见我哥哥卡济恩，看看他有没有新的任务给我们吗？我会在这里等你，需要我的时候随时来找我。回头见~

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Good work, Mr. Ahman just
arrived and picked up his
packages. It looks like we're
done for today. When you're
ready for another job, just
ask to my brother Kazien, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
干得好，阿赫曼先生刚到并取走了他的包裹。看起来我们今天的工作结束了。当你准备好接下一个任务时，直接去找我哥哥卡济恩，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lyozien, do you know
what kinds of things
we're delivering?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
廖齐恩，你知道我们要送的是什么东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
No clue. I've been
a little curious myself,
but my brother warned me
not to ask. Besides, I don't
think it makes a difference
to what we gotta do, right?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
完全不知道。我自己也有点好奇，但我哥哥警告我不要问。而且，我觉得这并不影响我们要做的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Anyway, it oughta be
fine. I mean, our clients
are entitled to their privacy
anyway. You've been in that
sort of situation, right? You
know, embarassing orders...
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
总之，应该没事的。我是说，我们的客户有权拥有隐私。
你也遇到过那种情况，对吧？
你知道的，尴尬的订单...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
No? Eh, just meet up with
my brother to see if he's
got another job for us, okay?
If you wanna find me again,
I'll be waiting right here.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
没有吗？呃，那就去见我哥哥，看看他有没有新的任务给我们，好吗？
如果你想再找我，我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Alright, when this Airship
arrives in Izlude, get off and
enter the Airport to meet with
a man named Mr. Ahman.
Let him know his order has
already arrived, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
好的，当这艘飞空艇到达依斯鲁得岛时，下船并进入机场，去见一位名叫阿赫曼先生的男人。
告诉他他的订单已经送达，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Um, would you mind
treading lightly around
this area, and kind of go
around the piles? Yeah,
these are all pretty fragile.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嗯，你介意在这个区域轻手轻脚地走，并绕开那些堆放的物品吗？是的，这些都很脆弱。
谢谢，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
are you Lyozien?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，你是廖齐恩吗？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, are you the one that
my brother Kazien sent?
Nice, I've been waiting
for you. As you can see,
I'm having trouble handling
all of these packages here.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嘿，你是我哥哥卡济恩派来的吗？
太好了，我一直在等你。正如你所见，我处理这些包裹有点吃力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, Kazien is
your brother? That's
weird, you figure he
would mention that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，卡济恩是你哥哥？
真奇怪，我以为他会提到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh, yeah, he's been like
that ever since we lived
in Lighthalzen's slums.
Luckily, he joined the
corporation and helped
us improve our lots in life...
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
啊，是的，自从我们住在里希塔乐镇的贫民窟以来，他就一直是这样。
幸运的是，他加入了公司，帮助改善了我们的生活...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
That's why I appreciate the
fact that he lets me work for
him. I can't let him down.
Anyway, back to business: we
gotta deliver these goods to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
所以我感激他让我为他工作。我不能让他失望。
好了，言归正传：我们必须把这些货物送到卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I have to ensure that these
packages aren't damaged or
stolen by thieves. Your job is
to go to Izlude, find Mr. Ahman
at the Airport, and tell him that his orders have safely arrived.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
我必须确保这些包裹不被损坏或被盗贼偷走。
你的任务是去依斯鲁得岛，在机场找到阿赫曼先生，告诉他他的订单已经安全送达。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Once you tell Mr. Ahman
that message, he'll take
care of picking up his own
packages. But yeah, I need
to stay behind to guard these
products in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
一旦你告诉阿赫曼先生这个消息，他会亲自去取他的包裹。
不过，在此期间，我需要留下来看守这些货物。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Um, would you mind
treading lightly around
this area, and kind of go
around the piles? Yeah,
these are all pretty fragile.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[廖齐恩]
嗯，你介意在这个区域轻手轻脚地走，并绕开那些堆放的物品吗？是的，这些都很脆弱。
谢谢，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, hello. I've heard
that you had to quit.
It's quite a pity, really.
If it weren't for you, some
of my packages would have
been destroyed by those thugs.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，你好。听说你不得不辞职了。
真遗憾。如果不是因为你，我的一些包裹可能已经被那些恶棍毁掉了。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Shouldn't you be
taking a break? Besides,
Lyozien is still waiting for
you on the Airship, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
你不该休息一下吗？
而且，廖齐恩还在飞空艇上等你，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, have my packages
arrived? Good, good.
I appreciate all of your
hard work. I'm surprised
they haven't hired you
full time by now.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，我的包裹到了吗？很好，很好。
我很感激你的辛勤工作。真惊讶他们到现在还没聘你为全职员工。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Is something the matter?
You seem really pale. Oh
well, you'll have plenty of
time to relax on the Airship.
Oh, and don't worry, I'll
take care of the packages.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
怎么了？你看起来很苍白。
算了，你在飞空艇上有的是时间放松。
哦，别担心，包裹我会处理的。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, hello. I'm not
expecting any packages
at this moment, although
I'm aware that there are a
few deliveries in queue, but shouldn't you be in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，你好。我现在没有期待任何包裹，虽然我知道有一些货物在排队，但你不该在里希塔乐镇吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Shouldn't you be on
your way and report to
Lyozien? You should hurry
before the Airship takes off.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
你不该在途中并向廖齐恩汇报吗？
在飞空艇起飞前，你应该快点。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Ah, it's you again.
I assume that means that
my packages have arrived
safely. Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
啊，又是你。
我猜这意味着我的包裹安全到达了。是吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right.
Actually, this time we 
were attacked by a group
of thugs, so I was wondering
if you knew anything about it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，没错。
实际上，这次我们被一群恶棍袭击了，所以我在想你是否知道些什么...

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
They attacked again?
Oh, that isn't good.
Well, I have no idea
what's going on. I wish
I had some idea of what
they were up to, really.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
他们又袭击了？
哦，那不好。
好吧，我不知道发生了什么。我真希望能知道他们在搞什么鬼。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
For now, you should
go and report to Lyozien.
I assume that you protected
my packages, so thank you
for your diligent work. Now, I shall pick up what I ordered...
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
现在，你应该去汇报给廖齐恩。
我猜你保护了我的包裹，所以感谢你的尽职工作。现在，我要去取我订购的东西了...

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, it's you again.
Shouldn't you be getting
on the Airship and heading
back to the Schwarzwald
Republic? There are more
deliveries in queue, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，又是你。
你不该上飞空艇并返回秀发兹发德共和国吗？
你知道，还有更多货物在排队。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Thank you for letting me
know that my order has arrived.
You should go back to Lyozien
now so you can finish your job.
Perhaps I'll see you again
sometime, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
谢谢你告诉我我的订单到了。
你现在应该回到廖齐恩那里，完成你的工作。
也许我们以后还会见面，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hmm, can you really
call this place an Airport?
It's far too small, wouldn't
you agree? Still, I kind of
enjoy sitting around here.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嗯，你真的能叫这个地方机场吗？
它太小了，不是吗？不过，我有点喜欢坐在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do
you know where I can
find a man named Ahman?
I have a message for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，你知道我可以在哪里找到一个叫阿赫曼的人吗？
我有消息要告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
I'm Ahman, how can--
Oh! You must be here to
tell me that my packages
have arrived. Am I correct?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
我是阿赫曼，有什么--
哦！你一定是来告诉我我的包裹到了。我猜得对吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-yes. That's right.
Your packages have
arrived and they're
being guarded until
you come to pick them up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，没错。
你的包裹已经到了，正在被看守，直到你来取。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Ah, that's very good to
know. Say, are you a new
worker for Lyozien and Kazien?
I don't believe I've seen you
around before. Have they finally started hiring part timers?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
啊，那真是太好了。
话说，你是廖齐恩和卡济恩的新员工吗？
我不记得见过你。
他们终于开始招兼职了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right.
Actually, I'm working for
them part time. I heard
they were really busy, so
I sort of volunteered my time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，没错。
其实我是兼职帮他们工作的。
听说他们很忙，所以我就主动请缨帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Alright, alright.
I suppose that you
also don't know what's
being delivered in these
packages, just like Lyozien.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
好吧，好吧。
我想你大概也不知道这些包裹里装的是什么，就像廖齐恩一样。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Well, it's all confidential
information anyway, so don't
worry about it. Thank you for
notifying me about the delivery.^FFFFFF  ^000000 Now, you should go back and 
tell Lyozien. Take care now~
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
反正都是机密信息，不用担心。谢谢你通知我包裹到了。^FFFFFF  ^000000现在，你该回去告诉廖齐恩了。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hmm, can you really
call this place an Airport?
It's far too small, wouldn't
you agree? Still, I kind of
enjoy sitting around here.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嗯，你真的能叫这个地方机场吗？
它太小了，不是吗？不过，我有点喜欢坐在这里。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Damn it! N-next time...
Next time we'll g-get rid
of those damned packages!
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 For now, we
retreat and fight another day!
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
该死！下...下次...
下次我们一定...一定要毁掉那些该死的包裹！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 暂时撤退，改日再战！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHey-- there's a slit
in the wrapping on one
of the packages. It was
probably ripped a little
while you were fighting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嘿——其中一个包裹的包装上有个裂口。
大概是你战斗时不小心撕开的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou peek through the
slit in the wrapping
that is covering one
of the packages.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你透过包裹包装上的裂口往里看。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... my God!
These are... These are
weapons of mass destruction.
There's even parts for assembling guardians, the kinds that usually
defend those Guild Castles...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢...天哪！
这些是...这些是大规模杀伤性武器。
甚至还有组装守卫的零件，就是那种通常用来守卫公会城堡的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
-Don't you have anything to protect, huh?- 
-Are you sure that you're always doing the right thing?-
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
-你难道没有什么需要守护的吗？-
-你确定自己一直做的是正确的事吗？-

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Answer me! Answer me! Answer meee!
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
回答我！回答我！回答我啊！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look man, this is what
I decided. I don't care
what other people'll think.
I might go to hell when
I die, but that's my problem.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
听着，这是我做的决定。
我不在乎别人怎么想。
我死后可能下地狱，但那是我的问题。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Besides, you adventurers
are always running around
with your swords and magic spells... Isn't that just as bad?
It's not the weapons or the power that's bad: it's how they're used.
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
而且，你们冒险者总是拿着剑和魔法到处跑...
这难道不是一样吗？
错的不是武器或力量，而是它们的使用方式。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
There'd be days when my
brother and I'd have nothing
to eat. So when I heard about
this job, I took it. What good
is world peace if I'm not even
alive to enjoy it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡济恩]
有时候我和弟弟连饭都吃不上。所以当我听说这份工作，我就接了。如果我连命都没了，世界和平又有什么意义呢？
